zh.tag: 人类与AI代理共存的蜂巢式协作空间
zh.what: Buzz 是一个自托管的协作平台，让人类和 AI 代理在同一个“房间”里共同工作。它基于 Nostr 协议，所有消息、操作和工作流步骤都作为签名事件记录在日志中，提供统一的身份模型和审计追踪。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Buzz 平台源码，包括前端界面、后端服务、Nostr 中继实现以及多个 Rust crate。提供了频道、画布、工作流、语音讨论等功能，并支持代理执行仓库操作、代码审查、CI/CD 等任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，基于 Nostr 协议，依赖多个 Rust crate 实现事件日志、身份管理和中继功能。
zh.hot: Buzz 在 GitHub 上一天内获得 3252 颗星，总星数达 4148，因其创新的“人类与代理平等协作”理念和自托管、基于 Nostr 的架构吸引了大量关注。
uses: 团队协作 —— 人类与 AI 代理在同一工作空间中共同管理项目、代码审查和 CI/CD
AI 代理开发 —— 测试和部署具有完整操作权限（如仓库、工作流）的 AI 代理
事件驱动工作流 —— 利用 Nostr 事件日志构建可审计的自动化流程
自托管社区 —— 为需要完全控制数据和身份的组织提供私有协作平台

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and agents collaborate in shared rooms
en.what: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms. Built on the Nostr protocol, every message, action, and workflow step is a signed event in a single log, providing a unified identity model and audit trail.
en.content: The repository contains the full Buzz platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, Nostr relay implementation, and multiple Rust crates. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and enables agents to perform repo operations, code review, CI/CD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, based on the Nostr protocol, leveraging multiple Rust crates for event logging, identity management, and relay functionality.
en.hot: Buzz gained 3252 stars in a single day, reaching 4148 total, due to its innovative concept of equal collaboration between humans and agents, self-hosted nature, and Nostr-based architecture.
uses: Team collaboration — humans and AI agents manage projects, code review, and CI/CD in the same workspace
AI agent development — test and deploy agents with full operational capabilities (repos, workflows, etc.)
Event-driven workflows — build auditable automation using Nostr event logs
Self-hosted communities — provide a private collaboration platform for organizations needing full data and identity control

zh.tag: 阿里巴巴开源的企业级AI代码审查CLI工具
zh.what: OpenCodeReview 是一款基于 AI 的代码审查 CLI 工具，起源于阿里巴巴集团内部，经过两年大规模验证，为数万开发者服务并发现数百万代码缺陷。它读取 Git diff，通过具备工具调用能力的 Agent 将变更文件发送给可配置的 LLM，生成精确到行的结构化审查评论。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具源码、内置精细调优的规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入等）、支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口，以及多语言文档和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 和 LLM API（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 作为阿里巴巴内部大规模验证的代码审查工具开源，结合确定性流水线和 LLM Agent 的混合架构，精准行级评论和内置规则集吸引了大量开发者，今日新增 162 星，总星数 10964。
uses: 开发团队 —— 集成到 CI/CD 流水线，自动审查代码提交，提升代码质量
个人开发者 —— 在本地运行审查，快速发现潜在缺陷和安全漏洞
开源维护者 —— 用于管理 PR 审查，减少人工负担

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review CLI with deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent
en.what: OpenCodeReview is an AI-powered code review CLI tool originating from Alibaba Group's internal system, serving tens of thousands of developers and identifying millions of code defects over two years. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates line-level structured review comments.
en.content: The repo contains Go CLI source code, built-in fine-tuned rulesets (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), support for OpenAI & Anthropic compatible APIs, and multi-language documentation and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, depends on Git and LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic compatible), supports agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
en.hot: Open-sourced from Alibaba's battle-tested internal tool, its hybrid architecture of deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, and built-in rulesets have attracted many developers, gaining 162 stars today and 10964 total.
uses: Development teams — integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated code review on commits, improving code quality
Individual developers — run locally for quick detection of potential defects and security vulnerabilities
Open source maintainers — manage PR reviews with reduced manual effort

zh.content: 仓库包含 macOS 桌面应用（.dmg 安装包）和 ego-browser 技能包，支持通过 npx 安装技能。提供文档、Discord 社区和 X 账号。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 构建，依赖 macOS 系统，通过 npx 管理技能。
zh.hot: 今日新增 247 颗星，GitHub Trending 日榜第 5 名。解决了 AI 浏览器自动化工具与用户争夺标签页的痛点，提供真正的并行体验。
uses: AI 开发者 —— 需要让 AI 代理在浏览器中自主操作，同时保留自己的浏览会话
自动化测试工程师 —— 利用 AI 代理并行执行浏览器测试任务
日常用户 —— 希望 AI 助手在不干扰自己浏览的情况下完成网页任务

en.tag: A browser designed for you and your AI agents to work in parallel
en.what: ego lite is a browser designed for humans and AI agents to work in parallel. Agents run multiple browser tasks in their own Spaces while your tabs stay yours, completing tasks faster on fewer tokens.
en.content: The repo includes a macOS desktop app (.dmg installer) and the ego-browser skill package, installable via npx. Also provides docs, Discord community, and X account.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, depends on macOS, skill management via npx.
en.hot: Gained 247 stars today, ranked #5 on GitHub Trending. Solves the pain point of AI browser automation tools fighting for tabs with users, offering true parallel experience.
uses: AI developers — need AI agents to operate browsers autonomously while keeping their own sessions
Automation test engineers — leverage AI agents to run browser tests in parallel
Everyday users — want AI assistants to complete web tasks without interrupting their browsing

en.what: A curated list of 1000+ production-ready Claude Skills and plugins for customizing Claude AI workflows, supporting not only Claude.ai and Claude Code but also coding agents like Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more.

Coding agent users — reuse Claude skills in tools like Codex, Cursor

zh.tag: 离线、隐私优先的英语语法检查器，快速开源，Rust 驱动
zh.what: Harper 是一个离线运行的英语语法检查工具，注重隐私和速度。它可以在毫秒级内检查文档，内存占用仅为 LanguageTool 的 1/50，且所有处理都在本地完成，无需联网。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Harper 核心库、语言服务器（harper-ls）、WebAssembly 版本以及多种编辑器集成（VS Code、Obsidian 等）。提供二进制下载和 npm 包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，通过 WebAssembly 支持浏览器端运行。提供 LSP 协议实现，可集成到各种编辑器中。
zh.hot: Harper 在 GitHub 上获得 12,300+ 星标，今日新增 624 星，排名日榜第 14。其离线、隐私优先的设计解决了 Grammarly 和 LanguageTool 的痛点，吸引了大量关注。

开发者 —— 集成到 VS Code、Neovim 等编辑器中，作为轻量级 LSP 使用
Obsidian 用户 —— 通过插件在笔记中直接使用 Harper
需要离线环境的用户 —— 如飞机上或网络受限场景

en.tag: Offline, privacy-first English grammar checker, fast and open-source, powered by Rust
en.what: Harper is an offline English grammar checker that prioritizes privacy and speed. It can lint documents in milliseconds, uses less than 1/50th of LanguageTool's memory, and processes everything locally without network requests.
en.content: The repository includes the Harper core library, language server (harper-ls), WebAssembly build, and integrations for multiple editors (VS Code, Obsidian, etc.). Binaries and npm packages are available.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with WebAssembly support for browser usage. Implements the LSP protocol for editor integration.
en.hot: Harper has garnered 12,300+ stars on GitHub, with 624 new stars today, ranking 14th on the daily trending list. Its offline, privacy-first approach addresses pain points of Grammarly and LanguageTool, drawing significant attention.
uses: Privacy-conscious writers — get grammar checking without sending text to the cloud
Developers — integrate into editors like VS Code, Neovim as a lightweight LSP
Obsidian users — use Harper directly in notes via plugin
Users needing offline environments — such as on flights or restricted networks

zh.tag: 金融市场的首个开源基础模型
zh.what: Kronos 是一个专为金融市场 K 线序列设计的解码器基础模型。它通过两阶段框架：先用量化器将 OHLCV 数据转为层次化离散 token，再用自回归 Transformer 预训练，统一处理多种量化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型代码、预训练权重、微调脚本、论文及在线演示。提供 Hugging Face 模型和实时 BTC/USD 预测演示。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 和 Transformer 架构，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 和自定义 tokenizer。
zh.hot: 作为首个开源金融基础模型，被 AAAI 2026 接收，上线即获 3.2 万星标，展示强大预测能力。
uses: 量化研究员 —— 用于金融时间序列预测和因子挖掘
交易员 —— 辅助技术分析和策略回测
AI 开发者 —— 研究金融领域的 tokenization 和预训练方法

en.tag: First open-source foundation model for financial markets
en.what: Kronos is a decoder-only foundation model tailored for financial K-line sequences. It uses a two-stage framework: a specialized tokenizer quantizes OHLCV data into hierarchical discrete tokens, then an autoregressive Transformer is pre-trained to handle diverse quantitative tasks.
en.content: Repository includes model code, pretrained weights, fine-tuning scripts, paper, and a live demo. Hugging Face model and real-time BTC/USD forecast demo are available.
en.stack: Built on PyTorch and Transformer architecture, with Hugging Face Transformers and custom tokenizer.
en.hot: As the first open-source financial foundation model, accepted at AAAI 2026, it gained 32K stars upon release, demonstrating strong forecasting capability.
uses: Quantitative researchers — for financial time series forecasting and factor mining
Traders — for technical analysis and strategy backtesting
AI developers — for studying tokenization and pretraining in finance

zh.tag: 为编码智能体打造的完整软件开发方法论与技能框架
zh.what: Superpowers 是一套为编码智能体设计的软件开发方法论，基于一组可组合的技能和初始指令，让智能体在开发过程中自动遵循规范。它强调先理解需求、制定规范、规划实现，再通过子智能体驱动开发，实现长时间自主工作。
zh.content: 仓库包含一套技能框架、初始指令集以及针对多种编码智能体（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等）的安装指南。核心是让智能体在开发时自动触发规范流程，包括需求澄清、规范展示、实现计划、TDD 和子智能体开发。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Shell，依赖多种编码智能体平台（Claude Code、Cursor 等），无额外运行时依赖。
zh.hot: 26.1k Stars 且日增 479，因其提供了一种让 AI 编码智能体自主、规范地完成复杂开发任务的实用方法论，解决了开发者对 AI 代码质量与可控性的核心痛点。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编码工具的开发者 —— 为智能体注入规范开发流程，提升代码质量
AI 编码工具的研究者与构建者 —— 参考其技能框架与方法论设计自己的智能体系统
希望实现 AI 自主编程的企业团队 —— 通过商业支持获得稳定、可控的 AI 开发流水线

en.tag: A complete software development methodology & composable skills framework for coding agents
en.what: Superpowers is a software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills and initial instructions. It guides agents to first understand requirements, produce specs, plan implementation, then execute via subagent-driven development, enabling hours of autonomous work.
en.content: The repo contains a skills framework, initial instructions, and installation guides for various coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, etc.). The core is an automated workflow: requirement clarification, spec review, implementation planning, TDD, and subagent-driven development.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, depends on various coding agent platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), no additional runtime dependencies.
en.hot: 26.1k stars with 479 daily new, because it offers a practical methodology for AI coding agents to autonomously and systematically handle complex development tasks, addressing core developer concerns about code quality and control.
uses: Developers using AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor — to give agents a disciplined development workflow for better code quality
Researchers and builders of AI coding tools — to learn from its skills framework and methodology for designing agent systems
Enterprise teams seeking autonomous AI programming — via commercial support for stable, controlled AI development pipelines

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的高性能 Minecraft 服务端
zh.what: Pumpkin 是一个完全用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 服务器，旨在提供极致的性能和可定制性。它支持最新的 Java 和 Bedrock 版本，同时保持原版游戏机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务器核心实现，包括世界加载、区块生成、玩家管理、实体 AI、红石、插件系统等模块，目前处于积极开发中。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Rust，利用多线程和零成本抽象实现高性能；依赖 tokio 异步运行时和自定义网络协议实现。
zh.hot: Rust 语言的高性能和安全性吸引了大量 Minecraft 社区关注，今日新增 108 星，总星数 8415，位列 GitHub 日榜第 18 名。
uses: Minecraft 服务器管理员 —— 希望部署高性能、低资源占用的服务端
Rust 开发者 —— 学习 Rust 在游戏服务器领域的实践
Minecraft 模组/插件开发者 —— 基于其插件系统进行扩展

en.tag: A fast, efficient Minecraft server built entirely in Rust
en.what: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, designed for maximum performance and customizability. It supports the latest Java and Bedrock editions while adhering to vanilla game mechanics.
en.content: The repository contains a full server core implementation, including world loading, chunk generation, player management, entity AI, redstone, plugin system, etc., currently under heavy development.
en.stack: Tech stack is Rust, leveraging multi-threading and zero-cost abstractions for high performance; relies on tokio async runtime and custom network protocol implementation.
en.hot: The high performance and safety of Rust attract massive attention from the Minecraft community, with 108 stars added today and 8415 total, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Minecraft server admins — seeking high-performance, low-resource server software
Rust developers — learning Rust in game server development
Minecraft mod/plugin developers — extending functionality via its plugin system

zh.tag: 去中心化蓝牙+ Nostr 双协议即时通讯
zh.what: Bitchat 是一款去中心化、点对点的即时通讯应用，支持蓝牙 Mesh 网络（离线）和 Nostr 协议（互联网）双传输架构。无需账户、手机号或中央服务器，注重隐私与抗审查。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 iOS/macOS 原生应用源码，支持蓝牙 Mesh 多跳中继、Nostr 全球中继、地理频道、IRC 风格命令、端到端加密（Noise 协议 + NIP-17）及紧急擦除等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，依赖 Bluetooth LE（CoreBluetooth）和 Nostr 协议栈，集成 Noise Protocol 加密、LZ4 压缩、Geohash 地理编码。
zh.hot: 凭借去中心化、无服务器、离线可用等特性，在隐私和抗审查需求高涨的当下迅速走红，24 小时内获 1720 星，总星数达 28722。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 无需手机号或账户，完全匿名通信
离线/灾难场景 —— 蓝牙 Mesh 在无网络环境下仍可通信
抗议或审查环境 —— 去中心化架构难以被封锁
技术爱好者 —— IRC 风格命令和开源代码便于探索

en.tag: Decentralized messaging with Bluetooth mesh & Nostr
en.what: Bitchat is a decentralized peer-to-peer messaging app with dual transport: Bluetooth mesh for offline and Nostr for internet. No accounts, phone numbers, or central servers; privacy-first and censorship-resistant.
en.content: Full source code for iOS/macOS native app with Bluetooth mesh multi-hop relay, Nostr global relays, location-based channels, IRC-style commands, end-to-end encryption (Noise + NIP-17), and emergency wipe.
en.stack: Built with Swift, leveraging Bluetooth LE (CoreBluetooth) and Nostr protocol stack, with Noise Protocol encryption, LZ4 compression, and Geohash geocoding.
en.hot: Its decentralized, serverless, offline-capable design resonates with privacy and censorship concerns, gaining 1720 stars in 24h and 28722 total.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — anonymous without phone or account
Offline/disaster scenarios — Bluetooth mesh works without internet
Protests or censorship — decentralized architecture resists blocking
Tech enthusiasts — IRC-style commands and open-source code

zh.tag: 面向真实工程师的 AI 代理技能集
zh.what: 这是一套由资深工程师设计的 AI 代理技能（skills），旨在帮助开发者进行真正的工程开发，而非简单的“氛围编码”。它提供可组合、易定制的小型技能模块，适用于任何模型，并支持通过 skills.sh 或 Claude Code 插件安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个可选的技能模块（如 /triage、/setup-matt-pocock-skills 等），以及一个快速安装脚本和 Claude Code 插件配置。用户通过 npx 命令选择安装，并运行设置向导完成配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Shell 脚本和 Node.js（npx），可选集成 Claude Code 插件。依赖 skills.sh 生态。

uses: 构建隐私敏感的 RAG 系统（完全离线，数据不离开本地）

uses: Building privacy-sensitive RAG systems (fully air-gapped, no data leaving local)
Large-scale vector search (e.g., document retrieval, recommendation systems)

en.tag: Dark Web OSINT Tool
en.what: TorBot is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) tool designed for the dark web (.onion sites). It crawls Tor hidden services, collects page titles, link relationships, and outputs results as JSON or visual tree graphs.

zh.tag: 无向量、基于推理的 RAG 文档索引
zh.what: PageIndex 是一个无需向量数据库和文本分块的 RAG 文档索引系统。它通过基于推理的上下文感知检索，让 LLM 像人类一样阅读和理解长文档，实现真正的相关性匹配而非简单的语义相似度。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心索引框架、Agentic 无向量 RAG 示例、PageIndex 文件系统（支持百万级文档）、以及聊天平台、MCP 和 API 接口。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 OpenAI Agents SDK 等 LLM 工具，无需向量数据库。
zh.hot: 该项目以 34,560 星高居 GitHub 热门，因其颠覆性的无向量 RAG 思路——无需分块和向量库，通过推理实现精准检索，解决了传统 RAG 的痛点。
uses: 需要处理长文档（如法律合同、学术论文）的 RAG 开发者
希望避免向量数据库复杂性的 AI 应用构建者
构建 Agentic 检索系统的研究人员
需要大规模文档搜索的企业用户

en.tag: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG document index
en.what: PageIndex is a vectorless, chunking-free RAG document index that enables reasoning-based, context-aware retrieval. It allows LLMs to read and understand long documents like a human, achieving true relevance matching over mere semantic similarity.
en.content: The repo contains the core indexing framework, an agentic vectorless RAG example, the PageIndex File System for scaling to millions of documents, and interfaces for chat platform, MCP, and API.
en.stack: Built with Python, leverages OpenAI Agents SDK and other LLM tools, no vector database required.
en.hot: With 34,560 stars, this project is trending for its disruptive vectorless RAG approach—no chunking, no vector DB, using reasoning for precise retrieval, addressing key pain points of traditional RAG.
uses: RAG developers working with long documents (legal contracts, academic papers)
AI app builders seeking to avoid vector database complexity
Researchers building agentic retrieval systems
Enterprise users needing large-scale document search

en.tag: Free proxy to use Claude Code, Codex, Pi and more coding agents

zh.tag: 高效高分辨率图像与视频生成框架
zh.what: SANA 是一个面向效率的高分辨率图像和视频生成代码库，基于线性扩散 Transformer 架构。它提供完整的训练和推理流程，支持从文本到图像/视频的生成，并包含多种变体如 SANA-1.5、SANA-Sprint、SANA-Video 等。

开发者 —— 集成高分辨率生成能力到应用，如游戏、影视、设计
AI 爱好者 —— 通过在线 Demo 体验文本到图像/视频生成

en.tag: Efficient high-resolution image & video generation framework
en.what: SANA is an efficiency-oriented codebase for high-resolution image and video generation, built on linear diffusion Transformer. It provides complete training and inference pipelines for text-to-image/video generation, with variants like SANA-1.5, SANA-Sprint, SANA-Video, etc.
en.content: The repo includes model code, training scripts, inference examples, pretrained weights, and multiple demos (e.g., 6x3090 online demo, 4bit quantized demo, ControlNet demo). It also integrates with ComfyUI, SGLang, Cosmos-RL, etc.
en.stack: Built on PyTorch and NVIDIA deep learning frameworks, using linear diffusion Transformer architecture, with mixed-precision training and multiple quantization schemes.

AI enthusiasts — experience text-to-image/video generation via online demos

zh.tag: 开源AI自动化渗透测试工具，自主发现并修复应用漏洞
zh.what: Strix 是一个开源的 AI 渗透测试平台，通过自主 AI 代理动态运行代码，像真实黑客一样侦察、利用并验证应用漏洞。它通过生成实际的可利用 Proof-of-Concept 来确认漏洞，而非仅依赖静态分析的误报，并支持多代理协作规模化执行安全测试。

zh.stack: 项目以 Python 为主要语言构建，支持通过 PyPI 分发安装（strix-agent），并依赖现代 AI 代理编排框架实现多智能体协作；可与现有 DevOps 工具链深度集成。

uses: 开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动化安全扫描，在代码合并前拦截漏洞
安全工程师 —— 利用多 AI 代理协作执行大规模渗透测试与漏洞验证
DevOps/平台团队 —— 将安全左移，无需额外基础设施即可接入现有流水线

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI pentesting agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities
en.what: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing platform where autonomous agents dynamically run code to discover and validate vulnerabilities like real hackers. It generates working proofs-of-concept rather than static-analysis false positives, and scales through multi-agent orchestration for collaborative security testing.
en.content: The repository ships with a full pentesting toolkit covering reconnaissance, exploitation, and validation out of the box. It also provides GitHub Actions integration and CI/CD pipeline plugins to auto-scan pull requests and block insecure code before it reaches production.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python and distributed via PyPI as strix-agent, it relies on modern AI agent orchestration frameworks for multi-agent collaboration and deep integration with existing DevOps toolchains.
en.hot: With 16,488 new stars this month and a #5 spot on GitHub Trending, it has climbed to 42,318 total stars. Its “AI + dynamic PoC validation” model directly addresses the high false-positive rates of legacy scanners and the cost of manual pentesting, making it a standout in the shift-left security movement.
uses: Development teams — Automate security scanning in CI/CD to intercept vulnerabilities before code merges.
Security engineers — Leverage multi-agent AI collaboration for large-scale pentesting and real exploit validation.
DevOps/platform teams — Shift security left by plugging into existing pipelines with zero additional infrastructure.

Enterprise teams — unify context management across multiple AI platforms

en.tag: Open-source AI gateway aggregating 264 providers with token compression and auto-fallback

Power users of AI coding tools —— Redirect Cursor, Cline, Claude Code and Copilot to free model backends via one endpoint.
Platform builders —— Those needing a unified gateway with auto-fallback, routing strategies, and token compression for internal AI infra.

AI enthusiasts: Build intelligent agents using multi-model support (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)

zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库采用 monorepo 结构，包含 pi-ai（统一 LLM 接口）、pi-agent-core（代理运行时）、pi-coding-agent（交互式编码 CLI）和 pi-tui（差分渲染终端 UI）四个核心包。README 还提供了容器化与沙箱隔离方案，以及面向人类和代理的协作规范。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 npm 管理 monorepo 依赖与生命周期脚本。支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流 LLM 提供商，并可通过 Docker 或 Gondolin micro-VM 进行容器化隔离。
zh.hot: 一周内新增 2,741 Star 使其冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 17 名，目前总 Star 数已突破 7.2 万。开发者对统一 LLM 接口与自扩展编程代理的结合表现出强烈兴趣。
uses: 需要构建多模型 AI 代理的开发者——统一接口降低集成成本
追求终端原生体验的 CLI 用户——内置 TUI 与差分渲染提升交互效率
关注代码安全隔离的团队——提供 Docker、micro-VM 等多种沙箱方案
希望人机与 AI 代理协作的项目维护者——贡献指南同时面向人类与 Agent

en.tag: AI agent toolkit with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding agent CLI
en.what: A modular AI agent development framework that unifies multi-provider LLM APIs, agent runtime, and terminal UI. It features a self-extensible coding agent CLI with tool calling, state management, and interactive coding capabilities.
en.content: The monorepo houses four core packages: pi-ai (unified LLM API), pi-agent-core (agent runtime), pi-coding-agent (interactive CLI), and pi-tui (diff-rendered terminal UI). It also includes containerization guides and contribution rules for both humans and agents.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript with npm-based monorepo tooling and lifecycle scripts. Supports major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and offers containerization via Docker or Gondolin micro-VM.
en.hot: It gained 2,741 stars this week, landing at #17 on GitHub's TypeScript Weekly Trending with over 72.2k total stars. The combination of a unified LLM API and a self-extensible coding agent has drawn strong developer interest.
uses: Developers building multi-model AI agents — unified API reduces integration overhead
CLI users preferring terminal-native experiences — built-in TUI with diff rendering
Teams requiring secure isolation — supports Docker, micro-VM, and sandbox patterns
Project maintainers enabling human and AI co-contribution — guidelines cover both humans and agents

zh.tag: AI 驱动的全球实时态势感知仪表盘
zh.what: World Monitor 是一个实时全球情报仪表盘，利用 AI 聚合新闻、监控地缘政治事件和基础设施状态，提供统一的态势感知界面。它支持多个垂直领域（科技、金融、大宗商品、能源等）的定制化视图。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 应用源码、CLI 工具和 npm 包，提供多种主题变体（科技、金融、大宗商品、能源等），以及 MCP 服务器集成。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 npm 包管理，支持 Web 应用和 CLI 两种形态，集成了 MCP 服务器。
zh.hot: 凭借 AI 驱动的实时全球情报聚合和多个垂直领域定制视图，上线后迅速获得 6.5 万+ Star，日增近 1300，登顶 GitHub 日榜。
uses: 地缘政治分析师 —— 实时监控全球事件与基础设施状态
金融投资者 —— 跟踪大宗商品、能源等市场动态
科技从业者 —— 获取科技领域新闻与趋势
普通用户 —— 通过 Happy 变体关注积极新闻

en.tag: AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard for situational awareness
en.what: World Monitor is a real-time global intelligence dashboard that uses AI to aggregate news, monitor geopolitical events, and track infrastructure status in a unified situational awareness interface. It offers customized views for various verticals like tech, finance, commodities, and energy.
en.content: The repository contains full web application source code, CLI tools, and npm packages, offering multiple theme variants (tech, finance, commodities, energy, etc.), along with MCP server integration.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, managed via npm, supports both web app and CLI, and integrates MCP server.
en.hot: With AI-powered real-time global intelligence aggregation and multiple vertical-specific views, it quickly gained over 65K stars, adding nearly 1,300 daily, topping GitHub's daily trending chart.
uses: Geopolitical analysts — monitor global events and infrastructure in real time
Financial investors — track commodities, energy, and market movements
Tech professionals — stay updated with tech news and trends
General users — follow positive news via the Happy variant

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Web 应用源码、桌面应用构建配置、CLI 工具以及文档（入门指南、远程访问、架构概览等）。支持通过 npx 快速运行或安装桌面应用。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Vite+（Vite 的增强版）构建，依赖各代理的 CLI 工具（Codex CLI、Claude Code 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Vite+ (enhanced Vite), depends on each agent's CLI tool (Codex CLI, Claude Code, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 413 stars this week, total 14459, ranked #18 on TypeScript weekly trending. It fills the gap for a unified multi-agent management UI, attracting many developers interested in AI coding tools.
uses: Developers who want to switch between multiple AI coding assistants in one interface
Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 为 pi 编码代理打造的本地 Web 界面
zh.what: Pi Web 是一个为 pi 编码代理设计的本地 Web 用户界面。它读取本地的 pi 会话文件，提供浏览器工作区，支持会话浏览、实时聊天、模型配置、技能管理和项目文件预览。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 应用源码，支持通过 npx 或 npm 全局安装运行，提供会话管理、模型配置、文件预览等功能，并附带中文文档。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 Node.js 运行时，依赖 pi 编码代理的会话文件格式。
zh.hot: 今日新增 298 星，总星数 1723，位列 GitHub 日榜第 17。作为 pi 代理的官方 Web UI，填补了 CLI 代理缺乏图形界面的空白，受到开发者欢迎。

需要可视化浏览代理会话记录的用户 —— 按项目浏览历史对话
希望从终端切换到图形界面的用户 —— 在 Web UI 中配置模型和技能

en.tag: Local web UI for the pi coding agent
en.what: Pi Web is a local web UI for the pi coding agent. It reads local pi session files and provides a browser workspace for session browsing, real-time chat, model configuration, skill management, and project file preview.
en.content: The repository contains the full web app source code, can be run via npx or npm global install, offering session management, model configuration, file preview, and includes Chinese documentation.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Node.js, depends on pi coding agent session file format.
en.hot: Gained 298 stars today, total 1723, ranked #17 on GitHub Daily Trending. As the official web UI for the pi agent, it fills the gap of missing GUI for CLI agents and is well received by developers.

Users who need to visually browse agent session logs — browse past conversations by project
Users who want to switch from terminal to GUI — configure models and skills in web UI

zh.tag: 开源 AI 工作流共享桌面应用，替代 Claude Cowork
zh.what: OpenWork 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，用于共享 AI 工作流。它可作为 Claude Cowork 和 Codex 的替代品，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。通过添加 OpenWork MCP，用户可以在 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等代理中复用技能、MCP 和连接服务。

zh.hot: 作为 Claude Cowork 的开源替代品，吸引了大量关注，当前 17k+ Stars，日增 49，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 11。
uses: AI 开发者 —— 在不同代理间共享和复用工作流
团队协作 —— 通过管理后台统一管理技能和权限
企业用户 —— 大规模配置推理模型和访问控制

en.tag: Open-source desktop app for sharing AI workflows, alternative to Claude Cowork
en.what: OpenWork is a free, open-source desktop app for sharing AI workflows. It serves as an alternative to Claude Cowork and Codex on macOS, Windows, and Linux. By adding the OpenWork MCP, users can reuse skills, MCPs, and connected services across agents like Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.
en.content: The repo includes desktop app source code, MCP integration guides, admin panel (OpenWork Den), and installation scripts. It provides search and execute capability tools, supporting team collaboration and access control.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses the MCP protocol to interact with AI agents, supports remote MCP servers and OAuth authentication.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork, it has gained significant traction with 17k+ stars, 49 daily additions, ranking 11th on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: AI developers — share and reuse workflows across different agents
Team collaboration — centrally manage skills and permissions via admin panel
Enterprise users — configure inference models and access control at scale

zh.tag: Google 出品的全栈 AI 应用开发框架
zh.what: Genkit 是一个开源框架，用于构建全栈 AI 应用，支持 JavaScript/TypeScript、Go、Python 和 Dart。它提供统一的接口来集成 Google、OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 等模型，并简化了多模态内容、结构化输出、工具调用和代理工作流的开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含多语言 SDK、插件系统、CLI 工具、示例应用和文档。核心 SDK 提供生成、检索、工具调用等 API，插件支持多种模型和平台集成。
zh.stack: 主要技术栈：TypeScript、Go、Python、Dart。依赖包括 Firebase、Google AI、OpenAI、Anthropic、Ollama 等。
zh.hot: 由 Google 生产环境验证，支持多语言和主流模型，简化 AI 应用开发流程，吸引大量开发者关注，Star 数超 6k。
uses: 全栈开发者 —— 快速集成 AI 功能到 Web 或移动应用
AI 工程师 —— 构建和部署聊天机器人、自动化流程和推荐系统
多语言团队 —— 使用 JS/TS、Go、Python 或 Dart 统一开发 AI 应用

en.tag: Google's open-source framework for building full-stack AI apps
en.what: Genkit is an open-source framework for building full-stack AI-powered applications, supporting JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Python, and Dart. It provides a unified interface to integrate models from Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and more, simplifying development of multimodal content, structured output, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
en.content: The repository includes multi-language SDKs, a plugin system, CLI tools, sample apps, and documentation. The core SDK provides APIs for generation, retrieval, tool calling, etc., with plugins for various model and platform integrations.
en.stack: Main tech stack: TypeScript, Go, Python, Dart. Dependencies include Firebase, Google AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, etc.
en.hot: Backed by Google's production use, supports multiple languages and major models, simplifies AI app development, attracting over 6k stars.
uses: Full-stack developers — quickly integrate AI features into web or mobile apps
AI engineers — build and deploy chatbots, automations, and recommendation systems
Multi-language teams — develop AI apps uniformly in JS/TS, Go, Python, or Dart

zh.tag: 代码驱动、实时更新的软件架构可视化工具
zh.what: LikeC4 是一种建模语言和工具集，用于从代码描述生成软件架构图。它受 C4 模型启发，但允许自定义符号、元素类型和嵌套层级，使架构图始终与实际代码同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LikeC4 语言规范、CLI 工具、VS Code 扩展以及示例模板。核心是 `likec4` 包，提供 `start` 命令启动本地预览服务器，并支持导出为静态站点。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时。前端使用 React 渲染交互式图表，支持 VS Code 和 Open VSX 扩展。
zh.hot: 今日新增 58 星，总星数 4019，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 12。开发者对“代码即架构”的自动化、可视化需求强烈，LikeC4 提供了比传统 UML 更灵活、更现代的替代方案。
uses: 软件架构师 —— 用代码定义并维护系统架构图，确保文档与实现一致
开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动生成架构图，用于代码审查和文档
技术写作者 —— 为开源项目或内部系统创建可交互的架构文档

en.tag: Code-driven, always up-to-date software architecture visualization
en.what: LikeC4 is a modeling language and toolset that generates software architecture diagrams from code descriptions. Inspired by the C4 model, it allows custom notation, element types, and nested levels, keeping diagrams always in sync with the actual code.
en.content: The repository includes the LikeC4 language specification, CLI tool, VS Code extension, and example templates. The core `likec4` package provides a `start` command to launch a local preview server and supports exporting to static sites.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Node.js. The frontend uses React for interactive diagram rendering, with extensions for VS Code and Open VSX.
en.hot: Gained 58 stars today, total 4019, ranked #12 on TypeScript daily trending. Developers have a strong demand for automated, code-driven architecture visualization, and LikeC4 offers a more flexible, modern alternative to traditional UML.
uses: Software architects — define and maintain system architecture diagrams in code, ensuring docs match implementation
Development teams — auto-generate architecture diagrams in CI/CD for code reviews and documentation
Technical writers — create interactive architecture docs for open-source or internal systems

zh.tag: AI 驱动的本地求职助手，基于 Claude Code 自动化申请流程
zh.what: 这是一个基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职应用框架，能在你的机器上运行。它可以评估职位描述、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试，将整个求职流程自动化。

en.tag: AI-powered local job search assistant automating applications via Claude Code
en.what: An AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code that runs on your machine. It evaluates job postings, tailors CVs, writes cover letters, and prepares interviews, automating the entire job search workflow.

en.hot: Gained over 20k stars this month, reaching 24k total, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending monthly. The author personally used this framework to land an AI engineer job, sparking massive interest.
uses: Job seekers: individuals wanting to automate CV tailoring, cover letter writing, and interview prep with AI
Developers: tech enthusiasts interested in AI agent workflows, looking to learn or extend Claude Code application frameworks
Recruitment consultants: professionals needing to batch evaluate job fit and optimize application materials

zh.what: MonkeyCode 是一个开源的企业级 AI 开发平台，内置开发环境管理、AI 模型管理、AI 任务管理和项目需求管理。它专为专业工程团队设计，不同于普通的 AI 编码工具，支持在企业内网部署，让开发者快速启动任务，同时让工程领导集中管理 AI 开发工作流。

zh.hot: 今日新增 10 星，总星数 3843，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 15。作为企业级 AI 编码平台，它解决了团队协作和私有化部署的痛点，受到开发者关注。
uses: 企业研发团队 —— 在内网部署 MonkeyCode，统一管理 AI 开发任务和环境

en.tag: Enterprise-grade AI coding platform for teams, integrating dev environment, AI models, and task management

AI developers — use built-in models and cloud environments for rapid AI coding experiments
Tech managers — monitor and coordinate team AI development workflows via the platform

zh.tag: 数据和AI的开放上下文层
zh.what: OpenMetadata 是一个开源平台，用于构建可信的数据上下文和业务语义，服务于人类、AI 助手和代理。它将技术元数据、数据质量信号、血缘、所有权、使用情况、策略、对话、记忆、词汇表、分类、指标、域、数据合同和数据产品统一到一个元数据知识图中。

zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖包括元数据知识图、语义搜索、API/SDK 等。
zh.hot: 作为最大且增长最快的开源 AI 上下文项目，OpenMetadata 解决了 AI 系统需要上下文和记忆而非原始数据连接的需求，拥有 14563 星和活跃的社区。
uses: 数据工程师和架构师：用于构建统一的数据目录和元数据管理平台
AI 开发者和数据科学家：为 AI 代理和助手提供可信的数据上下文
数据治理团队：管理数据质量、血缘、策略和合规性
业务分析师：通过业务词汇表和指标理解数据含义

en.tag: The Open Context Layer for Data and AI
en.what: OpenMetadata is an open platform for building trusted data context and business semantics for humans, AI assistants, and agents. It unifies technical metadata, data quality signals, lineage, ownership, usage, policies, conversations, memories, glossaries, classifications, metrics, domains, data contracts, and data products into a unified metadata knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository contains the core code for OpenMetadata, 130+ connectors, open metadata standards, semantic search, APIs, SDKs, and an MCP server.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with dependencies including metadata knowledge graph, semantic search, APIs/SDKs.
en.hot: As the largest and fastest-growing open-source project for AI context, OpenMetadata addresses the need for AI systems to have context and memory rather than raw data connections, with 14563 stars and an active community.
uses: Data engineers and architects: to build a unified data catalog and metadata management platform
AI developers and data scientists: to provide trusted data context for AI agents and assistants
Data governance teams: to manage data quality, lineage, policies, and compliance
Business analysts: to understand data meaning through business glossaries and metrics

zh.tag: 用 HTML 写视频，专为 AI 代理打造
zh.what: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，能将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可搜索动画转换为确定性 MP4 视频。它支持本地 CLI 使用、AI 编码代理集成，或作为托管创作工作流的渲染核心。

uses: AI 代理开发者 —— 通过 Skills 让代理自动生成视频内容
前端开发者 —— 用熟悉的 HTML/CSS 技能制作动画视频
内容创作者 —— 快速生成产品介绍、演示视频等

en.tag: Write HTML, render video, built for agents
en.what: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that turns HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via CLI, integrated with AI coding agents, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
en.content: The repo includes the core framework, CLI tool, AI agent skills, documentation, examples, and showcase pages. Users can get started via npm package or npx command.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript on Node.js (≥22). Relies on HTML/CSS rendering engine and FFmpeg for video encoding.

zh.tag: 专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计的 Git 工作树 CLI 工具
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，用于高效管理 Git 工作树，特别针对并行 AI 代理工作流进行了优化。它简化了多分支并行开发场景下的工作树创建、切换和清理。

团队协作 —— 在代码审查和并行开发中保持工作区整洁

en.tag: A CLI for Git worktree management, optimized for parallel AI agent workflows
en.what: Worktrunk is a CLI tool for efficient Git worktree management, specifically optimized for parallel AI agent workflows. It simplifies creating, switching, and cleaning up worktrees in multi-branch parallel development scenarios.

zh.tag: 现代化 Git 版本控制客户端，支持 AI 工作流

zh.tag: 7x24小时屏幕记录，为AI代理提供本地记忆

zh.tag: 用 Rust 实现的高性能 Apache Iceberg 表格式
zh.what: Apache Iceberg 是一种开放的表格式，用于大规模分析数据集。该仓库用 Rust 实现了 Iceberg 规范，提供高性能的读写、目录管理和查询集成能力。

需要低延迟查询的分析系统 —— 利用 Rust 的零成本抽象和并发安全

en.tag: High-performance Rust implementation of Apache Iceberg table format

zh.tag: Rust 官方工具链安装器，轻松管理多版本编译器

en.what: Rustup is the official toolchain installer for Rust, allowing installation from official release channels and easy switching between stable, beta, and nightly compilers with automatic updates. It simplifies cross-compilation by providing binary builds of the standard library for common platforms and runs on all platforms Rust supports, including Windows.

zh.tag: 极速 Python 包管理与项目工具，Rust 实现
zh.what: uv 是一个用 Rust 编写的极速 Python 包和项目管理器。它旨在替代 pip、pip-tools、pipx、poetry、pyenv、twine、virtualenv 等多个工具，提供统一的解决方案。

zh.hot: uv 凭借比 pip 快 10-100 倍的性能、统一多工具的能力以及 Astral 团队（Ruff 创建者）的背书，吸引了 87k+ 星标，成为 Python 工具链的热门选择。

团队协作 —— 使用通用锁文件确保依赖一致性
CI/CD 环境 —— 快速安装依赖，减少构建时间
多 Python 版本管理 —— 统一管理 Python 版本和虚拟环境

en.tag: Blazing-fast Python package & project manager, written in Rust
en.what: uv is an extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust. It aims to replace multiple tools like pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, twine, virtualenv, etc., providing a unified solution.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, benchmarks, documentation, and installation scripts for uv. It provides a CLI tool supporting package installation, project creation, dependency management, Python version management, script execution, and tool installation.

Team collaboration — use universal lockfile for dependency consistency
CI/CD environments — quickly install dependencies, reduce build time
Multi-Python version management — manage Python versions and virtual environments uniformly

zh.tag: 面向多模态AI的开放湖仓格式
zh.what: Lance 是一种开放的湖仓格式，专为多模态 AI 设计。它支持高性能向量搜索、全文搜索、随机访问和数据版本控制，可替代 Parquet 等传统格式。

需要高性能随机访问和版本控制的大规模 ML 训练团队
管理图像、视频、音频等多模态数据的开发者
希望从 Parquet 迁移以获得更好性能的数据工程师

en.tag: Open lakehouse format for multimodal AI
en.what: Lance is an open lakehouse format designed for multimodal AI. It enables high-performance vector search, full-text search, random access, and data versioning, serving as a replacement for traditional formats like Parquet.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust implementation of Lance file format, table format, and catalog spec, along with Python bindings (pylance). It includes CLI tools and comprehensive API documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Apache Arrow and Lance core libraries. Integrates with Pandas, DuckDB, Polars, PyTorch, and more.
en.hot: With 6855 stars, Lance is trending due to its 100x faster random access than Parquet, native multimodal support, and zero-copy versioning, making it a popular choice for AI data infrastructure.

Large-scale ML training teams needing high-performance random access and versioning
Developers managing multimodal data like images, videos, and audio
Data engineers migrating from Parquet for better performance

zh.tag: Delta Lake 的原生 Rust 实现，提供 Python 绑定
zh.what: delta-rs 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Delta Lake 原生库，同时提供 Python 绑定。它允许用户在不依赖 Apache Spark 的情况下，通过 Rust 或 Python 直接读取、写入和管理 Delta Lake 表。

zh.hot: Delta Lake 是数据湖仓领域的热门格式，delta-rs 提供了高性能的 Rust 原生实现，吸引了 3270 颗星，尤其受 Rust 和数据工程社区关注。
uses: 数据工程师 —— 在 Rust 或 Python 环境中直接操作 Delta Lake 表，无需 Spark
平台开发者 —— 将 Delta Lake 集成到自己的数据工具或引擎中
性能敏感场景 —— 利用 Rust 的高性能处理大规模 Delta Lake 数据

en.tag: Native Rust library for Delta Lake with Python bindings
en.what: delta-rs is a native Rust library for Delta Lake with Python bindings, enabling direct read, write, and management of Delta Lake tables without Apache Spark.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust core library (deltalake on crates.io) and a Python package (deltalake on PyPI), offering low-level APIs for developers and high-level operations API for querying and managing Delta Lake.
en.stack: Tech stack: Rust core with Python bindings via PyO3, leveraging Arrow and Parquet formats.
en.hot: Delta Lake is a popular format in data lakehouse, and delta-rs offers a high-performance Rust native implementation, attracting 3270 stars, especially from Rust and data engineering communities.
uses: Data engineers — directly manipulate Delta Lake tables in Rust or Python without Spark
Platform developers — integrate Delta Lake into custom data tools or engines
Performance-sensitive scenarios — leverage Rust's high performance for large-scale Delta Lake data

zh.tag: 高颜值现代化终端文件管理器

跨平台工作者 —— 在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 间寻求一致的文件管理体验

en.tag: A fancy, modern terminal file manager with rich TUI
en.what: superfile is a terminal-based file manager that delivers a modern, fancy TUI interface, allowing developers to browse, preview, and manipulate files without leaving the command line. DevOps and system administrators who need to quickly browse, edit, and manage files on remote servers
Aesthetics-minded developers looking for modern UI, rich themes, and customization in terminal tools
Cross-platform workers seeking a consistent file management experience across macOS, Linux, and Windows

zh.tag: 微软用 Go 原生重写 TypeScript 编译器，迈向高性能 TS 7
zh.what: 这是 TypeScript 编译器的原生 Go 语言移植版，目标是用原生性能替代现有的 TypeScript-on-JavaScript 架构。它将成为 TypeScript 7 的核心基础，最终合并回主仓库。目前大部分核心功能（解析、类型检查、代码生成等）已实现，并提供可预览的 npm 包和 VS Code 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的编译器管线实现（扫描、解析、类型解析与检查、声明和 JS 输出），以及 LSP 语言服务原型和命令行工具链。开发者可通过 npm 安装 `@typescript/native-preview` 使用 `tsgo` 命令，或在 VS Code 中安装预览版扩展体验。
zh.stack: 整体以 Go 语言原生实现编译器核心，兼顾跨平台性能；通过 npm 分发预览包并提供 Node.js 可用的 CLI 封装，同时配套发布 VS Code 扩展以集成语言服务。
zh.hot: 作为 TypeScript 生态的基石级重写，该项目在 GitHub 已斩获 25.9k Star，本周新增 110 Star 并冲入 Go 语言周榜第 3 名，社区高度关注编译速度可能带来的数量级提升。
uses: 前端/全栈开发者 —— 希望在大型代码库中获得更快的类型检查和编译速度。
TypeScript 工具链贡献者 —— 关注编译器架构迁移与 Go 实现细节，提前适配 TS 7。
VS Code 用户 —— 想抢先体验基于原生编译器的语言服务与实时反馈。
基础设施团队 —— 评估将核心开发工具从 JavaScript 运行时迁移到原生二进制的影响。

en.tag: Microsoft's Go rewrite of the TypeScript compiler for high-performance TS 7
en.what: This is a native Go port of the TypeScript compiler, aiming to replace the existing TypeScript-on-JavaScript architecture with native performance. It will serve as the foundation for TypeScript 7 and eventually merge back into the main TypeScript repository. Most core features like parsing, type checking, and emit are already implemented, with preview npm packages and a VS Code extension available.
en.content: The repo houses the full compiler pipeline (scanning, parsing, type resolution and checking, declaration and JS emit), plus an LSP language service prototype and CLI toolchain. TDD/BDD 实践者 —— 想用接近自然语言的断言和场景描述写测试
性能工程师 —— 需要集成微基准测试以追踪代码性能回归
开源库维护者 —— 寻求跨平台、 header-only（v2）或现代库形态（v3）的测试方案

en.tag: Modern C++-native unit-testing & micro-benchmarking framework for TDD/BDD
en.what: Catch2 is a modern, C++-native unit testing framework that also offers micro-benchmarking capabilities and basic BDD macros. It lets you write tests using natural C++ boolean expressions without cumbersome macro boilerplate.
en.content: The repository houses a multi-header library source, CMake build configs, CI workflows, and extensive docs. Starting with v3, it was restructured from a single-header library into a normal multi-file library with a dedicated benchmark module and test macro suite.
en.stack: Built on modern C++ (primarily C++14/17/20), uses CMake, supports cross-platform CI on Linux, macOS, and Windows, and offers Godbolt online playground integration.
en.hot: One of the most popular C++ testing frameworks with over 21k stars, Catch2 gained 769 stars this week and hit #7 on the GitHub C++ Trending list, signaling strong demand for lightweight, modern C++ testing tools.
uses: C++ developers looking to quickly integrate unit and regression tests
TDD/BDD practitioners who want natural-language-like assertions and scenario descriptions
Performance engineers needing built-in micro-benchmarking to track code regressions
Open-source maintainers seeking cross-platform testing in header-only (v2) or modern library (v3) form

zh.tag: C++ 微基准测试支持库，类似单元测试
zh.what: Google Benchmark 是一个用于对代码片段进行微基准测试的库，类似于单元测试框架。它帮助开发者测量小段代码的性能，并生成可重复的、精确的计时结果。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 头文件库、CMake 构建系统、示例代码、用户指南以及 Python 绑定等工具。核心功能是通过宏和状态对象注册基准测试函数，并自动运行和计时。
zh.stack: C++11 可用，C++17 构建；依赖 CMake 和 git；可选 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方维护的基准测试库，拥有 10301 颗星，是 C++ 性能测试的事实标准，稳定且广泛使用。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 对函数或算法进行性能基准测试
库作者 —— 确保代码变更不引入性能退化
性能工程师 —— 精确测量和比较代码执行时间

en.tag: A microbenchmark support library for C++, similar to unit tests
en.what: Google Benchmark is a library for microbenchmarking code snippets, similar to unit testing. It helps developers measure the performance of small code segments and produce repeatable, precise timing results.
en.content: The repository contains a C++ header-only library, CMake build system, examples, user guide, and Python bindings. Core functionality registers benchmark functions via macros and state objects, then automatically runs and times them.
en.stack: Usable with C++11, requires C++17 to build; depends on CMake and git; optional Python bindings.
en.hot: As Google's official benchmark library, it has 10301 stars and is the de facto standard for C++ performance testing, stable and widely used.
uses: C++ developers — benchmark functions or algorithms for performance
Library authors — ensure code changes don't introduce performance regressions
Performance engineers — precisely measure and compare code execution time

zh.tag: 跨平台 C++ 原生 GUI 框架
zh.what: wxWidgets 是一个免费开源、跨平台的 C++ 框架，用于编写使用原生控件的 GUI 应用程序。它支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 等主流桌面平台，并抽象了非 GUI 方面的差异。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、超过一百个示例以及构建脚本。支持多种编译器（MSVC、g++、Clang）和构建系统（CMake、make）。
zh.stack: 核心是 C++11 及以上标准，依赖原生平台工具包（GTK+、Cocoa、Win32 API）。构建系统支持 CMake 和传统 make。
zh.hot: 作为成熟的跨平台 GUI 库，持续维护且拥有大量用户，今日新增 3 星，总星数 7211，在 C++ 日榜排名第 20。
uses: C++ 桌面应用开发者 —— 需要跨平台原生 GUI 的开发者
开源项目维护者 —— 希望使用成熟、稳定且文档齐全的 GUI 框架
学习 C++ GUI 编程的学生 —— 有大量示例和文档

en.tag: Cross-Platform C++ Native GUI Framework
en.what: wxWidgets is a free and open-source cross-platform C++ framework for writing GUI applications using native controls. It supports major desktop platforms like Windows, macOS, and Linux, and abstracts non-GUI differences.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation, over a hundred examples, and build scripts. It supports multiple compilers (MSVC, g++, Clang) and build systems (CMake, make).
en.stack: Core is C++11 or later, relying on native platform toolkits (GTK+, Cocoa, Win32 API). Build system supports CMake and traditional make.
en.hot: As a mature cross-platform GUI library, it is continuously maintained with a large user base. Gained 3 stars today, total 7211, ranked 20th on C++ daily trending.
uses: C++ desktop application developers — needing cross-platform native GUI
Open-source project maintainers — wanting a mature, stable, well-documented GUI framework
Students learning C++ GUI programming — with many examples and documentation

zh.tag: DeepSeek 出品的高效多头潜在注意力内核库
zh.what: FlashMLA 是 DeepSeek 开发的高性能注意力机制内核库，为 DeepSeek-V3 和 V3.2-Exp 模型提供加速。它包含稀疏注意力（DSA）和密集注意力两种内核，覆盖预填充和解码阶段。
zh.content: 仓库包含稀疏注意力内核（支持 FP8 KV 缓存）和密集注意力内核，以及测试脚本和深度技术博客。
zh.stack: 基于 CUDA 12.8+，支持 NVIDIA H800 SXM5 和 B200 GPU，使用 FP8 和 bfloat16 混合精度。
zh.hot: 由 DeepSeek 官方发布，性能惊人（H800 上达 660 TFLOPS），且伴随 V3.2 模型发布，吸引大量关注。
uses: 大模型推理优化工程师 —— 加速 LLM 推理中的注意力计算
AI 框架开发者 —— 集成高效内核到训练/推理框架
高性能计算研究者 —— 学习稀疏注意力与 FP8 优化技术

en.tag: DeepSeek's optimized multi-head latent attention kernel library
en.what: FlashMLA is DeepSeek's library of optimized attention kernels, powering DeepSeek-V3 and V3.2-Exp models. It includes sparse (DSA) and dense attention kernels for both prefill and decoding stages.
en.content: The repo contains sparse attention kernels (with FP8 KV cache), dense attention kernels, test scripts, and deep-dive technical blogs.
en.stack: Built on CUDA 12.8+, targeting NVIDIA H800 SXM5 and B200 GPUs, using FP8 and bfloat16 mixed precision.
en.hot: Official release from DeepSeek with stunning performance (up to 660 TFLOPS on H800) and tied to the V3.2 model launch, driving massive interest.
uses: LLM inference optimization engineers — accelerate attention computation in LLM inference
AI framework developers — integrate efficient kernels into training/inference frameworks
HPC researchers — study sparse attention and FP8 optimization techniques

zh.tag: Facebook开源的高性能C++20基础组件库
zh.what: Folly 是 Facebook 开发并广泛使用的开源 C++20 组件库，专注于提供实用且高效的基础工具。它承载了 Meta 内部大量 C++ 项目的共享代码，并针对大规模场景下的极致性能进行了深度优化。
zh.content: 仓库采用扁平的 folly/ 目录结构，存放各类相对独立的头文件与实现模块；同时包含 experimental、test 与 docs 子目录，分别存放内部实验性组件、单元测试及项目文档。
zh.stack: 基于 C++20 标准构建，与 Boost 及标准库互补而非竞争，仅在既有方案无法满足性能或功能需求时才提供替代实现。
zh.hot: 作为 Facebook C++ 生态的基石项目，Folly 已累计获得 30.4k+ Stars，本月新增 87 Stars 并跻身 GitHub C++ 月榜第 21 位，是高性能系统开发领域广泛认可的基础设施库。
uses: 大规模后端 C++ 开发者 —— 需要高性能基础组件来替代标准库或 Boost 的不足之处
基础设施/中间件团队 —— 构建高并发、低延迟系统时可复用其锁、字符串与内存工具
开源 C++ 项目维护者 —— 希望引入经过 Meta 生产环境长期验证的工业级基础库

en.tag: Facebook's open-source high-performance C++20 core components library
en.what: Folly is an open-source C++20 components library developed and widely used at Meta, designed for practicality and efficiency. It serves as foundational shared code for many of Facebook's C++ projects, with deep performance optimizations targeting large-scale infrastructure.
en.content: The repository follows a flat folly/ directory layout containing relatively independent headers and implementation modules, alongside experimental, test, and docs subdirectories for internal prototypes, unit tests, and project documentation.
en.stack: Built on C++20, it complements rather than competes with Boost and the standard library, providing alternative implementations only when existing solutions fail to meet required performance or functionality profiles.
en.hot: As a cornerstone of Facebook's C++ ecosystem, Folly has accumulated over 30.4k stars, gaining 87 this month and ranking 21st on GitHub's C++ monthly trending list, making it a widely recognized infrastructure library for high-performance systems.
uses: Large-scale backend C++ developers who need high-performance primitives to fill gaps left by the standard library or Boost
Infrastructure and middleware teams building high-concurrency, low-latency systems and reusing its locks, strings, and memory utilities
Open-source C++ maintainers seeking to adopt production-hardened, industrial-grade foundational libraries validated at Meta

zh.tag: ROS 2 导航框架与系统
zh.what: Navigation2 是 ROS 2 的官方导航框架，为移动机器人提供路径规划、控制、定位、行为树等完整导航功能。它支持多种机器人平台，是 ROS 生态中机器人自主导航的核心基础设施。
zh.content: 仓库包含导航系统的核心库、插件（如规划器、控制器、恢复行为）、配置工具、教程文档以及 Docker 容器支持。代码以 C++ 编写，提供丰富的 API 和可扩展插件接口。
zh.stack: 基于 ROS 2 框架，依赖 C++ 标准库和 ROS 2 核心包（如 rclcpp、nav_msgs），支持多种规划与控制算法插件。
zh.hot: 作为 ROS 2 导航的官方实现，拥有 4505 颗星，是机器人领域最受关注的导航项目之一。尽管今日新增星数不多，但其在 C++ 日榜排名第 12，体现了持续稳定的社区关注度。
uses: ROS 2 机器人开发者 —— 快速集成自主导航功能
移动机器人研究 —— 测试和验证导航算法
工业自动化 —— 部署 AGV/AMR 导航系统
教育学习 —— 学习机器人导航原理与实践

en.tag: ROS 2 Navigation Framework and System
en.what: Navigation2 is the official navigation framework for ROS 2, providing complete navigation capabilities for mobile robots including path planning, control, localization, and behavior trees. It supports various robot platforms and is the core infrastructure for autonomous navigation in the ROS ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains core libraries, plugins (e.g., planners, controllers, recovery behaviors), configuration tools, tutorial documentation, and Docker container support. The code is written in C++ with extensive APIs and extensible plugin interfaces.
en.stack: Built on ROS 2 framework, depends on C++ standard library and ROS 2 core packages (e.g., rclcpp, nav_msgs), supports multiple planning and control algorithm plugins.
en.hot: As the official navigation implementation for ROS 2, it has 4505 stars and is one of the most watched navigation projects in robotics. Although today's new stars are few, its rank #12 on C++ daily trending reflects sustained community interest.
uses: ROS 2 robot developers — quickly integrate autonomous navigation
Mobile robotics researchers — test and validate navigation algorithms
Industrial automation — deploy AGV/AMR navigation systems
Education — learn robot navigation principles and practice

zh.tag: 生产级客户端系统追踪与性能分析套件
zh.what: Perfetto 是一套开源的追踪、性能分析和 trace 分析工具，帮助开发者理解复杂系统行为并定位功能和性能问题。它是 Android 和 Chromium 的默认追踪系统。
zh.content: 包含高性能追踪守护进程、低开销 C++17 SDK、丰富的 OS 级探针（如调度、CPU 频率、内存分析）、基于浏览器的可视化 UI 以及 SQL 分析引擎。
zh.stack: 核心组件用 C++ 编写，依赖 protobuf 序列化，前端为 WebAssembly 应用，支持 SQLite 查询。
zh.hot: 作为 Android 和 Chromium 的官方追踪工具，Perfetto 拥有庞大用户基础，今日新增 4 星，总星数 6274，在 C++ 日榜排名第 13。
uses: Android 应用和平台开发者：调试启动慢、掉帧、内存泄漏等问题
C/C++ 开发者：使用 Tracing SDK 自定义追踪点，分析性能瓶颈
Linux 内核开发者：通过 ftrace 集成深入分析调度、系统调用等
性能工程师：使用 SQL 接口分析多种 trace 格式（如 Linux perf、Chrome JSON）

en.tag: Production-grade client-side tracing, profiling, and analysis suite
en.what: Perfetto is an open-source suite for tracing, profiling, and trace analysis, helping developers understand complex system behavior and root-cause functional and performance issues. It is the default tracing system for Android and Chromium.
en.content: Includes high-performance tracing daemons, low-overhead C++17 SDK, extensive OS-level probes (e.g., scheduling, CPU freq, memory profiling), browser-based UI, and SQL-based analysis engine.
en.stack: Core components in C++, uses protobuf for serialization, frontend is a WebAssembly app, supports SQLite queries.
en.hot: As the official tracing tool for Android and Chromium, Perfetto has a massive user base, gaining 4 stars today with 6274 total, ranking 13th on C++ daily trending.
uses: Android app & platform developers: debug slow startups, jank, memory issues
C/C++ developers: instrument custom trace points with SDK to find bottlenecks
Linux kernel developers: deep kernel insights via ftrace integration
Performance engineers: analyze multiple trace formats (Linux perf, Chrome JSON) with SQL

zh.tag: 内存高效的跨平台序列化库
zh.what: FlatBuffers 是一个跨平台的序列化库，旨在实现最大内存效率。它允许直接访问序列化数据而无需先解析/解包，同时保持出色的向前/向后兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 flatc 编译器、多种语言的运行时库、示例代码（如 monster.fbs 模式文件）以及完整的文档。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，支持 C、C++、C#、Dart、Go、Java、JavaScript、Kotlin、Lobster、Lua、PHP、Python、Rust、Swift、TypeScript 等语言。依赖 CMake 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 出品的高效序列化方案，FlatBuffers 在游戏、移动端和实时系统中有广泛应用，26k+ Stars 体现了其稳定性和社区认可度。
uses: 游戏开发 —— 需要低延迟、零拷贝读取数据
移动应用 —— 减少内存占用和启动时间
嵌入式系统 —— 资源受限环境下的高效序列化

en.tag: Memory-efficient cross-platform serialization library
en.what: FlatBuffers is a cross-platform serialization library architected for maximum memory efficiency. It allows direct access to serialized data without parsing/unpacking first, while maintaining excellent forwards/backwards compatibility.
en.content: The repository includes the flatc compiler, runtime libraries for multiple languages, sample code (e.g., monster.fbs schema), and comprehensive documentation.
en.stack: Core written in C++, with support for C, C++, C#, Dart, Go, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin, Lobster, Lua, PHP, Python, Rust, Swift, TypeScript, etc. Build via CMake.
en.hot: As Google's efficient serialization solution, FlatBuffers is widely used in gaming, mobile, and real-time systems. Its 26k+ Stars reflect stability and community trust.
uses: Game development — requires low-latency, zero-copy data access
Mobile apps — reduces memory footprint and startup time
Embedded systems — efficient serialization in resource-constrained environments

zh.tag: 现代C++高性能实体组件系统（ECS）库
zh.what: EnTT 是一个轻量级、头文件库，提供实体组件系统（ECS）架构，用于游戏开发和其他需要高性能数据管理的场景。它支持运行时类型擦除、多线程和自定义分配器，被 Minecraft 和 ArcGIS 等知名项目采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 ECS 核心实现、信号/调度器、资源管理、序列化支持等模块，所有代码均为头文件形式，无需编译。提供丰富的文档、示例和基准测试。
zh.stack: 纯 C++17 实现，无外部依赖，仅需支持 C++17 的编译器。
zh.hot: EnTT 已积累 12942 星，因其在游戏开发中的高性能和易用性而广受赞誉。今日新增 8 星，持续活跃。
uses: 游戏开发者 —— 构建高性能实体系统，如 Minecraft 中的实体管理
C++ 学习者 —— 学习现代 C++ 设计模式和 ECS 架构
仿真与可视化应用 —— 需要高效数据管理的场景

en.tag: A fast and reliable header-only ECS library for modern C++
en.what: EnTT is a header-only, tiny library for game programming and beyond, offering a fast and reliable entity-component system (ECS) with runtime type erasure, multi-threading support, and custom allocators. It is used by Minecraft and ArcGIS Runtime SDKs.
en.content: The repository includes core ECS components, signals/dispatcher, resource management, serialization support, all as header-only files. It also provides extensive documentation, examples, and benchmarks.
en.stack: Pure C++17 implementation, no external dependencies, requires a C++17-compliant compiler.
en.hot: With 12,942 stars, EnTT is widely praised for its performance and ease of use in game development. It gained 8 stars today, showing steady activity.
uses: Game developers — for high-performance entity management, e.g., Minecraft
C++ learners — to study modern C++ design patterns and ECS architecture
Simulation and visualization apps — scenarios requiring efficient data management

zh.tag: 免费开源的量化金融 C++ 库
zh.what: QuantLib 是一个为量化金融提供全面软件框架的免费开源库，涵盖建模、交易和风险管理。它被广泛应用于金融行业，支持多种金融工具和定价模型。

金融软件开发者 —— 集成到交易或风控系统中

en.tag: Free/open-source C++ library for quantitative finance
en.what: QuantLib is a free/open-source library providing a comprehensive software framework for quantitative finance, including modeling, trading, and risk management. It is widely used in the financial industry, supporting various financial instruments and pricing models.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source code of the QuantLib library, build scripts (supporting Linux/Windows/Mac OS), test suites, and documentation links.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation, depends on Boost libraries, supports CMake build system.
en.hot: As one of the most well-known open-source libraries in quantitative finance, QuantLib consistently attracts attention from finance professionals and researchers, gaining 10 stars today with a total of 7409 stars.

Financial engineering students — learning and researching quantitative finance algorithms
Researchers — validating new financial models or strategies

zh.tag: 每秒解析数GB JSON的高性能解析库
zh.what: simdjson 是一个利用 SIMD 指令和微并行算法实现超高速 JSON 解析的 C++ 库。它比 RapidJSON 快 4 倍以上，比 JSON for Modern C++ 快 25 倍，同时保持完整的 JSON 和 UTF-8 验证。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心解析器、API 文档、性能基准测试、绑定和移植（如 Python、JavaScript、Rust 等），以及 CMake 构建系统。
zh.stack: C++17，依赖 SIMD 指令集（如 SSE4.2、AVX2、AVX-512、NEON），可选 CMake 构建。
zh.hot: 被 Node.js、ClickHouse、Meta Velox 等重量级项目采用，性能卓越且持续更新，今日新增 39 星，总星数超 2.4 万。
uses: 需要极速 JSON 解析的数据库和存储引擎（如 ClickHouse、Doris）
高性能网络服务与 API 网关（如 Node.js、WasmEdge）
数据分析和 ETL 管道（如 Velox、Pax）
移动端或嵌入式场景（如 WatermelonDB）

en.tag: Parsing gigabytes of JSON per second with SIMD
en.what: simdjson is a C++ library that leverages SIMD instructions and microparallel algorithms to parse JSON at blazing speeds—over 4x faster than RapidJSON and 25x faster than JSON for Modern C++. It maintains full JSON and UTF-8 validation with lossless parsing.
en.content: The repo includes the core parser, API documentation, performance benchmarks, bindings and ports (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Rust), and a CMake build system.
en.stack: C++17, depends on SIMD instruction sets (SSE4.2, AVX2, AVX-512, NEON), optional CMake build.
en.hot: Adopted by major projects like Node.js, ClickHouse, and Meta Velox; exceptional performance and active maintenance; gained 39 stars today, 24k+ total.
uses: Databases and storage engines needing ultra-fast JSON parsing (e.g., ClickHouse, Doris)
High-performance web services and API gateways (e.g., Node.js, WasmEdge)
Data analytics and ETL pipelines (e.g., Velox, Pax)
Mobile or embedded scenarios (e.g., WatermelonDB)

en.hot: With an out-of-the-box, pain-free cross-device transfer experience, croc has earned 35.6K stars, gaining 167 this week and hitting #20 on GitHub's Go Trending chart. It fills the gap between tedious scp/rsync setup and instant tools that lack encryption.

uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 极致美观的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器
zh.what: Hyprland 是一个独立、高度可定制、动态平铺的 Wayland 合成器，注重外观而不牺牲功能。它提供最新的 Wayland 特性、丰富的视觉效果（渐变边框、模糊、动画、阴影等）、强大的插件系统、内置插件管理器、撕裂支持（提升游戏性能）等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hyprland 合成器的完整源代码、文档链接、安装指南、配置示例和画廊展示。代码库以 C++ 编写，易于扩展和阅读。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，不依赖 wlroots、libweston、kwin 或 mutter，完全独立实现。依赖 Wayland 协议和相关库。
zh.hot: 凭借出色的视觉效果和高度可定制性，Hyprland 在 Linux 桌面用户中广受欢迎，Star 数达 36,817，今日新增 24，持续活跃开发。
uses: Linux 桌面用户 —— 追求美观、高效、可定制的平铺窗口管理体验
Wayland 爱好者 —— 希望体验最新 Wayland 特性的用户
开发者 —— 对合成器实现感兴趣，或希望为其开发插件的开发者

en.tag: A highly customizable dynamic tiling Wayland compositor with stunning visuals
en.what: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks. It offers the latest Wayland features, extensive eye candy (gradient borders, blur, animations, shadows), a powerful plugin system, built-in plugin manager, tearing support for better gaming performance, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Hyprland compositor, documentation links, installation guides, configuration examples, and a gallery. The codebase is written in C++ and is designed to be easily expandable and readable.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, Hyprland is fully independent and does not rely on wlroots, libweston, kwin, or mutter. It depends on Wayland protocols and related libraries.
en.hot: With its stunning visuals and high customizability, Hyprland has gained immense popularity among Linux desktop users, amassing 36,817 stars (24 new today) and maintaining active development.
uses: Linux desktop users — seeking a beautiful, efficient, and customizable tiling window management experience
Wayland enthusiasts — users wanting to experience the latest Wayland features
Developers — interested in compositor implementation or developing plugins for Hyprland

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室，集克隆、合成与听写于一体
zh.what: Voicebox 是一款本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室，集语音克隆、文本转语音与实时语音输入于一体。它能够在本地运行 7 种 TTS 引擎，支持 23 种语言的语音合成，并通过全局热键向任意文本框听写。此外，它还能为 MCP 兼容的 AI 智能体赋予自定义语音，实现完整的语音输入输出闭环。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 TypeScript 的桌面应用源码、7 套 TTS 引擎的本地集成、语音克隆与听写核心模块，以及配套落地页与文档站点。
zh.stack: 主技术栈为 TypeScript，构建跨平台桌面应用；依赖本地运行的 LLM 进行语音文本优化，并集成 7 种 TTS 引擎与语音克隆模型实现完整语音 I/O。
zh.hot: 在 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow 等云端方案之外，Voicebox 以完全本地运行和隐私保护击中用户痛点，月增 12,138 Star 达 42,229 颗，跻身 TypeScript 月榜第 8。它一次性覆盖语音克隆、合成与听写全链路，降低了创作者与开发者对闭源语音服务的依赖。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 快速克隆音色并生成多语言旁白，无需依赖云端付费 API。
隐私敏感用户 —— 语音数据完全本地处理，适合对数据安全有较高要求的个人与企业。
AI 开发者 —— 为 MCP 智能体快速接入自定义语音，构建具备语音交互能力的本地应用。
效率办公人群 —— 通过全局热键向任意文本框实时语音输入，替代传统键盘录入。

en.tag: Local-first open-source AI voice studio for cloning, synthesis and dictation
en.what: Voicebox is a local-first, open-source AI voice studio that combines voice cloning, text-to-speech, and real-time dictation in one app. It runs seven TTS engines locally for speech synthesis across 23 languages, and lets you dictate into any text field via a global hotkey. It also gives MCP-aware AI agents a custom voice, closing the full voice I/O loop on your machine.
en.content: The repository contains the TypeScript-based desktop application source, integrations for seven local TTS engines, voice-cloning and dictation modules, plus a landing site and documentation.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript as a cross-platform desktop app; it relies on a bundled local LLM for speech refinement and integrates seven TTS engines plus voice-cloning models for complete on-device voice I/O.
en.hot: Hitting a pain point against cloud incumbents like ElevenLabs and WisprFlow, Voicebox offers fully local, privacy-preserving voice I/O; it gained 12,138 stars this month to reach 42,229, ranking 8th on the TypeScript monthly trending list. Its all-in-one coverage of cloning, synthesis, and dictation lowers reliance on proprietary voice services for creators and developers.
uses: Content creators — quickly clone voices and generate multilingual narrations without cloud APIs.
Privacy-conscious users — process all voice data locally for individuals and enterprises with strict data-security needs.
AI developers — give MCP-compatible agents custom voices to build locally running voice-interactive applications.
Productivity-focused users — dictate into any text field via a global hotkey as a keyboard alternative.

zh.tag: 给设计工程师准备的一套 UI 类 Agent Skills
zh.what: 知名设计工程师 ibelick 出品的 UI 技能包集合：让 AI 编码 agent 按任务自动走对应的 UI 技能流程，跑一行 npx ui-skills start 就能把 agent 路由到合适的技能集。
zh.content: skills/ 目录下 6 个技能：baseline-ui、improve-ui、fixing-accessibility、fixing-metadata、fixing-motion-performance、ui-skills-root；另有 bin/（CLI 入口）和配套网站（Astro + Cloudflare Workers）。
zh.stack: TypeScript，CLI 走 npx 分发，MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，官网 ui-skills.com。
zh.hot: 把设计判断封装成 AI Agent 可复用技能，这一思路对设计工程师直观易懂，也便于立刻试用。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 让 agent 按设计规范生成和改进 UI，告别「能跑但丑」
设计工程师 —— 把无障碍、metadata、动效性能检查自动化
独立开发者 —— 一人兼顾开发和设计时的品味兜底

en.tag: A set of UI Agent Skills for design engineers
en.what: A UI skill-pack collection from well-known design engineer ibelick: routes your AI coding agent through the right UI skill workflow per task — run npx ui-skills start and the agent picks the appropriate skill set.
en.content: Six skills under skills/: baseline-ui, improve-ui, fixing-accessibility, fixing-metadata, fixing-motion-performance and ui-skills-root; plus bin/ (the CLI entry) and the companion site (Astro on Cloudflare Workers).
en.stack: TypeScript, CLI distributed via npx, MIT; created January 2026, site at ui-skills.com.
en.hot: The idea of packaging design judgment as reusable skills for AI agents is easy for design engineers to understand and immediately test.
uses: Frontend developers — let agents generate and improve UI to design standards, no more 'works but ugly'
Design engineers — automate accessibility, metadata and motion-performance checks
Indie hackers — a taste safety net when you cover both dev and design

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的开源生成式BI引擎
zh.what: WrenAI 是一个开源的生成式 BI（GenBI）引擎，让 AI 代理能够通过自然语言生成可信的仪表盘、图表和 SQL 查询。它通过开放的上下文层将自然语言问题转化为受治理的 SQL，支持 20+ 数据源。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GenBI 引擎核心代码、上下文层实现、以及用于部署和管理的 CLI 工具。还包含 Wren Engine 的合并代码和旧版 GenBI Classic 分支。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 开发，依赖 PostgreSQL、DuckDB 等数据库，支持 BigQuery、Snowflake 等多种数据源。
zh.hot: 日增 321 星，总星数 16451，因其为 AI 代理提供可信的 BI 能力，解决了自然语言到 SQL 的治理问题。
uses: AI 代理开发者 —— 集成 GenBI 能力，让代理自主生成仪表盘
数据分析师 —— 通过自然语言快速探索数据，生成受治理的 SQL
企业 BI 团队 —— 部署可治理的 BI 平台，支持多数据源

en.tag: Open-source GenBI engine for AI agents to generate, deploy, and govern dashboards
en.what: WrenAI is an open-source GenBI engine that enables AI agents to generate, deploy, and govern business intelligence from natural language. It uses an open context layer to turn questions into governed SQL, supporting 20+ data sources.
en.content: The repo contains the GenBI engine core, context layer implementation, CLI tools for deployment and management, merged Wren Engine code, and a legacy branch for GenBI Classic.
en.stack: Built with Python, relies on PostgreSQL, DuckDB, and supports data sources like BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.
en.hot: Gained 321 stars today, total 16451, because it provides trustworthy BI for AI agents, solving governance in text-to-SQL.
uses: AI agent developers — integrate GenBI for autonomous dashboard generation
Data analysts — explore data via natural language with governed SQL
Enterprise BI teams — deploy a governed BI platform across multiple data sources

zh.tag: CPU-GPU异构大模型推理与微调框架
zh.what: KTransformers 是一个专注于通过 CPU-GPU 异构计算实现大语言模型高效推理与微调的研究项目。它提供高性能的 kt-kernel 内核，支持多种前沿模型（如 DeepSeek-V4、MiniMax-M3、GLM-5.2 等）的快速部署和定制化微调。
zh.content: 仓库包含 kt-kernel 推理引擎、SFT 微调脚本、多模型教程（如 MiniMax-M3、GLM-5.2、DeepSeek-V4 等），以及 CPU-GPU 专家调度、BF16/FP8 精度支持等优化模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 和 C++/CUDA 内核，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers 等深度学习框架，支持 AVX2 及更高指令集的 CPU 后端。
zh.hot: 凭借对最新模型（如 MiniMax-M3、GLM-5.2）的 Day0 支持以及 CPU-GPU 异构推理的显著性能优势，KTransformers 在 GitHub 上迅速获得 18755 星，日增 458 星，位列日榜第 7。
uses: AI 研究员和开发者 —— 在消费级硬件上高效推理和微调最新大模型
需要快速部署前沿模型（如 DeepSeek-V4、MiniMax-M3）的团队
对 CPU-GPU 异构计算优化感兴趣的系统工程师
希望低成本进行大模型 SFT 微调的个人或小团队

en.tag: A flexible framework for heterogeneous LLM inference and fine-tuning
en.what: KTransformers is a research project focused on efficient inference and fine-tuning of large language models through CPU-GPU heterogeneous computing. It provides a high-performance kt-kernel that supports rapid deployment and customized fine-tuning of cutting-edge models like DeepSeek-V4, MiniMax-M3, GLM-5.2, etc.
en.content: The repo includes the kt-kernel inference engine, SFT fine-tuning scripts, tutorials for multiple models (e.g., MiniMax-M3, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4), and optimization modules like CPU-GPU expert scheduling, BF16/FP8 precision support.
en.stack: Built with Python and C++/CUDA kernels, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and other deep learning frameworks; supports CPU backends with AVX2 or higher instruction sets.
en.hot: With Day0 support for the latest models (e.g., MiniMax-M3, GLM-5.2) and significant performance advantages in CPU-GPU heterogeneous inference, KTransformers has rapidly gained 18,755 stars on GitHub, adding 458 stars daily and ranking 7th on the daily trending list.
uses: AI researchers and developers — efficiently infer and fine-tune the latest LLMs on consumer hardware
Teams needing rapid deployment of cutting-edge models like DeepSeek-V4, MiniMax-M3
System engineers interested in CPU-GPU heterogeneous computing optimizations
Individuals or small teams looking for low-cost SFT fine-tuning of large models

zh.tag: 多平台 AI 代理助手与开发框架
zh.what: AstrBot 是一个集成了多种即时通讯平台、大语言模型、插件和 AI 功能的 AI 代理助手与开发框架。它可以作为 OpenClaw 的替代品，帮助用户构建和管理 AI 驱动的自动化工作流。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的源代码、文档、多语言 README（中、英、日、法、西、俄）、Docker 部署配置以及丰富的插件示例。项目采用模块化架构，支持快速扩展。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+ 开发，依赖主流 LLM API（如 OpenAI、Claude）、IM 平台 SDK（如 QQ、Telegram、Discord）以及插件系统。
zh.hot: 凭借 37K+ Stars 和每日 300+ 新增，AstrBot 因提供一站式多平台 AI 代理解决方案而备受关注，尤其作为 OpenClaw 的替代品吸引了大量开发者。
uses: 开发者 —— 快速搭建跨平台 AI 聊天机器人或自动化助手
AI 爱好者 —— 集成多种 LLM 和插件，探索 AI 代理能力
企业团队 —— 利用 AstrBot 构建内部 AI 工作流，替代商业工具

en.tag: Multi-platform AI agent assistant & dev framework
en.what: AstrBot is an AI agent assistant and development framework that integrates multiple IM platforms, LLMs, plugins, and AI features. It can serve as an alternative to OpenClaw, helping users build and manage AI-driven automation workflows.
en.content: The repository includes full source code, documentation, multilingual READMEs (Chinese, English, Japanese, French, Spanish, Russian), Docker deployment configs, and rich plugin examples. The project uses a modular architecture for easy extensibility.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.12+, relies on mainstream LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude), IM platform SDKs (e.g., QQ, Telegram, Discord), and a plugin system.
en.hot: With 37K+ stars and 300+ daily additions, AstrBot gains attention for its all-in-one multi-platform AI agent solution, especially as an OpenClaw alternative, attracting many developers.
uses: Developers — quickly build cross-platform AI chatbots or automation assistants
AI enthusiasts — integrate multiple LLMs and plugins to explore agent capabilities
Enterprise teams — leverage AstrBot to build internal AI workflows, replacing commercial tools

zh.tag: 统一语义元数据交换的开放标准
zh.what: Apache Ossie 是一个行业范围的规范，旨在标准化跨分析、AI 和 BI 平台的语义元数据交换方式，提供厂商中立的单一语义数据源。它解决了不同工具间同一指标定义不一致、团队手动协调定义耗时、AI 代理因业务逻辑不一致而产生不可靠输出等问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心规范（spec.md）、机器可读的 schema（spec.yaml、osi-schema.json）、参考转换器（支持 dbt、GoodData、Polaris、Salesforce 等格式）、示例语义模型（含完整 TPC-DS 模型）以及验证工具。
zh.stack: 基于 JSON 和 YAML 的规范，Python 实现参考转换器和验证工具。
zh.hot: 本周新增 827 星，总星数 1428，增长迅猛。数据栈碎片化是普遍痛点，Ossie 作为 Apache 孵化项目，提供了厂商中立的统一方案，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 数据平台团队 —— 统一不同 BI 工具和分析平台的语义层，减少数据定义冲突
AI 代理开发者 —— 确保 AI 代理基于一致的业务逻辑生成可靠输出
数据工程师/分析师 —— 通过标准格式交换语义模型，提升协作效率
工具厂商 —— 实现与 Ossie 的互操作，扩大生态兼容性

en.tag: Open standard for semantic metadata exchange across analytics, AI, and BI
en.what: Apache Ossie is an industry-wide specification effort to standardize how semantic metadata is exchanged across analytics, AI, and BI platforms, providing a vendor-neutral single source of truth for semantic data. It addresses issues like inconsistent KPI definitions across tools, time-consuming manual reconciliation, and unreliable AI agent outputs due to inconsistent business logic.
en.content: The repository contains the core specification (spec.md), machine-readable schema (spec.yaml, osi-schema.json), reference converters (to/from dbt, GoodData, Polaris, Salesforce, etc.), example semantic models (including a complete TPC-DS model), and validation tooling.
en.stack: JSON and YAML based specification, with Python implementations for reference converters and validation tools.
en.hot: Gained 827 stars this week, total 1428, rapid growth. Data stack fragmentation is a common pain point, and Ossie as an Apache incubating project offers a vendor-neutral unified solution, attracting significant attention.
uses: Data platform teams — unify semantic layer across different BI tools and analytics platforms, reduce data definition conflicts
AI agent developers — ensure AI agents produce reliable outputs based on consistent business logic
Data engineers/analysts — exchange semantic models in standard format, improve collaboration efficiency
Tool vendors — implement interoperability with Ossie, expand ecosystem compatibility

zh.tag: 一键部署本地 AI 服务器，集成推理、对话、Agent 与 RAG
zh.what: ODS 是一个本地 AI 服务器部署系统，能将你的 PC、Mac 或 Linux 设备变成功能齐全的私有 AI 服务器。它集成了大模型推理、类 ChatGPT 聊天界面、语音交互、智能代理、自动化工作流、RAG 检索增强生成以及图像生成等能力，无需依赖云端服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的安装脚本、服务编排（Docker Compose）、控制面板、CLI 工具、测试套件和运维文档。核心运行时位于 ods/ 目录下，提供一键安装脚本和模块化扩展。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 和 Docker Compose 构建，整合 Ollama、Open WebUI、n8n、ComfyUI 等开源组件，支持 GPU 加速和本地模型管理。

zh.tag: 流式3D重建的几何上下文Transformer基础模型
zh.what: LingBot-Map 是一个前馈式 3D 基础模型，能够从流式数据中实时重建三维场景。它通过几何上下文 Transformer 架构，在单一流式框架内统一了坐标定位、密集几何线索编码与长程漂移校正。

en.tag: Geometric Context Transformer for real-time streaming 3D reconstruction
en.what: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data in real time. It unifies coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction within a single streaming framework via its Geometric Context Transformer architecture.
en.content: The repo ships an interactive demo script (`demo.py`), an offline rendering pipeline, and evaluation benchmarks for KITTI and Oxford Spires, with pretrained weights hosted on both HuggingFace and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built in Python on PyTorch with a Transformer core, supporting both SDPA and FlashInfer backends to accelerate inference over extremely long sequences.
en.hot: Delivering stable ~20 FPS inference at 518×378 across sequences exceeding 10,000 frames, the project gained 4,765 stars this month, surpassing 12,000 total and hitting #18 on GitHub’s monthly Python Trending list.
uses: Autonomous driving & robotics teams — for real-time large-scale 3D mapping from continuous video streams.
AR/VR content creators — seeking efficient long-sequence geometric reconstruction and offline rendering for immersive experiences.
Computer-vision researchers — exploring streaming 3D foundation models, geometric Transformers, and long-range drift correction.
