en.what: FastMCP is a Python framework for building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and clients. en.tag: A methodology pipeline to distill books, videos and podcasts into executable AI agent skills
en.what: cangjie-skill is a RIA-TV++ pipeline that extracts actionable methodologies from long-form content—books, videos, podcasts—and structures them into reusable AI agent skills. Instead of generating simple summaries, it produces executable skill kits including skill maps, glossaries, stress tests, and installable modules for Claude Code and Cursor, bridging the gap between passive consumption and active execution.
en.content: The repo provides the RIA-TV++ implementation scripts and specifications across seven stages: Adler analysis, parallel extraction, triple verification, RIA++ structuring, Zettelkasten indexing, and stress testing. It ships with deliverable templates including BOOK_OVERVIEW.md, INDEX.md, DIGEST.md, GLOSSARY.md, individual SKILL.md modules, and test-prompts.json, forming a complete multi-skill repository.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python, it combines Mortimer Adler's analytical reading and the RIA note-taking method, relying on LLMs for parallel extraction and verification to produce skills compatible with Claude Code and Cursor; video workflows require the companion video-downloader skill for subtitle and audio transcription.
en.hot: Ranked #15 on GitHub Trending with 1,158 new stars this week and 3,558 total, it signals strong developer interest in moving from passive reading to executable agent skills. It directly addresses the "read-later graveyard" pain point by turning long-form content into callable agent toolkits, aligning with the current wave of AI agent engineering.
uses: Knowledge workers who want to convert methodologies from books, courses, and videos into callable AI tools
Engineers using Claude Code or Cursor who need to build reusable skill libraries for their teams

硬件评测者：使用内置基准测试测量真实 tok/s，并贡献结果到社区
普通用户：通过 TUI 轻松浏览和选择模型，无需手动配置

en.tag: One command to find which LLM models run on your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that automatically detects your hardware (RAM, CPU, GPU) and scores hundreds of models from various providers to find the best fit for your machine. It evaluates models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, offering both an interactive TUI and a classic CLI mode.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust core engine, TUI interface, CLI interface, and benchmarking & sharing features. It supports multi-GPU, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization selection, speed estimation, and integrates local runtimes like Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and LLM runtimes (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, Docker Model Runner, LM Studio).
en.hot: With nearly 30k stars and 247 new today, llmfit solves the pain point of hardware compatibility for local LLM deployment, recommending runnable models with one command and significantly reducing trial-and-error costs.
uses: AI developers: quickly find LLM models compatible with local hardware, avoiding download failures
Hardware reviewers: use built-in benchmarks to measure real tok/s and contribute results to the community
General users: easily browse and select models via TUI without manual configuration

zh.tag: Rust 全栈跨平台 UI 框架，一套代码覆盖 Web、桌面与移动端
zh.what: Dioxus 是一个基于 Rust 的全栈应用框架，开发者只需维护一套代码库即可构建 Web、桌面和移动应用。它提供了类似 React 的组件化开发体验，并内置基于 Signals 的状态管理、热重载与零配置启动能力。通过 Server Functions 还能直接在同一代码库中编写后端逻辑，实现真正的全栈开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 UI 库、跨平台渲染器（Web/桌面/移动端）、CLI 打包工具以及 Server Functions 全栈运行时。此外还提供了丰富的官方示例、文档站点和多语言 README，方便开发者快速上手。
zh.stack: 完全基于 Rust 生态，核心使用自研的 Virtual DOM 与 Signals 响应式系统，编译目标涵盖 WebAssembly、桌面端（基于 Winit/Tao）及移动端原生渲染。
zh.hot: 凭借 36.8K Star 的热度和本周 Rust 趋势榜第 18 名的成绩，Dioxus 吸引了大量希望用 Rust 替代 JavaScript 技术栈的开发者。其“一套代码、多端运行”的全栈能力，加上对热重载和零配置体验的重视，精准击中了 Rust 社区对高性能跨平台 UI 方案的强烈需求。
uses: Rust 开发者 —— 希望用单一代码库同时覆盖前端页面与桌面/移动原生应用的项目。
全栈工程师 —— 想在前端组件中直接调用 Server Functions，减少前后端语言切换成本的团队。
跨平台应用团队 —— 需要高性能、内存安全且拒绝 Electron 厚重方案的产品组。

en.tag: Rust fullstack cross-platform UI framework for web, desktop, and mobile
en.what: Dioxus is a Rust-based fullstack framework that lets developers build for the web, desktop, and mobile from a single codebase. It offers a React-like component model with zero-config setup, integrated hot-reloading, and signals-based state management. Server Functions enable backend logic to live alongside the UI, streamlining fullstack development in Rust.
en.content: The repo contains the core UI library, cross-platform renderers for web, desktop, and mobile, a CLI bundler, and a fullstack runtime for Server Functions. It also ships with extensive examples, documentation, and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built entirely on Rust, featuring a custom Virtual DOM and signals-based reactivity, compiling to WebAssembly, desktop (via Winit/Tao), and mobile native targets.
en.hot: With 36.8K stars and ranking 18th on this week's GitHub Rust Trending, Dioxus is drawing developers eager to replace JavaScript stacks with Rust. Its promise of a single codebase spanning web, desktop, and mobile—backed by hot-reload and zero-config DX—directly addresses the Rust community's demand for high-performance cross-platform UI solutions.
uses: Rust developers —— teams wanting a single codebase for web, desktop, and mobile apps without sacrificing performance.
Fullstack engineers —— those looking to colocate Server Functions with UI components to cut language-switching overhead.
Cross-platform product teams —— groups that need memory-safe, high-performance alternatives to heavy Electron-style solutions.

zh.tag: Jellyfin 非官方桌面客户端，基于 CEF 和 mpv
zh.what: Jellium Desktop 是一个非官方的 Jellyfin 桌面客户端，旨在提供比网页版更流畅、更原生的媒体播放体验。它利用 CEF 渲染界面，mpv 作为播放后端，支持跨平台运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端源码、构建脚本（支持 Linux AppImage/Flatpak、macOS DMG、Windows 安装包）以及开发工具链（just 任务运行器）。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Rust 主语言，CEF（Chromium Embedded Framework）用于 UI，mpv 用于视频播放，跨平台构建支持 Linux、macOS、Windows。
zh.hot: Jellyfin 用户对原生桌面客户端需求强烈，Jellium 凭借 CEF+mpv 的流畅体验和跨平台支持，上线即获 1400+ Star，今日新增 155，登顶 Rust 日榜第 4。
uses: Jellyfin 用户：需要比网页版更流畅、功能更丰富的桌面播放器
媒体中心爱好者：在 Linux/macOS/Windows 上统一管理并播放 Jellyfin 媒体库
Rust 开发者：学习如何结合 CEF 和 mpv 构建跨平台桌面应用

en.tag: Unofficial Jellyfin desktop client built on CEF and mpv
en.what: Jellium Desktop is an unofficial Jellyfin desktop client that offers a smoother, more native media playback experience than the web version. It uses CEF for UI rendering and mpv as the playback backend, with cross-platform support.
en.content: The repository includes full client source code, build scripts (Linux AppImage/Flatpak, macOS DMG, Windows packages), and a development toolchain (just command runner).
en.stack: Tech stack: Rust as the main language, CEF (Chromium Embedded Framework) for UI, mpv for video playback, cross-platform builds for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: Jellyfin users have a strong demand for native desktop clients. Jellium, with its smooth CEF+mpv experience and cross-platform support, quickly gained 1400+ stars, adding 155 today, ranking 4th on Rust daily trending.
uses: Jellyfin users: need a smoother, more feature-rich desktop player than the web version
Media center enthusiasts: manage and play Jellyfin media library uniformly on Linux/macOS/Windows
Rust developers: learn how to combine CEF and mpv to build cross-platform desktop apps

zh.tag: 一站式媒体下载与学习管理桌面应用
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款开源桌面应用，支持从 1800+ 网站下载视频、音频、课程和电子书，并内置 PDF/EPUB 阅读器、专注模式、带时间戳的笔记和间隔重复功能。无需命令行，无需 Python，开箱即用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，基于 Tauri + Rust + Svelte 构建，提供媒体下载、播放、阅读、笔记和插件系统。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Tauri（桌面框架）、Rust（后端）、Svelte（前端）、yt-dlp（媒体下载）、SQLite（本地存储）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 357 星，总星数 7277，位列 Rust 日榜第 10。其“一站式下载+学习”的定位精准解决了用户在多平台间切换的痛点，且完全免费开源。
uses: 在线课程学习者 —— 一键下载 Udemy、YouTube 等平台的课程视频和资料
媒体收藏爱好者 —— 从 1800+ 站点下载视频、音乐和电子书
高效学习者 —— 利用内置阅读器、笔记和间隔重复功能进行主动学习

en.tag: All-in-one desktop app for downloading, organizing and studying media
en.what: OmniGet is an open-source desktop app that downloads videos, audio, courses, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites, with built-in PDF/EPUB reader, focus mode, timestamped notes, and spaced repetition. No command line, no Python, just download and run.
en.content: The repo contains the full desktop app source code built with Tauri + Rust + Svelte, featuring media downloading, playback, reading, note-taking, and a plugin system.
en.stack: Tech stack: Tauri (desktop framework), Rust (backend), Svelte (frontend), yt-dlp (media downloading), SQLite (local storage).
en.hot: Gained 357 stars today, total 7277, ranked #10 in Rust daily trending. Its 'all-in-one download + study' positioning solves the pain of switching between platforms, and it's completely free and open-source.
uses: Online course learners — one-click download courses from Udemy, YouTube, and more
Media collectors — download videos, music, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites
Active learners — use built-in reader, notes, and spaced repetition for effective study

zh.tag: OpenAI 官方轻量级终端 AI 编码代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的终端原生 AI 编码代理，可在本地计算机上直接运行。它能理解自然语言指令，协助完成代码编写、重构、调试等任务。用户可通过 ChatGPT 账户或 API 密钥接入，无需离开终端即可进行智能开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Codex CLI 的 Rust 源码、跨平台编译构建脚本，以及支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 的预编译二进制发布。除终端版外，项目还指向 IDE 插件和云端 Codex Web 的入口。
zh.stack: 核心采用 Rust 开发，保证高性能与低资源占用；提供 curl、npm、Homebrew 等多种安装方式，支持通过 ChatGPT 账号或 OpenAI API 密钥进行身份验证。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方出品的终端编码工具，凭借 99.2k Stars 的超高人气和单日新增 328 Stars 的强劲势头，成功登顶 Rust 日榜第二。它将 AI 编程能力直接嵌入开发者最熟悉的终端环境，轻量且开源。
uses: 终端重度使用者 —— 希望在命令行中直接调用 AI 辅助编程的开发者
全栈工程师 —— 需要快速完成代码生成、重构与调试的敏捷开发场景
开源贡献者 —— 希望基于 Apache-2.0 协议研究或扩展 AI Agent 能力的工程师
ChatGPT 订阅用户 —— 想将现有 Plus/Pro/Edu 等计划权益延伸至本地开发环境

en.tag: OpenAI's official lightweight coding agent for your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a terminal-native AI coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your machine. It interprets natural language instructions to help write, refactor, and debug code without leaving your terminal. Users can authenticate via their ChatGPT plan or an OpenAI API key.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for Codex CLI, cross-platform build scripts, and precompiled binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It also points to IDE extensions and the cloud-based Codex Web agent.
en.stack: Core is built in Rust for high performance and low resource usage. It supports multiple installation methods including curl, npm, and Homebrew, and authenticates via ChatGPT accounts or OpenAI API keys.
en.hot: As an official OpenAI terminal coding tool, it commands massive attention with 99.2k Stars and 328 new Stars today, ranking second on the Rust daily trending list. It brings AI coding directly into the familiar terminal environment in a lightweight, open-source package.
uses: Terminal power users — developers who want AI assistance directly in their command line
Full-stack engineers — those needing rapid code generation, refactoring, and debugging
Open-source contributors — engineers looking to study or extend an Apache-2.0 AI agent
ChatGPT subscribers — users wanting to extend their Plus/Pro/Edu benefits to local development

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing

zh.tag: 终端原生 AI Agent 多路复用器，支持持久会话与插件扩展
zh.what: herdr 是一款驻扎在终端内的 Agent 多路复用器，让你能在一个界面中并行运行、监控多个 AI Agent 的状态。它支持会话分离与跨终端重连，Agent 脱离终端后仍可后台运行，并通过纯 Socket API 实现 Agent 之间的相互调用。同时支持键盘与鼠标双模式操作，以及可扩展的插件市场。
zh.content: 仓库主体为一个 Rust 编写的单二进制文件，无需 Electron 或 Node.js 环境，直接嵌入现有终端。核心包含窗格分割与状态可视化、会话持久化、插件系统、纯 Socket API，以及兼容 tmux 风格快捷键与鼠标点击的混合交互层。
zh.stack: 完全基于 Rust 构建，单二进制分发，零额外依赖。提供 curl / Homebrew / mise 等多种安装方式，并已推出 Windows Beta 版本。
zh.hot: 在 AI Agent 工具链需求井喷的节点，herdr 上线不到两周便收获 1.7 万+ Star，本周激增 2512 颗，冲入 Trending 周榜第 17。它用原生终端体验替代了笨重的 Electron 方案，以「Agent 多路复用 + 可编排 Socket API」精准解决了开发者同时管理多 Agent 的痛点。
uses: 终端重度用户/开发者 —— 需要在不离开终端的情况下并行管理多个 AI Agent 任务。
AI Agent 开发者 —— 需要构建、调试和编排 Agent 工作流，并让 Agent 之间互相通信。
远程/服务器开发者 —— 通过 SSH 断连重连，保持 Agent 长时间后台运行不中断。
插件生态爱好者 —— 希望通过插件扩展窗格和工作流，打造自定义终端 Agent 环境。

en.tag: Terminal-native AI agent multiplexer with persistent sessions and plugins
en.what: herdr is a terminal-native agent multiplexer that lets you run and monitor multiple AI agents in parallel from a single interface. Sessions can be detached and reattached from any terminal or over SSH, and agents themselves can orchestrate each other through a pure socket API. It supports both keyboard and mouse workflows, plus a plugin marketplace for extensibility.
en.content: The repo is built as a single Rust binary with no Electron or Node.js runtime, embedding directly into your existing terminal. It ships with core pane splitting and status visualization, persistent sessions, a plugin system, a pure socket API, and a hybrid interaction layer supporting both tmux-style keybindings and mouse actions.
en.stack: Written entirely in Rust and distributed as a single self-contained binary with zero extra dependencies. Installable via curl, Homebrew, and mise, with a Windows beta already available.
en.hot: Riding the wave of AI-agent tooling demand, herdr racked up 17.7k+ stars within weeks of launch, adding 2,512 this week alone and hitting #17 on GitHub Trending. It replaces heavy Electron wrappers with a native terminal experience and solves the pain of orchestrating multiple agents via its unique multiplexing and socket API.
uses: Terminal-heavy developers who need to run and monitor multiple AI agent tasks without leaving the terminal.
Agent developers who need to build, debug, and orchestrate agent workflows with inter-agent communication.
Remote/server developers who require persistent agent sessions that survive SSH disconnects and terminal restarts.
Plugin ecosystem enthusiasts looking to extend pane management and workflows through a customizable plugin marketplace.

zh.tag: AI 代理的增量数据引擎，保持上下文实时新鲜
zh.what: CocoIndex 是一个开源的增量索引框架，专为 AI 代理设计。它能够从代码库、Slack、会议记录等企业数据源持续同步数据，仅处理变更的增量部分，确保代理始终拥有最新的上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心引擎、Python SDK、多种数据连接器（如 Slack、Google Drive、Notion）以及转换模块（如文本分块、嵌入）。提供 CLI 和 Python API 用于定义和运行增量管道。
zh.stack: 主语言 Rust，提供 Python 绑定；依赖向量数据库（如 Pinecone、Weaviate）和 LLM 服务；使用 Apache Arrow 进行数据交换。
zh.hot: 本周新增 240 星，总星数 11044，位列 Rust 周榜第 19。AI 代理需要实时上下文，CocoIndex 的增量方案解决了 RAG 管道的核心痛点，因此受到开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者 —— 为代理构建实时更新的知识库，提升回答准确性和时效性
企业知识管理团队 —— 将内部文档、聊天记录等持续索引到向量数据库，用于内部搜索或问答
RAG 应用开发者 —— 替代传统全量索引，实现低延迟、低成本的增量数据管道

en.tag: Incremental sync engine for AI agents, keeping context always fresh
en.what: CocoIndex is an open-source incremental indexing framework for AI agents. It continuously syncs data from enterprise sources like codebases, Slack, and meeting notes, reprocessing only the delta on each change to keep agent context fresh.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust core engine, Python SDK, connectors for Slack, Google Drive, Notion, etc., and transformation modules like text chunking and embedding. It offers CLI and Python API to define and run incremental pipelines.
en.stack: Core in Rust with Python bindings; depends on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate) and LLM services; uses Apache Arrow for data interchange.
en.hot: Gained 240 stars this week, total 11,044, ranked #19 in Rust weekly trending. AI agents need real-time context, and CocoIndex's incremental approach addresses a core pain point in RAG pipelines, attracting developer interest.
uses: AI agent developers — build real-time updated knowledge bases for agents to improve accuracy and timeliness
Enterprise knowledge management teams — continuously index internal docs, chats into vector DB for search or Q&A
RAG application developers — replace full re-indexing with low-latency, cost-effective incremental pipelines

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘的 Node.js 包管理器
zh.what: pnpm 是一个快速且节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器。它通过内容可寻址存储来链接 node_modules 中的文件，从而避免重复下载，并支持 monorepo 和严格的依赖隔离。
zh.content: 仓库包含 pnpm CLI 的完整源代码，包括核心逻辑、锁文件处理、工作区支持以及实验性的 Rust 移植版本（pacquet）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，核心部分有 Rust 实验性实现。依赖 Node.js 生态，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS。
zh.hot: pnpm 凭借其极致的速度和磁盘效率，已成为大型 monorepo 项目的首选包管理器，拥有超过 35k 星标，本周新增 90 星，持续受到开发者青睐。
uses: Node.js 开发者，希望提升包安装速度和节省磁盘空间
维护大型 monorepo 项目的团队，需要高效的依赖管理
对严格依赖隔离有要求的项目，避免幽灵依赖问题

en.tag: Fast, disk space efficient Node.js package manager
en.what: pnpm is a fast, disk space efficient package manager for Node.js. It links files from a single content-addressable storage to avoid duplication, supports monorepos, and enforces strict dependency isolation.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the pnpm CLI, including core logic, lockfile handling, workspace support, and an experimental Rust port (pacquet).
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript with an experimental Rust port. Relies on Node.js ecosystem and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: With its exceptional speed and disk efficiency, pnpm has become the go-to package manager for large monorepos, boasting over 35k stars and 90 new stars this week, continuing to gain developer traction.
uses: Node.js developers seeking faster package installation and disk space savings
Teams managing large monorepo projects needing efficient dependency management
Projects requiring strict dependency isolation to avoid phantom dependencies

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: 魔法般的 shell 历史管理工具，支持加密同步
zh.what: Atuin 用 SQLite 数据库替代传统的 shell 历史记录，并记录命令的额外上下文（如退出码、执行时间、工作目录等）。它提供可选的端到端加密同步功能，让你在多台机器间共享历史记录。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的命令行工具、同步服务器、以及可选的加密同步服务。提供全屏搜索 UI、统计功能、快捷键绑定等。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 SQLite 数据库存储历史记录，支持加密同步（可选自建服务器或使用官方服务）。
zh.hot: 30k+ Stars 说明其解决了 shell 历史管理的核心痛点：跨设备同步、搜索效率、上下文记录。今日新增 30 Stars 保持热度。
uses: 开发者/运维人员 —— 需要跨多台机器同步和高效搜索 shell 历史
终端重度用户 —— 希望记录命令退出码、耗时等额外信息
隐私敏感用户 —— 需要端到端加密的历史同步方案

en.tag: Magical shell history tool with encrypted sync across machines
en.what: Atuin replaces your existing shell history with a SQLite database, recording additional context like exit code, duration, and working directory. It offers optional fully encrypted synchronization of history across machines via an Atuin server.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust CLI tool, a sync server, and optional encrypted sync service. Features a full-screen search UI, statistics, and key bindings.
en.stack: Built with Rust, uses SQLite for history storage, supports encrypted sync (self-hosted or official server).
en.hot: 30k+ Stars show it solves core shell history pain points: cross-device sync, search efficiency, and context recording. 30 new stars today maintain its popularity.
uses: Developers/DevOps — need cross-machine sync and efficient shell history search
Heavy terminal users — want extra context like exit codes and duration
Privacy-conscious users — require end-to-end encrypted history sync

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面服务端，支持自托管
zh.what: RustDesk Server 是 RustDesk 远程桌面软件的服务器端程序，允许用户自建远程桌面服务。它包含 ID/中继服务器和 CLI 工具，支持完全自托管，免费开源。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个可执行程序：hbbs（ID/中继服务器）、hbbr（中继服务器）和 rustdesk-utils（CLI 工具），以及配置文档和环境变量说明。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Cargo 构建系统，支持通过命令行、环境变量或配置文件进行配置。
zh.hot: 作为 TeamViewer/AnyDesk 的开源替代，RustDesk 服务器端持续受到关注，本周新增 60 星，总星数突破 1 万，位列 Rust 周榜第 17。
uses: 希望自建远程桌面服务的企业或个人，避免依赖第三方服务
需要低成本远程支持或远程办公解决方案的团队
对数据隐私有高要求的用户，希望完全控制远程连接数据

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop server for self-hosting
en.what: RustDesk Server is the server-side program for the RustDesk remote desktop software, enabling users to self-host their own remote desktop service. It includes ID/rendezvous server, relay server, and CLI utilities, fully open-source and free.
en.content: The repo contains three executables: hbbs (ID/rendezvous server), hbbr (relay server), and rustdesk-utils (CLI utilities), along with configuration docs and environment variable documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Rust, built with Cargo, and configured via command-line flags, environment variables, or config files.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to TeamViewer/AnyDesk, RustDesk Server continues to gain attention, adding 60 stars this week, surpassing 10k total stars, ranking #17 on Rust weekly trending.
uses: Enterprises or individuals wanting to self-host remote desktop services, avoiding third-party dependency
Teams needing low-cost remote support or remote work solutions
Users with high data privacy requirements, wanting full control over remote connection data

zh.tag: 高性能自托管邮件列表管理器，单二进制部署
zh.what: listmonk 是一个高性能、自托管的新闻通讯和邮件列表管理器，提供现代化仪表盘。它作为一个单二进制应用运行，使用 PostgreSQL 作为数据存储，支持 Docker 或直接二进制部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端和 Vue + Buefy 前端，提供完整的邮件列表管理功能，包括订阅管理、模板编辑、统计分析和发送队列。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，前端使用 Vue.js 和 Buefy UI 框架，数据存储依赖 PostgreSQL。
zh.hot: 自托管邮件服务需求旺盛，listmonk 以高性能、单二进制部署和现代化界面吸引开发者，本周新增 213 星，总星数超 2.2 万。
uses: 需要自托管邮件列表的独立开发者或小团队
希望避免第三方邮件服务依赖的企业或组织
对邮件发送性能和隐私有高要求的用户

en.tag: High-performance, self-hosted newsletter & mailing list manager, single binary
en.what: listmonk is a high-performance, self-hosted newsletter and mailing list manager with a modern dashboard. It runs as a single binary and uses PostgreSQL as its data store, supporting Docker or direct binary deployment.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend and Vue + Buefy frontend, offering full mailing list management features including subscriber management, template editing, analytics, and send queues.
en.stack: Backend is written in Go, frontend uses Vue.js with Buefy UI framework, and data storage relies on PostgreSQL.
en.hot: Self-hosted email services are in high demand; listmonk attracts developers with its high performance, single binary deployment, and modern UI, gaining 213 stars this week and over 22k total.
uses: Independent developers or small teams needing self-hosted mailing lists
Organizations wanting to avoid reliance on third-party email services
Users with high performance and privacy requirements for email campaigns

zh.tag: 多账户 Grok API 统一网关
zh.what: Grok2API 是一个多账户 API 网关，统一管理 Grok Build、Grok Web 和 Grok Console 的 API 访问。它通过负载均衡和自动切换，提供稳定、高效的 Grok API 代理服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端和 React 前端，提供 Docker 镜像支持 amd64/arm64 部署。后端实现多账户管理与 API 路由，前端提供 Web 管理界面。
zh.stack: Go 1.26 后端 + React 19 前端，支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 551 星，总星数达 6563，位列 GitHub 周榜第 14。Grok API 需求旺盛，该工具简化了多账户管理，受到开发者追捧。
uses: 开发者 —— 统一管理多个 Grok 账户的 API 访问
AI 应用集成 —— 为自有应用提供稳定的 Grok API 代理
学习研究 —— 了解 API 网关与多账户负载均衡实现

en.tag: Multi-account API gateway for Grok services
en.what: Grok2API is a multi-account API gateway that unifies access to Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console APIs. It provides stable and efficient API proxying with load balancing and automatic account switching.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend and a React frontend, with Docker images for amd64/arm64. The backend handles multi-account management and API routing, while the frontend provides a web admin interface.
en.stack: Go 1.26 backend + React 19 frontend, Docker deployment supported.
en.hot: Gained 551 stars this week, total 6563, ranking #14 on GitHub weekly trending. High demand for Grok API access drives popularity as it simplifies multi-account management.
uses: Developers — centrally manage API access for multiple Grok accounts
AI app integration — provide stable Grok API proxy for own applications
Learning & research — study API gateway and multi-account load balancing

zh.tag: 单文件开源实时后端，内置数据库、用户认证与管理后台
zh.what: PocketBase 是一个开源 Go 后端，将 SQLite 数据库、实时订阅、文件存储、用户认证和管理后台打包在一个可执行文件中。它让开发者无需部署和维护多个服务，就能快速启动包含后端的全栈项目。
zh.content: 仓库提供各平台预构建可执行文件、Go 框架源码与基础示例，以及官方 JavaScript 和 Dart SDK；预构建版本默认启用 JS VM 插件，允许通过 JavaScript 扩展后端逻辑。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 1.25+ 构建，内嵌 SQLite 并提供 REST-ish API；客户端通过 JavaScript（浏览器、Node.js、React Native）或 Dart（全平台）SDK 与后端交互。
zh.hot: 凭借「一个文件搞定后端」的极简理念，PocketBase 已积累近 6 万 Star，日增 37 星并登上 Go 语言日榜，成为个人开发者和快速原型场景中 Firebase 的热门轻量替代品。
uses: 个人开发者与独立黑客 —— 无需运维，单二进制文件即可部署上线全栈应用
移动/Web 原型团队 —— 借助 Dart/JS SDK 快速搭建带实时同步与文件存储的后端
追求成本可控的中小项目 —— 作为 Firebase 的自托管开源替代，减少云服务依赖

en.tag: Open-source realtime backend in a single file with embedded DB, auth and admin UI
en.what: PocketBase is an open-source Go backend that bundles an embedded SQLite database with realtime subscriptions, file storage, user authentication, and an admin dashboard into a single portable executable. It enables developers to bootstrap full-stack projects without deploying and managing multiple separate services.
en.content: The repository ships prebuilt executables for multiple platforms, the Go framework source code with base examples, plus official JavaScript and Dart SDKs; the prebuilt binary enables a JS VM plugin by default for extending backend logic with JavaScript.
en.stack: Built with Go 1.25+ around an embedded SQLite database and exposed through a REST-ish API; client interaction is handled via official JavaScript (Browser, Node.js, React Native) and Dart (Web, Mobile, Desktop, CLI) SDKs.
en.hot: With its "backend in one file" philosophy, PocketBase has gained nearly 60k stars—adding 37 today and hitting the Go daily trending list—making it a popular lightweight, self-hosted alternative to Firebase for indie hackers and rapid prototyping.
uses: Indie developers and hackers — ship a zero-ops backend in a single portable binary
Mobile and web prototyping teams — rapidly build backends with realtime sync and file storage using Dart and JS SDKs
Cost-conscious small-to-medium projects — a self-hosted, open-source alternative to Firebase that reduces cloud vendor lock-in

zh.tag: 微信视频号视频一键下载工具
zh.what: 这是一个专为微信视频号设计的视频下载工具，支持 macOS 和 Windows 系统。用户只需以管理员身份运行，安装证书后即可在微信 PC 端看到下载按钮，轻松下载视频。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、前端解密逻辑（参考自其他项目）以及构建脚本。提供在线解析页面和本地代理服务两种使用方式。
zh.stack: Go 语言开发，依赖系统代理和 HTTPS 证书，前端解密参考 JavaScript 实现。
zh.hot: 本周新增 833 星，总星数 8107，位列 Go 语言周榜第 6。微信视频号内容下载需求大，工具简单易用，解决了用户痛点。
uses: 微信视频号内容创作者 —— 备份自己的视频素材
普通用户 —— 保存喜欢的视频到本地离线观看
研究人员 —— 分析视频号技术实现

en.tag: One-click WeChat Channels video downloader
en.what: A dedicated video downloader for WeChat Channels, supporting macOS and Windows. Run as administrator, install the certificate, and a download button appears in the WeChat PC client for easy video saving.
en.content: Contains a Go backend service, frontend decryption logic (referenced from other projects), and build scripts. Offers both online parsing page and local proxy service.
en.stack: Built with Go, relies on system proxy and HTTPS certificates; frontend decryption references JavaScript implementation.
en.hot: Gained 833 stars this week, total 8107, ranking #6 in Go weekly trending. High demand for WeChat Channels content downloading, simple and effective tool.
uses: WeChat Channels content creators — backup their own videos
Regular users — save favorite videos for offline viewing
Researchers — analyze technical implementation of Channels

zh.tag: 自托管的虚拟浏览器，支持多人同时访问
zh.what: Neko 是一个自托管的虚拟浏览器，运行在 Docker 中，使用 WebRTC 技术实现低延迟的远程浏览体验。它允许用户从任何地方安全、私密地访问互联网，并支持多人同时共享同一个浏览器环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Docker 镜像、WebRTC 信令服务器、浏览器自动化脚本以及可配置的 UI 界面。支持多种浏览器（如 Firefox、Chromium）和丰富的自定义选项。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 WebRTC 进行实时音视频传输，依赖 Docker 容器化部署。前端采用 React，后端与浏览器通过 WebSocket 通信。
zh.hot: Neko 凭借其自托管、隐私友好和多人协作的特性，在开发者社区中广受欢迎，本周新增 321 颗星，总星数达 21714。
uses: 开发者和测试人员 —— 在隔离环境中测试 Web 应用或跨浏览器兼容性
隐私敏感用户 —— 通过虚拟浏览器匿名访问互联网，保护本地 IP
团队协作 —— 多人共享浏览器会话，用于看板、演示或协同浏览
活动组织者 —— 托管观影派对或互动演示，参与者实时同步观看

en.tag: Self-hosted virtual browser with multi-user support via WebRTC
en.what: Neko is a self-hosted virtual browser that runs in Docker and uses WebRTC for low-latency remote browsing. It enables secure and private internet access from anywhere, with multi-user support for shared browsing sessions.
en.content: The repository includes Docker images, a WebRTC signaling server, browser automation scripts, and a configurable UI. It supports multiple browsers (e.g., Firefox, Chromium) and extensive customization.
en.stack: Built with Go, uses WebRTC for real-time streaming, Docker for containerization. Frontend is React, backend communicates with the browser via WebSocket.
en.hot: Neko gains popularity for its self-hosted, privacy-friendly, and collaborative features, adding 321 stars this week to reach 21,714 total.
uses: Developers and testers — test web apps or cross-browser compatibility in an isolated environment
Privacy-conscious users — browse anonymously via a virtual browser to hide local IP
Teams — share browser sessions for dashboards, demos, or collaborative browsing
Event organizers — host watch parties or interactive presentations with real-time sync

zh.tag: AI API 订阅配额中转与拼车共享平台
zh.what: Sub2API 是一款开源中转服务，将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等主流 AI 订阅统一接入单一平台。通过配额分发与拼车共享机制，帮助用户高效分摊订阅成本，并支持 Claude Code、Codex 等原生工具无缝调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 Go 的 API 网关后端、Vue 3 前端管理界面，以及 Docker 部署配置。项目提供多语言文档、赞助商展示模块，并内置 PostgreSQL 与 Redis 的存储和缓存支持。
zh.stack: 后端基于 Go 1.25+ 构建，前端采用 Vue 3.4+，数据层依赖 PostgreSQL 15+ 与 Redis 7+，并通过 Docker 提供一键部署能力。
zh.hot: 凭借 32.7k Star 和本周新增 1416 Star 的增速，该项目精准切中 AI 开发者对多模型聚合与低成本共享订阅的刚需；其开源中转架构和「拼车」模式大幅降低了个人与团队使用顶级 AI 模型的门槛。
uses: 拥有多平台 AI 订阅但希望统一管理和分发配额的开发者或团队
希望以「拼车」方式分摊 Claude、OpenAI 等高昂订阅成本的个人用户
需要在 Claude Code、Codex 等原生工具中无缝切换多模型 API 的工程师

en.tag: AI API Gateway for Subscription Quota Sharing & Cost Splitting
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source relay gateway that unifies access to Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and other AI subscriptions under one platform. It distributes subscription quotas and supports ride-sharing-style cost splitting to reduce individual expenses, while allowing native tools like Claude Code and Codex to work seamlessly.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based backend API gateway, a Vue 3 frontend admin panel, and Docker deployment configurations. It ships with multi-language documentation, sponsor modules, and built-in PostgreSQL and Redis support for storage and caching.
en.stack: Backend is built with Go 1.25+, frontend uses Vue 3.4+, with PostgreSQL 15+ and Redis 7+ handling data and caching, and Docker providing one-click deployment.
en.hot: With 32.7k stars and 1,416 new stars this week, it hits a strong demand for multi-model aggregation and low-cost subscription sharing among AI developers; its open-source relay architecture and ride-sharing model significantly lower the barrier to using top-tier AI models.
uses: Developers or teams managing multiple AI subscriptions who need unified quota distribution
Individual users looking to split high subscription costs for Claude, OpenAI, and others via ride-sharing
Engineers who want seamless multi-model API switching within native tools like Claude Code and Codex

zh.tag: 开源实时基础设施监控平台，秒级粒度
zh.what: Netdata 是一个开源的、实时的、AI 驱动的全栈可观测性平台，专为基础设施监控设计。它能够收集数千个指标，并以每秒一次的频率展示，帮助团队快速发现和诊断问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Netdata 的核心监控代理、仪表盘、告警引擎以及 AI/ML 异常检测模块。支持 Docker、Kubernetes、Linux 等多种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 C 语言插件和 Node.js 前端。支持多种数据采集插件（如 Prometheus、StatsD）和存储后端。
zh.hot: 拥有近 8 万 Star，是监控领域最受欢迎的开源项目之一。今日新增 51 Star，位列 Go 语言日榜第 3，因其零配置、秒级粒度和 AI 增强的异常检测能力持续吸引用户。
uses: 运维工程师 —— 实时监控服务器、容器和云基础设施性能
DevOps 团队 —— 集成到 CI/CD 流水线，快速定位性能瓶颈
SRE —— 利用 AI 异常检测减少告警噪音，提升可观测性

en.tag: Open-source real-time infrastructure monitoring platform with per-second granularity
en.what: Netdata is an open-source, real-time, AI-powered full-stack observability platform designed for infrastructure monitoring. It collects thousands of metrics and displays them at per-second granularity, enabling teams to quickly detect and diagnose issues.
en.content: The repository contains the core monitoring agent, dashboard, alerting engine, and AI/ML anomaly detection module. Supports deployment via Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, and more.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with C plugins and a Node.js frontend. Supports various data collection plugins (e.g., Prometheus, StatsD) and storage backends.
en.hot: With nearly 80K stars, it's one of the most popular open-source monitoring projects. Gaining 51 stars today, ranking #3 on Go daily trending, its zero-config, per-second granularity, and AI-enhanced anomaly detection continue to attract users.
uses: Ops engineers — real-time monitoring of servers, containers, and cloud infrastructure
DevOps teams — integrate into CI/CD pipelines for quick performance bottleneck identification
SREs — leverage AI anomaly detection to reduce alert noise and improve observability

zh.tag: 像构建API一样构建AI代理，像微服务一样运行
zh.what: AgentField 是一个 AI 后端框架，允许开发者像构建 API 一样构建 AI 代理，并像微服务一样运行成千上万个代理。它提供控制平面来排队、重试和追踪每个分支，实现一个请求扇出到数千个代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 AgentField 核心引擎、Go 编写的控制平面、Python/Go/TypeScript SDK 以及 REST API。提供文档、快速入门指南和示例。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Go，提供 Python、Go、TypeScript 的 SDK，依赖 REST API 进行通信。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理的兴起，AgentField 提供了类似微服务的架构来管理大规模代理，解决了代理编排的痛点，本周新增 80 星，位列 Go 周榜第 10。
uses: AI 应用开发者 —— 需要构建和编排多个 AI 代理的团队
微服务架构师 —— 希望将代理作为微服务管理的工程师
AI 平台团队 —— 需要大规模运行和监控代理的基础设施团队

en.tag: Build, run and scale AI agents like API and microservices
en.what: AgentField is an AI backend framework that lets developers build AI agents like APIs and run thousands of them like microservices. It provides a control plane to queue, retry, and trace every branch, enabling one request to fan out to thousands of agents.
en.content: The repo contains the AgentField core engine, a control plane written in Go, Python/Go/TypeScript SDKs, and a REST API. It includes documentation, quick start guide, and examples.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with SDKs for Python, Go, and TypeScript, communicating via REST API.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents, AgentField offers a microservice-like architecture to manage agents at scale, addressing the pain point of agent orchestration. It gained 80 stars this week, ranking #10 on Go weekly trending.
uses: AI application developers — teams needing to build and orchestrate multiple AI agents
Microservice architects — engineers wanting to manage agents as microservices

zh.tag: 微软开源的新版 Windows 终端与控制台主机
zh.what: Windows Terminal 是一个现代、快速、高效、强大且高效的终端应用程序，适用于命令行工具和 shell（如命令提示符、PowerShell 和 WSL）。它同时包含原始的 Windows 控制台主机 conhost.exe。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Windows Terminal、Windows Terminal Preview、控制台主机 conhost.exe 以及两者共享的组件，还有 ColorTool 和示例项目。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Windows 10 2004 及以上版本，支持通过 Microsoft Store、GitHub、winget、Chocolatey 和 Scoop 安装。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方开源项目，拥有超过 10 万 Star，今日新增 232，持续受到开发者关注，因为它提供了现代化的终端体验并替代了旧版控制台。
uses: Windows 开发者 —— 需要一个功能丰富的现代终端来运行命令行工具和 shell
系统管理员 —— 管理多个命令行环境，如 PowerShell、CMD 和 WSL
开源贡献者 —— 希望参与 Windows 终端或控制台主机的开发

en.tag: Microsoft's open-source new Windows Terminal and console host
en.what: Windows Terminal is a modern, fast, efficient, powerful, and productive terminal application for users of command-line tools and shells like Command Prompt, PowerShell, and WSL. It also includes the original Windows console host (conhost.exe).
en.content: The repo contains Windows Terminal, Windows Terminal Preview, the console host conhost.exe, shared components, ColorTool, and sample projects.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, requires Windows 10 2004 or later, and can be installed via Microsoft Store, GitHub, winget, Chocolatey, and Scoop.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft open-source project with over 100k stars and 232 new stars today, it remains popular for providing a modern terminal experience and replacing the legacy console.
uses: Windows developers — need a feature-rich modern terminal for command-line tools and shells
System administrators — manage multiple command-line environments like PowerShell, CMD, and WSL
Open-source contributors — want to contribute to Windows Terminal or console host development

zh.tag: 经典开源后末日回合制生存游戏，被誉为僵尸生存类Roguelike的祖师爷
zh.what: Cataclysm: DDA 是一款设定在末日后的硬核回合制生存游戏。玩家需要在程序生成的残酷、持久世界中搜刮物资、制作工具、驾驶载具，并对抗僵尸、巨型昆虫、杀人机器人等变异怪物，竭尽所能活下去。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的游戏源码、多种瓦片集与图形资源、实验/稳定双分支的构建流水线，以及面向 Linux、Windows、macOS 和 BSD 的编译与分发文档。
zh.stack: 核心以 C++ 编写，同时支持 ncurses 终端模式与 SDL 图形前端；游戏数据与模组内容通过 JSON 驱动，并利用 CMake/Make 及 GitHub Actions 完成跨平台构建。
zh.hot: 该仓库已积累约 1.27 万 Star，今日新增 24 颗并登上 C++ 日榜第 11 位。其持续十数年的高频更新、近乎疯狂的自由度与深度生存模拟，使其在开源游戏社区中拥有极为忠实的玩家群体。
uses: 硬核 Roguelike 爱好者——体验程序生成世界与永久死亡带来的极致生存挑战
开源游戏研究者——学习大型 C++ 游戏项目架构、数据驱动设计与跨平台分发实践
模组开发者——通过 JSON 自定义物品、怪物、地图与玩法规则，扩展末日世界
后末日题材玩家——在僵尸、怪物与人性挣扎中体验高自由度的沙盒叙事

en.tag: Classic open-source post-apocalyptic turn-based survival roguelike
en.what: Cataclysm: DDA is a hardcore turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players scavenge a procedurally generated, persistent wasteland for supplies, craft gear, drive vehicles, and fight or flee from zombies, mutants, and killer robots to survive as long as possible.
en.content: The repository contains the full game source code, multiple tilesets and graphical assets, CI/CD pipelines for stable and experimental builds, and compilation/packaging documentation for Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with both ncurses terminal and SDL graphical frontends; game data and modding content are JSON-driven, while cross-platform builds are handled via CMake/Make and GitHub Actions.
en.hot: With roughly 12.7k stars and 24 new stars today placing it at #11 on the C++ daily trending list, the game has maintained a devoted following. Decades of relentless updates, extreme freedom, and deep survival mechanics keep the community highly engaged.
uses: Hardcore roguelike fans seeking brutal permadeath survival in a procedurally generated world
Open-source game researchers studying large-scale C++ architecture and data-driven design
Modders who want to extend the apocalypse via JSON-defined items, monsters, and mechanics
Post-apocalyptic gamers craving sandbox storytelling with zombies, mutants, and moral dilemmas

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: Google 开源的跨语言结构化数据序列化协议
zh.what: Protocol Buffers（protobuf）是 Google 推出的语言无关、平台无关、可扩展的结构化数据序列化机制。它通过定义 .proto 文件描述数据结构，再由编译器生成多种语言的代码，实现高效、紧凑的数据交换。广泛应用于微服务通信、配置文件和数据存储等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 protoc 编译器核心（C++）、多语言运行时库以及标准 .proto 定义文件。同时提供了基于 Bazel 和 CMake 的构建配置与完整测试套件。
zh.stack: 核心编译器采用 C++ 实现，支持跨语言代码生成；构建系统以 Bazel 为主并兼容 CMake，运行时覆盖 Java、Python、Go、C++ 等主流语言。
zh.hot: 凭借极致的序列化性能与跨语言生态，protobuf 已成为微服务通信的事实标准。其 71.5k+ Stars 和持续稳定的日增关注，体现了基础设施领域长期且广泛的工业采纳度。
uses: 后端与微服务开发者 —— 构建高性能跨语言 RPC 及数据交换协议
云原生工程师 —— 在 Kubernetes 与服务网格中统一定义数据面接口
跨平台开发者 —— 通过 .proto 一次定义生成多语言客户端与服务端代码
数据工程师 —— 高效存储和传输结构化日志、配置与事件流

en.tag: Google's cross-language data serialization format and compiler
en.what: Protocol Buffers is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. Developers define data schemas in .proto files and use the protoc compiler to generate efficient, compact serialization code for multiple languages. It is widely adopted for microservices communication, configuration management, and data storage.
en.content: The repository includes the core protoc compiler (C++), multi-language runtime libraries, and standard .proto definitions. It also provides build configurations for Bazel and CMake alongside comprehensive test suites.
en.stack: The core compiler is implemented in C++ and supports cross-language code generation. The build system is primarily Bazel with CMake support, and runtimes cover Java, Python, Go, C++, and other major languages.
en.hot: It has become the de facto standard for microservices communication through extreme serialization performance and a cross-language ecosystem. Its 71.5k+ stars and steady daily growth reflect massive, long-standing industry adoption in the infrastructure space.
uses: Backend and microservices developers — building high-performance, cross-language RPC and data exchange protocols
Cloud-native engineers — standardizing data-plane interfaces in Kubernetes and service mesh environments
Cross-platform developers — generating multi-language client and server code from a single .proto definition
Data engineers — efficiently storing and transmitting structured logs, configurations, and event streams

zh.tag: 跨平台机器学习解决方案，赋能实时媒体处理
zh.what: MediaPipe 是 Google 开源的跨平台机器学习解决方案框架，提供预训练模型、API 和工具，让开发者轻松在移动端、Web、桌面和 IoT 设备上部署实时 ML 应用。它涵盖视觉、文本、音频等任务，支持自定义模型和端侧推理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MediaPipe Tasks（跨平台 API）、MediaPipe Models（预训练模型）、MediaPipe Model Maker（模型定制工具）和 MediaPipe Studio（浏览器内可视化评估）。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++，支持 Android、iOS、Web、Python 等多平台，依赖 TensorFlow Lite 等推理引擎。
zh.hot: MediaPipe 是端侧 ML 部署的标杆项目，拥有 36k+ Star，持续活跃。今日新增 22 Star，位列 C++ 日榜第 9，因其易用性和跨平台能力受到开发者青睐。
uses: 移动端开发者 —— 快速集成人脸检测、手势识别等视觉功能
Web 开发者 —— 在浏览器中运行实时 ML 模型，无需后端
IoT 与边缘设备开发者 —— 部署轻量级 ML 解决方案到资源受限设备

en.tag: Cross-platform ML solutions for live and streaming media
en.what: MediaPipe is an open-source cross-platform ML solutions framework by Google, offering pre-trained models, APIs, and tools to easily deploy real-time ML applications on mobile, web, desktop, and IoT devices. It covers vision, text, and audio tasks, with support for custom models and on-device inference.
en.content: The repo includes MediaPipe Tasks (cross-platform APIs), MediaPipe Models (pre-trained models), MediaPipe Model Maker (customization tool), and MediaPipe Studio (in-browser visualization and evaluation).
en.stack: Primarily C++, supports Android, iOS, Web, Python, and other platforms, with dependencies on TensorFlow Lite and other inference engines.
en.hot: MediaPipe is a benchmark project for on-device ML deployment with 36k+ stars and continuous activity. With 22 new stars today, ranking 9th in C++ daily trending, it's favored for its ease of use and cross-platform capabilities.
uses: Mobile developers — quickly integrate face detection, gesture recognition, and other vision features
Web developers — run real-time ML models in the browser without a backend
IoT and edge device developers — deploy lightweight ML solutions to resource-constrained devices

zh.tag: Linux 上运行 Windows 游戏的 Vulkan 翻译层
zh.what: DXVK 是一个基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 实现，允许在 Linux 上通过 Wine 运行 Windows 3D 应用和游戏。它通过将 Direct3D 调用转换为 Vulkan，显著提升了性能和兼容性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DXVK 的源码、构建脚本、预编译 DLL 发布包以及详细的 Wiki 文档。核心是多个 DLL 文件（d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll），用户需将其复制到 Wine 前缀目录并配置覆盖。
zh.stack: 使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan API 和 Wine 环境。构建需要 Meson 和相应的编译器工具链。
zh.hot: 作为 Linux 游戏生态的关键组件，DXVK 持续获得关注，本周新增 77 星，总星数 17709，位列 C++ 周榜第 10。其稳定的性能和广泛的游戏兼容性使其成为 Steam Play 等工具的核心依赖。
uses: Linux 游戏玩家 —— 通过 Wine/Steam Play 运行 Windows 游戏
开发者 —— 为 Linux 移植或测试 Direct3D 应用
发行版维护者 —— 集成 DXVK 到游戏工具或发行版中

en.tag: Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D 8/9/10/11 on Linux/Wine
en.what: DXVK is a Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D 8/9/10/11, enabling Windows 3D applications and games to run on Linux via Wine. It converts Direct3D calls to Vulkan, greatly improving performance and compatibility.
en.content: The repository contains source code, build scripts, precompiled DLL releases, and detailed Wiki documentation. The core consists of several DLL files (d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll) that users copy into their Wine prefix and configure via winecfg.
en.stack: Written in C++, depends on Vulkan API and Wine environment. Build requires Meson and appropriate compiler toolchain.
en.hot: As a critical component of the Linux gaming ecosystem, DXVK continues to gain attention with 77 new stars this week, totaling 17709, ranking 10th on the C++ weekly list. Its stable performance and broad game compatibility make it a core dependency for tools like Steam Play.
uses: Linux gamers — run Windows games via Wine/Steam Play
Developers — port or test Direct3D applications on Linux
Distro maintainers — integrate DXVK into gaming tools or distributions

zh.tag: 为逆向工程师和程序员打造的现代化十六进制编辑器
zh.what: ImHex 是一款功能强大的十六进制编辑器，专为逆向工程、编程和底层数据分析设计。它提供了直观的界面、丰富的可视化工具和强大的模式搜索功能，帮助用户高效地分析和编辑二进制文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的十六进制编辑器源代码，支持插件系统、多种数据模式、自定义主题和高级搜索功能。同时提供桌面版和 Web 版，以及详细的文档和社区支持。
zh.stack: 使用 C++ 开发，依赖 ImGui 构建图形界面，支持多种操作系统。集成模式匹配语言、反汇编器和数据分析工具。
zh.hot: 凭借其强大的功能和精美的界面设计，ImHex 在逆向工程和编程社区中广受欢迎，已获得超过 5.4 万颗星标。本周新增 108 颗星，持续活跃在 GitHub 趋势榜上。
uses: 逆向工程师 —— 分析二进制文件、固件和恶意软件
程序员 —— 调试底层数据结构和文件格式
安全研究人员 —— 执行漏洞分析和数据取证
数据爱好者 —— 探索和编辑任意二进制数据

en.tag: A modern hex editor for reverse engineers and programmers
en.what: ImHex is a powerful hex editor designed for reverse engineering, programming, and low-level data analysis. It offers an intuitive interface, rich visualization tools, and powerful pattern search capabilities to help users efficiently analyze and edit binary files.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the hex editor, supporting a plugin system, multiple data patterns, custom themes, and advanced search features. It offers both desktop and web versions, along with detailed documentation and community support.
en.stack: Developed in C++, using ImGui for the graphical interface, supporting multiple operating systems. Integrates pattern matching language, disassembler, and data analysis tools.
en.hot: With its powerful features and beautiful interface design, ImHex is widely popular in the reverse engineering and programming communities, amassing over 54,000 stars. It gained 108 new stars this week and remains active on the GitHub trending list.
uses: Reverse engineers — analyze binary files, firmware, and malware
Programmers — debug low-level data structures and file formats
Security researchers — perform vulnerability analysis and data forensics
Data enthusiasts — explore and edit arbitrary binary data

zh.tag: PS4 & PS5 模拟器，早期阶段
zh.what: Kyty 是一款正在早期开发中的 PS4 和 PS5 模拟器，能够运行部分简单 PS4 游戏和 PS5 自制程序。项目目前存在图形错误、崩溃、卡顿和低帧率等问题，许多功能尚未实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码、构建脚本（CMake）、CI 配置以及截图示例。支持 Windows 10 x64 平台，使用 Vulkan SDK 和 Qt 5.15.0 作为依赖。
zh.stack: C++ 编写，使用 CMake 构建，依赖 Vulkan SDK 和 Qt 5.15.0。支持 Visual Studio + clang-cl + ninja 或 Eclipse CDT + mingw-w64 + gcc/clang + ninja 工具链。
zh.hot: 作为罕见的 PS4/PS5 模拟器项目，本周新增 118 星，总星数达 2944，位列 GitHub C++ 周榜第 5，吸引了大量游戏爱好者和开发者的关注。
uses: 游戏爱好者 —— 尝试运行 PS4/PS5 游戏或自制程序
模拟器开发者 —— 学习 PS4/PS5 模拟技术或贡献代码
C++ 开发者 —— 参与开源项目，提升技能

en.tag: PS4 & PS5 emulator in early stage
en.what: Kyty is an early-stage PS4 and PS5 emulator capable of running some simple PS4 games and PS5 homebrews. The project currently suffers from graphics glitches, crashes, freezes, and low FPS, with many features not yet implemented.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build scripts (CMake), CI configuration, and screenshot examples. It supports Windows 10 x64 and relies on Vulkan SDK and Qt 5.15.0.
en.stack: Written in C++, built with CMake, depends on Vulkan SDK and Qt 5.15.0. Supports toolchains: Visual Studio + clang-cl + ninja or Eclipse CDT + mingw-w64 + gcc/clang + ninja.
en.hot: As a rare PS4/PS5 emulator project, it gained 118 stars this week, reaching 2944 total stars and ranking #5 on GitHub C++ weekly trending, attracting significant attention from gamers and developers.
uses: Gamers — to try running PS4/PS5 games or homebrews
Emulator developers — to learn PS4/PS5 emulation techniques or contribute code
C++ developers — to participate in open-source projects and improve skills

zh.tag: 自托管桌面流媒体主机，原生分辨率云游戏
zh.what: Apollo 是一个自托管的桌面流媒体主机，专为 Artemis (Moonlight Noir) 客户端设计，提供低延迟、原生客户端分辨率的流式传输，支持 AMD、Intel 和 Nvidia GPU 硬件编码及软件编码。它包含 Web UI 用于配置和客户端配对，并内置虚拟显示器，自动匹配客户端分辨率与帧率。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的流媒体服务器源码、Web 管理界面、虚拟显示驱动（SudoVDA）集成、权限管理系统、剪贴板同步及客户端连接/断开命令。
zh.stack: 主语言 C++，依赖 Sunshine 框架、SudoVDA 虚拟显示驱动、Web UI 前端，支持 AMD/Intel/Nvidia GPU 硬件编码。
zh.hot: 本周新增 141 星，总星数 10316，位列 C++ 周榜第 17。它解决了云游戏中原生分辨率匹配的痛点，提供开箱即用的虚拟显示器，吸引自建游戏流媒体用户。
uses: 游戏玩家 —— 自建云游戏服务器，在任何设备上以原生分辨率玩 PC 游戏
开发者 —— 研究或扩展流媒体协议与虚拟显示技术
双 GPU 笔记本用户 —— 利用 Apollo 优化外接显示器或内屏流式传输

en.tag: Self-hosted desktop stream host for native-resolution cloud gaming
en.what: Apollo is a self-hosted desktop stream host for Artemis (Moonlight Noir) clients, offering low-latency streaming at native client resolution with support for AMD, Intel, and Nvidia GPU hardware encoding as well as software encoding. It includes a web UI for configuration and client pairing, and a built-in virtual display that automatically matches client resolution and framerate.
en.content: The repository contains the full streaming server source code, web management UI, virtual display driver (SudoVDA) integration, permission management system, clipboard sync, and client connection/disconnection commands.
en.stack: Primarily C++, built on the Sunshine framework with SudoVDA virtual display driver, web UI frontend, and support for AMD/Intel/Nvidia GPU hardware encoding.
en.hot: Gained 141 stars this week, total 10316, ranked #17 on C++ weekly trending. It solves the pain point of native resolution matching in cloud gaming with an out-of-the-box virtual display, attracting self-hosted game streaming enthusiasts.
uses: Gamers — self-host a cloud gaming server to play PC games at native resolution on any device
Developers — study or extend streaming protocols and virtual display technology
Dual-GPU laptop users — leverage Apollo for optimized streaming to external or internal displays

zh.tag: 本地AI服务器，GPU/NPU上运行LLM，免费私密
zh.what: Lemonade 是一款本地 AI 服务器，能在用户自己的 GPU 和 NPU 上运行优化后的 LLM，提供与云端 API 相同的功能，但完全免费且私密。支持聊天、编程、语音和图像生成等最新模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Lemonade Server（作为服务安装，兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama API）和 Embeddable Lemonade（可嵌入应用的便携二进制）。提供模型管理器、内置聊天/图像/语音界面，以及 iOS 移动端。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，利用 AMD 工程师的优化，支持 Ryzen AI、Radeon 和 Strix Halo PC。依赖 GPU/NPU 加速，兼容多种模型格式。
zh.hot: 本周新增 132 星，总星数 5042，位列 GitHub C++ 周榜第 11。因其提供免费、私密的本地 AI 体验，且由 AMD 官方优化，吸引大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：在本地运行 LLM 进行测试和开发，无需云服务费用
隐私敏感用户：完全离线使用 AI 聊天、编程助手，数据不外传
AMD 硬件用户：充分利用 Ryzen AI、Radeon 等 GPU/NPU 性能

en.tag: Local AI server serving optimized LLMs on your own GPU/NPU, free and private
en.what: Lemonade is a local AI server that runs optimized LLMs on your own GPU and NPU, offering cloud-like capabilities completely free and private. It supports the latest models for chat, coding, speech, and image generation.
en.content: The repo includes Lemonade Server (installable service compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama APIs) and Embeddable Lemonade (portable binary for embedding). It features a model manager, built-in chat/image/speech interfaces, and an iOS mobile app.
en.stack: Built with C++, optimized by AMD engineers for Ryzen AI, Radeon, and Strix Halo PCs. Leverages GPU/NPU acceleration and supports multiple model formats.
en.hot: Gained 132 stars this week, total 5042, ranking #11 on GitHub C++ weekly trending. Its free, private local AI experience with official AMD optimizations has attracted significant developer attention.
uses: Developers: run LLMs locally for testing and development without cloud costs
Privacy-conscious users: use AI chat, coding assistants fully offline with no data leakage
AMD hardware users: maximize performance on Ryzen AI, Radeon GPUs/NPUs

zh.tag: 实时分析型列式数据库管理系统
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为实时生成分析数据报告而设计。它能够对海量数据进行极速查询，支持 SQL 接口，适用于在线分析处理（OLAP）场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ClickHouse 数据库的完整源代码、构建脚本、测试套件以及文档。提供 Linux、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的安装方式，并有丰富的社区资源如教程、文档、视频和 Slack 群组。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 LLVM、libcxx、zlib-ng 等底层库，支持多种编译器和平台。
zh.hot: ClickHouse 因其极致的查询性能和实时分析能力而广受欢迎，拥有 48k+ Stars，本周新增 159 Stars，在 C++ 周榜排名第 15。
uses: 数据工程师 —— 构建实时 OLAP 数据管道和仪表盘
DevOps/SRE —— 监控和可观测性数据存储与查询
数据分析师 —— 对海量数据进行交互式探索分析
产品经理 —— 了解用户行为分析场景下的技术选型

en.tag: Real-time analytics column-oriented database management system
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system designed for real-time generation of analytical data reports. It enables blazing-fast queries on massive datasets, supports SQL interface, and is suitable for online analytical processing (OLAP) scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, test suites, and documentation for the ClickHouse database. It provides installation methods for Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, and offers rich community resources such as tutorials, documentation, videos, and Slack groups.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies on LLVM, libcxx, zlib-ng, and other low-level libraries, supporting multiple compilers and platforms.
en.hot: ClickHouse is widely popular for its extreme query performance and real-time analytics capabilities, with over 48k Stars and 159 new stars this week, ranking 15th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Data engineers — building real-time OLAP data pipelines and dashboards
DevOps/SRE — storing and querying monitoring and observability data
Data analysts — interactive exploration and analysis of massive datasets
Product managers — understanding technical choices for user behavior analytics

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: Telegram 官方桌面客户端，开源完整源码
zh.what: Telegram Desktop 是 Telegram 即时通讯软件的官方桌面客户端，提供跨平台的消息收发、文件传输、语音通话等功能。它基于 Telegram API 和 MTProto 安全协议构建，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。

uses: Telegram 重度用户 —— 需要官方桌面客户端进行高效聊天
开源爱好者 —— 研究大型 C++ 项目架构与跨平台开发
安全研究者 —— 审查 MTProto 协议实现与加密通信

en.tag: Official Telegram desktop client, full open-source code
en.what: Telegram Desktop is the official desktop client for Telegram messenger, offering cross-platform messaging, file transfer, voice calls, and more. It is built on the Telegram API and MTProto secure protocol, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, and third-party dependencies (e.g., Qt, OpenSSL, WebRTC), along with detailed build instructions.

Open-source enthusiasts — study large C++ project architecture and cross-platform development
Security researchers — review MTProto protocol implementation and encrypted communication

zh.tag: 开源计算机视觉库，图像与视频处理的基础设施
zh.what: OpenCV 是一个跨平台的计算机视觉库，提供数百种图像处理、视频分析、机器学习算法。它被广泛应用于学术研究、工业检测、自动驾驶、安防监控等领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 源码、Python 绑定、文档、示例和测试。模块涵盖图像处理、特征检测、目标识别、深度学习推理等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，支持 Python、Java、MATLAB 等语言绑定。依赖 CMake 构建，可集成 CUDA、OpenCL 等加速库。
zh.hot: 作为计算机视觉领域最知名的开源库，OpenCV 拥有超过 9 万星标，持续活跃更新。本周新增 176 星，稳居 C++ 周榜前列。
uses: 学术研究者 —— 快速原型验证图像处理与视觉算法
工业开发者 —— 构建实时视觉检测、人脸识别、运动跟踪系统
AI 工程师 —— 集成深度学习模型进行目标检测与图像分类
教育学习者 —— 学习计算机视觉原理与编程实践

en.tag: Open Source Computer Vision Library, infrastructure for image and video processing
en.what: OpenCV is a cross-platform computer vision library offering hundreds of algorithms for image processing, video analysis, and machine learning. It is widely used in academic research, industrial inspection, autonomous driving, and security surveillance.
en.content: The repository contains core C++ source code, Python bindings, documentation, examples, and tests. Modules cover image processing, feature detection, object recognition, deep learning inference, and more.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with bindings for Python, Java, MATLAB, etc. Built with CMake, and can integrate acceleration libraries like CUDA and OpenCL.
en.hot: As the most well-known open-source library in computer vision, OpenCV has over 90K stars and remains actively maintained. With 176 new stars this week, it consistently ranks high on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Academic researchers — quickly prototype and validate image processing and vision algorithms
Industrial developers — build real-time visual inspection, face recognition, and motion tracking systems
AI engineers — integrate deep learning models for object detection and image classification
Students and learners — study computer vision principles and programming practice

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 格式化库，安全快速替代 printf 和 iostream
zh.what: 提供类似 Python 的格式化字符串语法，支持位置参数、IEEE 754 浮点正确舍入、Unicode 等特性。实现了 C++20 std::format 和 C++23 std::print，性能优于常见标准库实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心头文件（base.h, format.h）、文档、示例和测试。最小配置仅需三个文件，易于集成。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，无外部依赖，支持 C++11 及以上标准。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 标准格式化库的事实标准，本周新增 30 星，总星数超 2.3 万，持续活跃维护。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 替代 printf/iostream，提升代码安全性和性能
库作者 —— 为用户定义类型提供格式化支持
需要本地化输出的应用 —— 利用位置参数实现多语言格式化

en.tag: Modern C++ formatting library, fast and safe alternative to printf and iostreams
en.what: Provides a Python-like format string syntax with positional arguments, correct IEEE 754 floating-point rounding, Unicode support, and more. Implements C++20 std::format and C++23 std::print, outperforming common standard library implementations.
en.content: Repository includes core headers (base.h, format.h), documentation, examples, and tests. Minimal configuration requires only three files for easy integration.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with no external dependencies, supports C++11 and later.
en.hot: As the de facto standard for C++ formatting, gained 30 stars this week, with over 23.6K total stars, actively maintained.
uses: C++ developers — replace printf/iostream for safer and faster code
Library authors — provide formatting support for user-defined types
Applications needing localized output — use positional arguments for multi-language formatting

zh.tag: 开源反检测浏览器，专为爬虫和AI代理设计
zh.what: Camoufox 是一个开源的反检测浏览器，旨在帮助用户绕过网站的反爬虫机制。它通过模拟真实浏览器指纹和行为，让爬虫和AI代理看起来像普通用户。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Camoufox 浏览器的核心源码、构建脚本、文档和示例。项目处于开发阶段，提供 Python 包和可执行文件。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，使用 Python 作为主要接口，依赖浏览器引擎（如 Firefox）和指纹库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 264 星，总星数超 1 万，因其填补了开源反检测浏览器的空白，且与 AI 代理和爬虫需求高度契合。
uses: 网络爬虫开发者 —— 需要绕过反爬机制采集数据
AI 代理开发者 —— 让代理在浏览器环境中隐身操作
安全研究人员 —— 测试网站指纹检测能力

en.tag: Open-source anti-detect browser for web scraping & AI agents
en.what: Camoufox is an open-source anti-detect browser designed to help users bypass anti-bot measures. It mimics real browser fingerprints and behaviors to make scrapers and AI agents appear as regular users.
en.content: The repo contains core source code, build scripts, documentation, and examples for Camoufox. It's under development, offering a Python package and executable.
en.stack: Built with C++, uses Python as the primary interface, relies on browser engines (e.g., Firefox) and fingerprinting libraries.
en.hot: Gained 264 stars this week, total over 10k, because it fills a gap in open-source anti-detect browsers and aligns well with AI agent and scraping needs.
uses: Web scrapers needing to bypass anti-bot measures
AI agent developers requiring stealthy browser automation
Security researchers testing fingerprint detection

zh.tag: 跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器，已可运行 Bloodborne 等独占大作
zh.what: shadPS4 是一款使用 C++ 编写的早期 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上运行 PS4 游戏。目前它已能成功启动并运行《血源诅咒》《如龙0》等热门独占作品，尽管仍处于开发初期，尚未达到完美体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心源码、图形/音频后端、指令翻译模块及系统服务实现，同时提供文档、兼容性列表与截图。用户可搭配独立的 QtLauncher 获得完整的图形界面体验。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，利用 Vulkan 等图形 API 实现 GPU 指令转译与渲染，跨平台兼容 Windows、Linux 与 macOS。
zh.hot: 凭借已能运行《血源诅咒》等 PS4 独占 3A 大作的突破性进展，该项目吸引了大量玩家与开发者关注，本周新增 332 Star 并累积至 32K+，跻身 GitHub C++ 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 硬核主机玩家 —— 想在 PC 或 Mac 上体验 PS4 独占大作。
模拟器开发者 —— 研究 PS4 系统架构、图形渲染与指令转译技术。
开源贡献者 —— 参与兼容性测试、漏洞修复与性能优化。
游戏研究者 —— 分析 PS4 游戏运行原理与系统调用实现。

en.tag: Cross-platform PS4 emulator already running exclusives like Bloodborne
en.what: shadPS4 is an early-stage PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++, enabling users to run PS4 titles on Windows, Linux, and macOS. It can already boot and play popular exclusives such as Bloodborne and Yakuza 0, though it remains a work in progress with known issues.
en.content: The repository houses the emulator core, graphics/audio backends, instruction translation modules, and system service implementations, along with documentation, compatibility lists, and screenshots. Users can pair it with the separate QtLauncher for a full GUI experience.
en.stack: Built primarily in C++, it leverages Vulkan and other graphics APIs to translate and render GPU instructions, with cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: Its breakthrough ability to run PS4 exclusives like Bloodborne has drawn massive attention from gamers and developers, earning 332 new stars this week for a total of 32K+ and placing it 16th on GitHub's C++ Trending chart.
uses: Hardcore console gamers who want to play PS4 exclusives on PC or Mac.
Emulator developers studying PS4 system architecture, graphics rendering, and instruction translation.
Open-source contributors helping with compatibility testing, bug fixes, and performance optimization.
Game researchers analyzing PS4 game execution principles and system call implementations.

zh.tag: AI驱动的价值投资研究框架，集成四位大师方法论
zh.what: AI Berkshire 是一套基于 Claude Code / Codex 的价值投资研究 Skill 合集，将巴菲特、芒格、段永平、李录四位大师的方法论系统化，通过多 Agent 并行研究实现专业级投资分析。一个人加上 AI 即可组成投研团队。
zh.content: 仓库包含 20 个 Skill（技能模块）、实盘业绩记录、快速开始指南、实战研究报告以及多语言文档（中英日）。核心是结构化分析流程、反偏见机制和金融数据校验工具。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Claude Code / Codex 作为 AI 引擎，使用命令行工具进行数据校验和报告生成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 13031 星，总星数 13750，因其将 AI Agent 与价值投资实战结合，提供可验证的实盘业绩（两年收益超 69% 和 66%），吸引了大量投资者和 AI 爱好者。
uses: 个人投资者 —— 用 AI 辅助深度研究公司，提高决策质量
量化研究员 —— 借鉴结构化分析框架和反偏见机制
AI 应用开发者 —— 学习多 Agent 协作和金融数据校验的实现

en.tag: AI-powered value investing research framework integrating 4 masters' methodologies
en.what: AI Berkshire is a collection of value investing research Skills built for Claude Code / Codex, systematizing the methodologies of Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping, and Li Lu. It enables professional-grade investment analysis through multi-agent parallel research, turning one person with AI into a full research team.
en.content: The repo contains 20 Skills, real track record, quick start guide, research reports, and multilingual docs (CN/EN/JP). Core features include structured analysis workflows, anti-bias mechanisms, and financial data validation tools.
en.stack: Built on Python, leveraging Claude Code / Codex as the AI engine, with CLI tools for data validation and report generation.
en.hot: Gained 13,031 stars this month (total 13,750) by combining AI agents with real value investing, backed by verified track records (69% and 66% annual returns), attracting investors and AI enthusiasts.

Quantitative researchers — adopt structured analysis and anti-bias mechanisms
AI application developers — learn multi-agent collaboration and financial data validation

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 会议助手，实时转录并自动总结纪要
zh.what: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 开发的 AI 会议助手，支持在 macOS 和 Windows 上实现 100% 本地化的实时会议转录、说话人分离与智能总结。它无需云端连接，通过 Parakeet/Whisper 实现 4 倍速实时转录，并借助 Ollama 自动生成会议纪要，满足企业对隐私与合规的严苛要求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理与转录引擎、Ollama 集成模块，以及面向 macOS 和 Windows 的预编译安装包和演示文档。
zh.stack: 核心采用 Rust 构建以保证高性能与低资源占用，集成 Parakeet/Whisper 语音识别模型实现实时转录，并通过 Ollama 在本地运行大模型完成会议总结。
zh.hot: 在数据隐私监管日益严格的背景下，其「100% 本地处理、零云端」的架构精准击中了企业合规痛点；凭借 25.3K Star 和本月新增 2,854 Star 登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 8，显示出市场对隐私优先型生产力工具的强烈需求。
uses: 企业合规团队 —— 需在完全离线环境下处理敏感会议内容，满足数据主权与隐私合规要求。
远程办公用户 —— 希望自动获得带说话人分离的实时转录与会议纪要，无需上传云端。
开发者与隐私爱好者 —— 寻求可自托管、可审计的开源会议工具，并能基于 Rust 源码二次定制。
咨询与法律行业 —— 在客户机密对话场景中，要求本地存储且可控的 AI 会议记录方案。

en.tag: Privacy-first AI meeting assistant with local transcription & summarization
en.what: Meetily is a Rust-built, privacy-first AI meeting assistant that delivers 100% on-device live transcription, speaker diarization, and smart summarization for macOS and Windows. It runs entirely offline using Parakeet/Whisper for 4x faster real-time transcription and Ollama for automated meeting minutes, ensuring enterprises retain full data sovereignty without cloud dependencies.
en.content: The repository houses the full desktop client source code, a Rust-based local audio processing and transcription engine, Ollama integration modules, along with pre-built installers and documentation for macOS and Windows.
en.stack: The core is built in Rust for high performance and low resource usage, integrating Parakeet/Whisper speech recognition for real-time transcription and leveraging Ollama to run LLMs locally for meeting summarization.
en.hot: Amid tightening data privacy regulations, its "100% local processing, zero cloud" architecture directly addresses enterprise compliance pain points; its 25.3K stars and 2,854 new stars this month—ranking 8th on GitHub Trending—signal strong market demand for privacy-first productivity tools.
uses: Enterprise compliance teams —— Process sensitive meetings in fully offline environments to meet data sovereignty and privacy requirements.
Remote professionals —— Automatically obtain real-time transcripts with speaker diarization and summaries without cloud uploads.
Developers and privacy advocates —— Seek a self-hostable, auditable open-source meeting tool that can be customized via the Rust codebase.
Consulting and legal sectors —— Handle confidential client conversations with locally stored, fully controllable AI meeting records.

zh.tag: 高性能代码智能 MCP 服务器，毫秒级构建代码知识图谱
zh.what: 这是一个专为 AI 编程代理设计的高性能代码智能引擎，通过 Tree-sitter AST 分析将代码库索引为持久化知识图谱。它能在毫秒内完成普通仓库的全量索引，并以亚毫秒级延迟回答结构化查询。作为 MCP 服务器，它提供 15 个工具，支持 43 种客户端接入，可将 Token 消耗降低 99%。
zh.content: 仓库包含纯 C 编写的单静态二进制可执行文件，内置基于 Tree-sitter 的 158 语言解析器与 10 种语言的 Hybrid LSP 语义增强模块。产物为零依赖的跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）二进制，附带 15 个 MCP 工具与 5600+ 测试用例。
zh.stack: 核心采用纯 C 语言实现以保证极致性能与零依赖，通过 tree-sitter 生成 AST 并辅以 Hybrid LSP 进行语义类型解析。编译为单静态二进制分发，无需任何运行时依赖。

en.tag: High-performance code-intelligence MCP server building persistent knowledge graphs in milliseconds
en.what: A high-performance code intelligence engine designed for AI coding agents that indexes entire codebases into persistent knowledge graphs via Tree-sitter AST analysis. It full-indexes average repositories in milliseconds and answers structural queries in under 1ms. As an MCP server, it exposes 15 tools across 43 client surfaces while cutting token usage by 99%.
en.content: A pure-C single static binary with built-in Tree-sitter parsers for 158 languages and Hybrid LSP semantic resolution for 10 languages. Ships as a zero-dependency, cross-platform executable (macOS/Linux/Windows) with 15 MCP tools and over 5,600 passing tests.
en.stack: Built entirely in C for extreme performance and zero dependencies, leveraging tree-sitter for AST generation and Hybrid LSP for semantic type resolution. Distributed as a single static binary requiring no runtime dependencies.
en.hot: Skyrocketed by 28,151 stars this month to 32,528, landing at #2 on GitHub's monthly Trending—reflecting soaring demand for lightning-fast code-intelligence infrastructure in the AI Agent era. It delivers 10× fewer tokens and 2.1× fewer tool calls versus file-by-file exploration, making it a go-to choice for AI-assisted coding workflows.
uses: AI agent developers —— Feed Cursor, Claude Code, and other MCP clients with instant codebase memory and sub-ms structural querying
Large-scale codebase maintainers —— Index multi-million-LOC projects like the Linux kernel in minutes, slashing AI comprehension costs
Efficiency-focused engineers —— Deploy a single zero-dependency binary to get sub-millisecond code search across 158 languages
MCP ecosystem integrators —— Leverage 15 standard tools and 43 client surfaces to build automated code-analysis pipelines

zh.tag: 全球主流AI系统提示词泄露收录与透明度研究

zh.content: 按厂商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI 等）分目录存放各产品的完整系统提示词文本，涵盖常规对话、编程助手（Claude Code、Copilot）、深度研究（Perplexity）等多场景版本。
zh.stack: 以 Markdown 文档为主，辅以简单的 JavaScript 脚本和 GitHub Actions 自动化更新，无需复杂后端依赖。
zh.hot: 本月新增近 3,000 Star 冲上 Trending 月榜第 3，反映出行业与公众对 AI 黑箱指令的极强好奇心；模型版本快速迭代也让提示词考古成为开发者刚需。

en.tag: Leaked system prompts archive for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more
en.what: This repository systematically collects and archives leaked system prompts from leading AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok, exposing the hidden instructions and behavioral rules they receive before processing user messages.
