en.hot: Its 20MB footprint covering 60+ databases, combined with a built-in AI assistant and multi-platform support, resonates with developers' need for lightweight versatility—driving 4,470 new stars this month and a #4 spot on the Rust trending chart.
uses: Multi-database developers — manage heterogeneous DBs like MySQL, PG, Redis, and MongoDB from one tool
Developers favoring lightweight tools — replace bloated client suites with a 20MB alternative
Teams requiring local/self-hosted access — Docker deployment satisfies privacy and unified access needs
DBAs leveraging AI — built-in assistant helps write and optimize SQL queries faster

zh.tag: Git 工作树 + tmux 窗口的零摩擦并行开发管理器，专为 AI Agent 打造
zh.what: workmux 是一款高度定制化的终端工作流工具，通过将 git worktree 与 tmux（以及 kitty、WezTerm、Zellij 等）窗口一一绑定，为每个任务提供独立的开发环境。它特别适合同时运行多个 AI Agent 进行并行编码，无需 stash 或切换分支，实现真正的零摩擦上下文切换。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、核心命令（add、merge 等）、支持多终端后端的适配层、Dashboard 与 Sidebar 界面，以及用于向 worktree 内 Agent 委派任务的 /worktree skill 集成。
zh.stack: 核心由 Rust 编写，底层依赖 git worktree 机制，并支持 tmux、Zellij、Kitty、WezTerm 作为窗口后端，通过 CLI 与终端 UI 进行交互。
zh.hot: 凭借 AI Agent 并行开发的热潮，该仓库在 Rust 周榜排名第 15，目前已获 1,853 Stars，本周新增 73 Star。其'零摩擦'理念——用现有终端工具而非新 GUI——精准切中了开发者对多 Agent 工作流的管理痛点。
uses: 需要同时维护多个功能分支、避免频繁切换上下文的终端开发者
在本地并行运行多个 AI Agent（如编码、review、测试）的工程师
使用 tmux/Zellij/Kitty 等终端复用器并追求自动化工作流的重度 CLI 用户
希望一键清理（合并分支、删除 worktree、关闭窗口）的全栈开发者

en.tag: Git worktree + tmux parallel dev manager built for AI agents
en.what: workmux is a highly opinionated terminal workflow tool that pairs git worktrees with tmux (and kitty, WezTerm, Zellij) windows to create isolated dev environments per task. It is designed to run multiple AI agents in parallel for concurrent coding, eliminating the need to stash or switch branches and enabling true zero-friction context switching.
en.content: The repo includes Rust source code, core commands (add, merge), adapters for multiple terminal backends, a Dashboard and Sidebar UI, and a /worktree skill integration for delegating tasks to agents inside worktrees.
en.stack: Built primarily in Rust, it relies on git worktrees under the hood and supports tmux, Zellij, Kitty, and WezTerm as windowing backends, exposing both CLI and terminal UI interfaces.
en.hot: Riding the wave of AI agent parallel development, it ranks #15 on GitHub Trending Rust, with 1,853 stars and 73 new this week. Its 'zero-friction' philosophy of leveraging existing terminal tools rather than new GUIs directly addresses developer pain points in managing multi-agent workflows.
uses: Terminal developers juggling multiple feature branches who want to avoid constant context switching
Engineers running multiple AI agents (coding, review, testing) in parallel locally
Heavy CLI users of tmux/Zellij/Kitty seeking automated, opinionated workflows
Full-stack developers who want one-command cleanup after merging branches

zh.tag: 基于Rust的GPU加速跨平台终端模拟器与多路复用器
zh.what: WezTerm 是一款由 Rust 编写的高性能终端模拟器，内置终端多路复用功能。它利用 GPU 加速渲染，在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上提供一致的流畅体验，并支持通过 Lua 进行深度定制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的终端仿真引擎、多路复用器实现、Lua 配置运行时以及跨平台窗口层，附带详尽的用户文档与官网源码。
zh.stack: 核心采用 Rust 语言开发，依托 OpenGL / WebGPU 实现 GPU 加速渲染，使用 Lua 提供可编程配置接口，并基于各平台原生 API 构建窗口系统。
zh.hot: 凭借 Rust 的安全与性能优势，WezTerm 在开发者社区迅速走红；目前拥有 27,669 Stars，本月新增 1,068 Star，跻身 GitHub Rust 月榜第 15 位，成为替代传统终端的热门选择。
uses: 进阶开发者与运维工程师 —— 需要 GPU 加速、多标签/多窗口管理的日常终端用户
跨平台工作者 —— 希望在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上保持统一终端体验的开发者
配置控与键盘流用户 —— 追求通过 Lua 脚本深度定制快捷键、外观与行为的极客

en.tag: GPU-accelerated cross-platform terminal emulator and multiplexer in Rust
en.what: WezTerm is a high-performance terminal emulator written in Rust, featuring a built-in terminal multiplexer. It leverages GPU acceleration to deliver smooth, consistent experiences across Windows, macOS, and Linux, with deep customization via Lua configuration.
en.content: The repository contains a full terminal emulation engine, built-in multiplexer, Lua configuration runtime, and cross-platform windowing layer, along with comprehensive user documentation and website source.
en.stack: Core is written in Rust with GPU-accelerated rendering via OpenGL/WebGPU, programmable configuration through Lua, and native platform APIs for windowing.
en.hot: Benefiting from Rust's safety and performance, WezTerm has gained strong traction among developers, amassing 27,669 stars with 1,068 added this month and ranking 15th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Advanced developers and DevOps engineers who need GPU-accelerated, multi-tab terminal sessions
Cross-platform professionals seeking a consistent terminal experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Power users and keyboard-driven workflow enthusiasts who want deep customization via Lua scripting

zh.tag: 受 Kakoune 启发的后现代模态编辑器，Rust 原生内置 LSP 与 Tree-sitter
zh.what: Helix 是一款受 Kakoune 与 Neovim 启发的终端模态文本编辑器，采用 Rust 编写。它将 Kakoune 的选择-操作模型与现代 IDE 功能结合，原生内置语言服务器（LSP）支持。通过 Tree-sitter 提供增量式语法高亮与智能代码编辑，致力于在终端中实现开箱即用的现代开发体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心编辑器源码、基于 tree-sitter 的 runtime 语法查询文件与缩进定义、多平台构建配置及文档。此外还包含实验性的 wgpu 自定义渲染器探索代码，以及完整的键位映射与安装指南。
zh.stack: 核心以 Rust 语言构建，利用 Tree-sitter 进行增量语法解析与高亮，内置 LSP 客户端实现 IDE 级代码补全与诊断。终端界面基于自有渲染层，并正探索以 wgpu 实现跨平台图形化前端。
zh.hot: 仓库已斩获 45.5k Stars，本月新增 735 并跻身 Rust 月榜第 12，反映出开发者对「模态编辑现代化」的强烈需求。它无需繁琐配置即可提供与 VS Code 相当的 LSP 和语法高亮体验，精准击中了 Vim/Neovim 用户渴望「开箱即用」的痛点。
uses: 追求极致键盘效率的终端开发者——希望获得 Vim 级模态编辑但不想手动配置插件
Rust 及系统编程爱好者——需要原生高性能、低资源占用的跨平台编辑器
偏好开箱即用 IDE 功能的用户——需要内置 LSP、语法高亮与多光标选择的现代化支持

en.tag: Post-modern modal editor in Rust, inspired by Kakoune with built-in LSP and tree-sitter
en.what: Helix is a terminal-based modal text editor written in Rust, heavily inspired by Kakoune and Neovim. It combines Kakoune’s selection-action editing model with modern IDE features like built-in language server protocol (LSP) support. Smart, incremental syntax highlighting and code editing are powered by tree-sitter, aiming for an out-of-the-box modern development experience in the terminal.
en.content: The repository holds the Rust-based core editor source, tree-sitter runtime query files and indentation definitions, multi-platform build configurations, and documentation. It also includes experimental code for a custom wgpu renderer, along with comprehensive keymaps and installation guides.
en.stack: Built primarily in Rust, it leverages tree-sitter for incremental parsing and syntax highlighting, and includes a native LSP client for IDE-grade code intelligence. The terminal UI runs on a custom rendering layer, with ongoing experiments toward a cross-platform GUI frontend using wgpu.
en.hot: With 45.5k stars and 735 new stars this month, ranking 12th on the GitHub Trending Rust monthly list, Helix reflects strong demand for a modernized modal editing experience. It hits the sweet spot for Vim/Neovim users by offering IDE-grade LSP and tree-sitter features out of the box, without the burden of heavy configuration.
uses: Terminal-centric developers seeking Vim-level modal efficiency without manual plugin configuration
Rust and systems programming enthusiasts who demand a native, high-performance, low-resource editor
Users preferring an out-of-the-box IDE experience with built-in LSP, syntax highlighting, and multiple selections

zh.tag: 开源本地优先的个人财务与投资组合追踪器
zh.what: Wealthfolio 是一款开源、本地优先的个人财务与投资追踪工具，可在设备端私密管理投资组合、净资产、日常支出并运行财务模拟。它无需云端账户即可永久免费使用，同时提供可选的订阅服务来接入 30 余家券商的自动同步与加密多设备同步。
zh.content: 仓库采用 Rust 后端与前端应用结合的全栈架构，包含桌面端（macOS / Windows / Linux）、移动端（iOS）以及 Docker 自托管部署方案。代码库涵盖核心财务数据处理、本地数据库、前端 UI 以及可选的 Wealthfolio Connect 同步服务接口。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为核心后端，搭配现代前端技术构建跨平台桌面与移动客户端，支持 Docker 自托管部署。数据完全本地化存储，同时通过 Wealthfolio Connect 提供可选的加密云端同步与券商数据接入。
zh.hot: 在数据隐私焦虑日益加剧的背景下，这款本地优先、无需账户即可永久免费使用的个人财务工具精准击中了用户痛点，本月新增 681 Star 并跻身 GitHub Trending Rust 月榜前 20。其优雅的开源定位与可选的券商自动同步订阅模式，也为个人理财工具树立了新的隐私标杆。
uses: 注重财务隐私的个人用户 —— 希望投资与消费数据完全保留在本地的个人理财者
跨平台桌面与移动端用户 —— 需要在 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 iOS 间无缝查看资产的人群
自托管与开源爱好者 —— 偏好使用 Docker 部署并完全掌控数据的开发者与技术用户
被动投资与净资产追踪者 —— 需要跟踪多券商投资组合、净资产变化及未来模拟的投资者

en.tag: Local-first, privacy-focused open-source portfolio & personal finance tracker.
en.what: Wealthfolio is an open-source, local-first personal finance and investment tracker that lets you privately manage portfolios, net worth, spending, and simulations on your own device. It requires no cloud account and is free forever for manual tracking and CSV imports, with an optional subscription for automatic brokerage syncing across 30+ institutions and encrypted multi-device sync.
en.content: The repo contains a full-stack Rust-backed application with desktop clients for macOS, Windows, and Linux, an iOS app, and a Docker self-hosting option. It includes core financial data processing, a local database, frontend UI, and interfaces for the optional Wealthfolio Connect sync service.
en.stack: Built primarily in Rust on the backend with a modern frontend stack powering cross-platform desktop and mobile clients, packaged for macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS. It also supports Docker-based self-hosting and optional encrypted cloud sync via Wealthfolio Connect.
en.hot: Amid growing privacy concerns, its local-first, account-free, and forever-free approach has resonated strongly with users, earning 681 new stars this month and breaking into the top 20 of GitHub’s Rust monthly trending list. The elegant balance between open-source self-custody and an optional brokerage-sync subscription sets a new benchmark for privacy-centric personal finance tools.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want investment and spending data to remain strictly on their own devices.
Cross-platform users who need seamless access to their net worth and portfolios across desktop and iOS.
Self-hosting enthusiasts and developers who prefer open-source tools and Docker-based deployment.
Passive investors and net-worth trackers looking to monitor multi-brokerage holdings, spending, and run financial simulations.

zh.tag: 兼容 Git 的下一代版本控制系统
zh.what: Jujutsu 是一个从头设计、兼顾易用性与强大功能的版本控制系统。它抽象了用户界面与存储后端，目前使用 Git 仓库作为存储层，因此兼容现有 Git 工具链。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Jujutsu 的 Rust 源码、文档、安装指南、教程及开发路线图。核心开发者使用它管理自身代码。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Git 作为存储后端，支持多种平台。
zh.hot: 作为 Git 的潜在替代品，Jujutsu 提供了更简洁的命令和更智能的冲突处理，吸引了 3 万+ Star，本月新增近 900 Star。
uses: 开发者——寻求更直观、高效的版本控制体验
团队——希望简化 Git 工作流并减少合并冲突
Git 用户——想尝试兼容 Git 的新工具
开源项目——评估下一代 VCS 作为 Git 的替代

en.tag: A next-gen VCS that's Git-compatible, simple, and powerful
en.what: Jujutsu is a version control system designed from the ground up for ease of use and power. It abstracts the UI from storage backends, currently using Git repos as a storage layer, making it compatible with existing Git tools.
en.content: The repo contains Jujutsu's Rust source code, documentation, installation guides, tutorials, and a development roadmap. Core developers use it to develop Jujutsu itself.
en.stack: Written in Rust, relies on Git as a storage backend, cross-platform.
en.hot: As a potential Git replacement, Jujutsu offers cleaner commands and smarter conflict resolution, amassing 30k+ stars with ~900 new stars this month.
uses: Developers — seeking a more intuitive and efficient version control experience
Teams — wanting to simplify Git workflows and reduce merge conflicts
Git users — looking to try a new Git-compatible tool
Open-source projects — evaluating next-gen VCS as a Git alternative

zh.tag: 高性能向量数据库与搜索引擎，为 AI 应用而生
zh.what: Qdrant 是一个用 Rust 编写的高性能向量相似度搜索引擎和向量数据库。它提供生产就绪的服务和便捷的 API，用于存储、搜索和管理带有额外负载的向量点。Qdrant 专为扩展过滤支持而设计，适用于神经网络匹配、分面搜索等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Qdrant 核心引擎的源代码、客户端库（Python、Go、Rust 等）、演示项目以及集成示例。还提供预构建的 Docker 镜像和云服务（含免费层）。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，利用其内存安全和并发特性实现高性能。依赖包括 gRPC、REST API、以及多种索引算法（如 HNSW）。
zh.hot: Qdrant 凭借其卓越的性能和易用性，在 AI 驱动的向量搜索领域迅速崛起。本月新增 1027 颗星，总星数达 33567，反映了开发者对高效向量数据库的强烈需求。
uses: AI 开发者 —— 构建语义搜索、推荐系统或 RAG 应用
数据科学家 —— 快速原型设计和部署向量相似度匹配
企业团队 —— 生产级向量存储，支持高并发和扩展过滤
云原生用户 —— 通过 Docker 或 Qdrant Cloud 快速集成

en.tag: High-performance vector database and search engine for AI applications
en.what: Qdrant is a high-performance vector similarity search engine and vector database written in Rust. It provides a production-ready service with a convenient API to store, search, and manage points—vectors with additional payload. Tailored for extended filtering support, it is useful for neural-network matching, faceted search, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the core engine source code, client libraries (Python, Go, Rust, etc.), demo projects, and integration examples. Pre-built Docker images and a managed cloud service (with free tier) are also available.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging its memory safety and concurrency for high performance. Dependencies include gRPC, REST API, and indexing algorithms like HNSW.
en.hot: Qdrant has rapidly gained traction in AI-driven vector search due to its outstanding performance and ease of use. With 1,027 new stars this month and a total of 33,567 stars, it reflects strong developer demand for efficient vector databases.
uses: AI developers — building semantic search, recommendation systems, or RAG applications
Data scientists — rapid prototyping and deploying vector similarity matching
Enterprise teams — production-grade vector storage with high concurrency and extended filtering
Cloud-native users — quick integration via Docker or Qdrant Cloud

zh.tag: 高通设备上本地运行前沿大模型的最简方案
zh.what: GenieX 是一个面向高通骁龙设备的端侧生成式 AI 推理运行时。它允许开发者用几行代码在 Hexagon NPU、Adreno GPU 或 CPU 上运行来自 Hugging Face 的 GGUF 模型或高通 AI Hub 的预编译包。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个统一的 C SDK，通过 CLI、Python、Kotlin/Java、Docker 和 OpenAI 兼容服务器暴露。底层集成了 llama.cpp 运行时（GGML 在 CPU/GPU/Hexagon HTP 上）和高通 AI Engine Direct 运行时（NPU 上）。
zh.stack: Rust 编写核心，依赖 llama.cpp (GGML)、Qualcomm AI Engine Direct、Hexagon HTP 内核。支持 Windows ARM64、Android、Linux ARM64。
zh.hot: 高通官方开源社区版 GENIE，让开发者无需云端即可在骁龙设备上运行前沿模型，月增 159 星，总星 8247，位列 Rust 月榜第 19。
uses: 高通骁龙设备上的 AI 应用开发者 —— 快速集成本地推理能力
边缘计算与 IoT 场景 —— 在 Linux ARM64 设备上部署模型
移动端 AI 开发 —— 通过 Android SDK 在手机上运行 LLM/VLM
研究与原型设计 —— 在本地快速测试 GGUF 模型

en.tag: The easiest way to run frontier LLMs & VLMs locally on Qualcomm devices
en.what: GenieX is an on-device Gen AI inference runtime for Qualcomm Snapdragon devices. It lets developers run GGUF models from Hugging Face or pre-compiled bundles from Qualcomm AI Hub on Hexagon NPU, Adreno GPU, or CPU with just a few lines of code.
en.content: The repo contains a single C SDK exposed via CLI, Python, Kotlin/Java, Docker, and an OpenAI-compatible server. Under the hood, it integrates the llama.cpp runtime (GGML over CPU/GPU/Hexagon HTP) and the Qualcomm AI Engine Direct runtime on the NPU.
en.stack: Core written in Rust, depends on llama.cpp (GGML), Qualcomm AI Engine Direct, Hexagon HTP kernels. Supports Windows ARM64, Android, Linux ARM64.
en.hot: Qualcomm's official open-source community version of GENIE, enabling developers to run frontier models on Snapdragon devices without the cloud. Gained 159 stars this month, total 8247, ranked #19 on Rust monthly trending.
uses: AI app developers on Qualcomm Snapdragon devices — quickly integrate on-device inference
Edge computing & IoT scenarios — deploy models on Linux ARM64 devices
Mobile AI development — run LLMs/VLMs on phones via Android SDK
Research & prototyping — test GGUF models locally

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面，自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面软件，开箱即用，无需复杂配置。它支持自建中继/信令服务器，让用户完全掌控自己的数据，无需担心安全问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 RustDesk 客户端和服务器的完整源代码，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、iOS、Android 等多平台。还提供了 Docker 构建方式、多语言翻译文件以及详细的文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Flutter 构建跨平台 UI，使用 protobuf 进行通信协议定义。
zh.hot: RustDesk 凭借完全开源、自托管、高性能和跨平台支持，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代品。目前拥有 118,854 颗星，本月新增 2240 星，持续受到社区追捧。
uses: 个人用户 —— 需要免费、安全的远程桌面访问家庭或办公电脑
IT 管理员 —— 为企业部署自托管远程支持方案，确保数据隐私
开发者 —— 研究 Rust 和 Flutter 构建跨平台应用的参考项目
教育机构 —— 提供远程教学和技术支持的免费工具

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust. It works out of the box with no configuration and allows users to self-host their own rendezvous/relay server, giving full control over data and security.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for the RustDesk client and server, supporting multiple platforms including Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android. It also includes Docker build instructions, multilingual translation files, and comprehensive documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and protobuf for communication protocol definition.
en.hot: RustDesk has become a popular alternative to commercial remote desktop solutions like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source nature, self-hosting capability, high performance, and cross-platform support. With 118,854 stars and 2,240 new stars this month, it continues to gain community traction.
uses: Individual users — need free and secure remote desktop access to home or office computers
IT administrators — deploy self-hosted remote support solutions for enterprises ensuring data privacy
Developers — reference project for building cross-platform apps with Rust and Flutter
Educational institutions — free tool for remote teaching and technical support

zh.tag: 可扩展的 SQL 查询引擎，用 Rust 实现
zh.what: Apache DataFusion 是一个高性能、可扩展的 SQL 查询引擎，专为构建现代数据平台而设计。它支持 SQL 和 DataFrame API，可嵌入到其他应用中，并提供了丰富的优化器和执行引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心查询引擎、优化器、执行运行时以及多种数据源连接器。代码结构清晰，包括 SQL 解析、逻辑计划、物理计划、表达式求值等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Arrow 列式内存格式和 Parquet 文件格式。可选集成 Object Store、Protobuf 等。
zh.hot: DataFusion 是 Apache 顶级项目，凭借高性能和可扩展性，在 Rust 数据生态中占据核心地位。本月新增 110 星，总星数 9019，持续吸引数据基础设施开发者。
uses: 数据平台开发者 —— 构建自定义查询引擎或数据仓库
嵌入式分析 —— 在应用中集成 SQL 查询能力
数据科学 —— 使用 DataFrame API 进行大规模数据处理

en.tag: Extensible SQL query engine implemented in Rust
en.what: Apache DataFusion is a high-performance, extensible SQL query engine designed for building modern data platforms. It supports SQL and DataFrame APIs, can be embedded in other applications, and provides a rich optimizer and execution engine.
en.content: The repository contains the core query engine, optimizer, execution runtime, and various data source connectors. The code is well-structured, including modules for SQL parsing, logical plans, physical plans, and expression evaluation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Arrow columnar memory format and Parquet file format. Optional integrations include Object Store, Protobuf, etc.
en.hot: As an Apache top-level project, DataFusion holds a core position in the Rust data ecosystem due to its high performance and extensibility. With 110 new stars this month and 9019 total stars, it continues to attract data infrastructure developers.
uses: Data platform developers — building custom query engines or data warehouses
Embedded analytics — integrating SQL query capabilities into applications
Data science — using DataFrame API for large-scale data processing

zh.tag: 基于 Rust 的现代化 JavaScript/TypeScript 安全运行时
zh.what: Deno 是一个基于 V8、Rust 和 Tokio 构建的 JavaScript、TypeScript 与 WebAssembly 运行时，默认启用安全沙箱和权限控制。它提供出色的开发者体验，可用于构建 Web 服务器、CLI 工具及各类现代应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Deno 运行时核心源码、CLI 工具链、标准库以及完整文档。用户可通过官方脚本或包管理器一键安装，也支持从源码编译。
zh.stack: 核心引擎基于 Google V8 执行 JavaScript，底层使用 Rust 编写，异步 IO 由 Tokio 驱动，并支持 WebAssembly。
zh.hot: 作为 Node.js 的现代化替代方案，Deno 凭借原生 TypeScript 支持、内置安全权限和单一可执行文件等优势持续吸引开发者。目前累计获星 107,711 颗，本周新增 290 星并跻身 Rust 语言周榜第 12 位。
uses: 前端/后端开发者：希望用原生 TypeScript 开发高性能 Web 服务与 API。
DevOps 与 CLI 工具开发者：需要安全沙箱和单一可执行文件部署脚本。
Rust/JavaScript 混合生态建设者：寻求基于 V8 和 Rust 的高性能运行时。
云原生应用开发者：利用 Deno Deploy 等边缘计算平台快速部署。

en.tag: Modern Rust-based JavaScript/TypeScript runtime with secure defaults
en.what: Deno is a JavaScript, TypeScript, and WebAssembly runtime built on V8, Rust, and Tokio, featuring secure-by-default permissions and sandboxing. It delivers a great developer experience for building web servers, CLI tools, and modern applications.
en.content: The repository houses the Deno runtime core, CLI toolchain, standard library, and comprehensive documentation. It supports one-line installation via official scripts or package managers, as well as building from source.
en.stack: Built on the Google V8 engine for JavaScript execution, with a Rust-written core and Tokio-powered asynchronous I/O, plus WebAssembly support.
en.hot: As a modern alternative to Node.js, Deno continues to attract developers with native TypeScript support, built-in security permissions, and a single executable. It has amassed 107,711 stars, gaining 290 this week and ranking 12th on the Rust trending chart.
uses: Frontend/backend developers building high-performance web services and APIs with native TypeScript.
DevOps and CLI tool developers who need secure sandboxing and single-binary deployment.
Builders of hybrid Rust/JavaScript ecosystems seeking a high-performance V8-based runtime.
Cloud-native developers leveraging Deno Deploy for rapid edge-computing deployment.

zh.tag: Rust 语言官方源码仓，包含编译器与标准库
zh.what: Rust 编程语言官方主仓库，包含编译器、标准库及文档。致力于通过所有权模型和类型系统，让开发者构建高性能且内存安全的系统级软件。
zh.content: 包含 Rust 编译器（rustc）、标准库、官方文档、测试套件及构建脚本。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 自举编译，依赖 LLVM 作为后端，配合 Cargo、rustfmt、Clippy 及 rust-analyzer 构成完整工具链。
zh.hot: 拥有 11.4 万 Star 并长期稳居 Rust 语言周榜前列，得益于其“零成本抽象”与内存安全特性，已成为系统编程、区块链及云原生基础设施的首选语言。
uses: 系统编程开发者 —— 需要高性能且内存安全的底层软件开发
区块链/Web3 工程师 —— 构建高效、可靠的智能合约与节点程序
云原生与基础设施开发者 —— 用于编写容器、微服务及 DevOps 工具
编程语言爱好者与研究者 —— 学习现代类型系统、所有权模型及编译器实现

en.tag: Official Rust language source repo with compiler and standard library
en.what: This is the official main source repository for the Rust programming language, containing the compiler, standard library, and documentation. It empowers developers to build reliable and efficient software through its ownership model and rich type system.
en.content: The repository houses the Rust compiler (rustc), standard library, official documentation, test suites, and build scripts.
en.stack: Self-hosted Rust compiler with LLVM backend, accompanied by Cargo, rustfmt, Clippy, and rust-analyzer for a complete toolchain.
en.hot: With 114.7K stars and consistently ranking on the Rust trending list, its zero-cost abstractions and memory safety guarantees have made it the go-to choice for systems programming, blockchain, and cloud-native infrastructure.
uses: Systems programmers building high-performance, memory-safe low-level software
Blockchain and Web3 engineers developing efficient smart contracts and node implementations
Cloud-native and infrastructure developers creating containers, microservices, and DevOps tooling
Programming language enthusiasts and researchers studying modern type systems, ownership models, and compiler design

zh.tag: Git预提交AI代理网关，自动把关代码质量并生成干净PR
zh.what: no-mistakes 在本地与远程仓库之间架设了一层 Git 代理，所有代码在真正推送到 origin 之前，都会先进入一个隔离的临时工作树。它会自动触发 AI 驱动的验证流水线（review、test、lint、docs），只有全部检查通过后才转发分支，并自动创建干净的 Pull Request。开发者无需中断当前工作，既可让 AI 自动修复机械性问题，也能把涉及意图的改动提交人工审核。
zh.content: 仓库主体是一个 Go 编写的 CLI，核心包含本地 Git 代理、多 Agent 适配层（Claude、Codex、Cursor、Copilot 等）以及流水线执行引擎。它通过创建临时工作树实现非阻塞验证，并附带自动发布与跨平台构建配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 开发，利用 Git 工作树与代理机制拦截推送，通过可扩展的 AI Agent 接口（acpx 等）串联 Review、Test、Lint 等关卡，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows 三平台。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程助手爆发式普及的当下，该工具切中了‘AI 生成代码质量不可控’的痛点，月增 5063 Star、总星数 6439、位列 GitHub 月榜第 4，说明开发者对‘Agent 原生’的自动化代码把关与干净 PR 工作流需求强烈。
uses: 使用 AI 编程助手（Cursor、Copilot、Claude Code 等）的开发者，想在 push 前自动验证 AI 生成的代码
追求干净 PR 与高质量代码审查的工程师团队，希望把 lint、test、review 统一到 push 前阶段
需要非阻塞式本地验证的开发者，不想因流水线执行而打断当前编码节奏
开源贡献者，希望自动修复机械性问题并减少因疏忽导致的 CI 失败

en.tag: Git pre-push AI agent gateway that auto-validates code and opens clean PRs
en.what: no-mistakes acts as a local Git proxy between your branch and the remote. Before anything reaches origin, your push is spun into a disposable worktree where an AI-driven validation pipeline runs review, tests, lint, and docs checks. Only after every gate passes does it forward the branch and open a clean PR automatically, applying safe auto-fixes while escalating intent-related changes for human review without disrupting your current workspace.
en.content: The repo is primarily a Go-based CLI comprising a local Git proxy core, multi-agent adapters for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and others via acpx, and a configurable pipeline runner. It manages disposable worktrees for non-blocking validation and ships with automated release workflows and cross-platform builds.
en.stack: Written in Go, it intercepts pushes via Git worktree and proxy mechanisms, chains review, test, and lint gates through pluggable AI agent interfaces like acpx, and supports macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants go mainstream, it directly addresses the pain point of uncontrolled AI-generated code quality, earning 5,063 new stars this month for a total of 6,439 and ranking 4th on GitHub's monthly trending list—reflecting strong demand for agent-native automated code gating and clean PR workflows.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) who want automated validation before pushing AI-generated code
Engineering teams pursuing clean PRs and high-quality code reviews by unifying lint, test, and review into a pre-push stage
Developers needing non-blocking local validation that doesn't interrupt their current coding flow
Open-source contributors who want mechanical issues auto-fixed and fewer CI failures from oversight

zh.tag: Kubernetes 声明式 GitOps 持续交付工具
zh.what: Argo CD 是面向 Kubernetes 的声明式 GitOps 持续交付工具，通过监控 Git 仓库中的配置声明自动将应用状态同步到目标集群。它支持 Kustomize、Helm、Jsonnet 等多种配置管理工具，让应用部署和生命周期管理实现自动化、可审计且易于理解。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Argo CD 核心服务端、Web UI、CLI 命令行工具及完整文档，源码以 Go 为主，同时提供 Helm Chart 和标准化安装清单。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，深度依赖 Kubernetes 及其 API，前端采用 React/TypeScript 构建，并集成 Kustomize、Helm、Jsonnet 等主流配置管理工具。
zh.hot: 作为云原生 GitOps 领域的标杆项目，Argo CD 已获 23.6k+ Star，本周新增 163 Star 并跻身 Go 语言周榜第 4，反映出 Kubernetes 社区对声明式交付和自动化运维的强烈需求。
uses: 云平台运维团队 —— 需要为多个 Kubernetes 集群实现声明式、自动化的应用持续交付
DevOps 工程师 —— 希望以 Git 为唯一可信源，落地 GitOps 工作流并提升部署可审计性
云原生架构师 —— 构建多环境（开发/测试/生产）一致性的 Kubernetes 应用交付体系

en.tag: Declarative GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes
en.what: Argo CD is a declarative GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes that automatically syncs application states to target clusters by monitoring configuration declarations in Git repositories. It supports multiple configuration management tools including Kustomize, Helm, and Jsonnet, enabling automated, auditable, and transparent application deployment and lifecycle management.
en.content: The repository contains the Argo CD core server, Web UI, CLI tool, and comprehensive documentation. The source code is primarily written in Go, with Helm charts and standard installation manifests provided.
en.stack: Built primarily in Go and relies on Kubernetes and its APIs. The frontend is built with React/TypeScript, and it integrates configuration management tools including Kustomize, Helm, and Jsonnet.
en.hot: As a landmark project in the cloud-native GitOps space, Argo CD has garnered over 23.6k stars, with 163 new stars this week and a ranking of #4 on the GitHub Go Trending weekly list, reflecting strong community demand for declarative delivery and automated operations in Kubernetes environments.
uses: Platform/Ops teams —— Automating declarative app delivery across multiple Kubernetes clusters
DevOps engineers —— Implementing GitOps workflows with Git as the single source of truth for auditable deployments
Cloud-native architects —— Building consistent Kubernetes application delivery pipelines across dev, test, and production environments

zh.tag: 容器安全沙箱与用户态应用内核，兼容 K8s/Docker
zh.what: gVisor 是 Google 开源的容器应用内核，用 Go 语言在用户态实现了一套 Linux 兼容接口，为容器提供额外的安全隔离层。它通过限制应用对宿主机内核的直接访问，大幅降低容器逃逸风险，同时保持接近原生容器的启动速度与资源开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含 runsc（兼容 OCI 的容器运行时）、Sentry（用户态内核）、Gofer（文件系统代理）等核心组件，以及大量 Linux 系统调用的 Go 语言实现与测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要采用 Go 语言编写，支持 x86_64 与 ARM64 架构；作为 OCI 运行时可直接对接 Docker、containerd 与 Kubernetes 生态。
zh.hot: 在容器安全需求激增的背景下，gVisor 以近 1.9 万 Star 成为云原生沙箱的热门选择，本周新增 85 Star 并跻身 Go 语言周榜第 13 位，体现了社区对"轻量隔离"方案的持续追捧。
uses: 云原生平台运维者 —— 为多租户集群或不可信工作负载提供安全沙箱。
安全合规团队 —— 在保持容器敏捷性的同时满足更严格的内核隔离要求。
边缘与 Serverless 开发者 —— 利用快速启动、低开销的用户态内核运行短时函数或微服务。

en.tag: Userspace application kernel for sandboxed containers with OCI/K8s compatibility
en.what: gVisor is an open-source application kernel from Google that implements a Linux-compatible interface in userspace using Go, adding an extra security isolation layer to containers. By limiting direct access to the host kernel, it significantly reduces container escape risks while maintaining near-native startup speed and resource overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the runsc OCI runtime, the Sentry userspace kernel, the Gofer filesystem proxy, and extensive Go implementations of Linux system calls along with test suites.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go and supports x86_64 and ARM64 architectures; as an OCI runtime it integrates directly with Docker, containerd, and Kubernetes.
en.hot: With nearly 19k stars, gVisor is trending as a top cloud-native sandbox amid surging container security demands; its 85 new stars this week and #13 spot on the Go trending list reflect strong community interest in lightweight isolation.
uses: Cloud-native platform operators —— providing secure sandboxes for multi-tenant clusters or untrusted workloads.
Security and compliance teams —— meeting stricter kernel isolation requirements without sacrificing container agility.
Edge and serverless developers —— leveraging fast-start, low-overhead userspace kernels for short-lived functions or microservices.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网与远程访问基础设施
zh.what: Tailscale 基于 WireGuard 协议构建安全的虚拟专用网络，让用户无需公网 IP 或端口转发即可将设备组成私有网络。它集成了身份验证和两因素认证（2FA），简化了团队和设备之间的安全远程访问与内网穿透。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含 tailscaled 守护进程与 tailscale 命令行工具的核心源码，覆盖 Linux、Windows、macOS 及 BSD 系统的网络栈与控制逻辑。移动端 App 的底层网络库亦来源于此，但各平台 GUI 包装代码位于其他独立仓库。
zh.stack: 项目以 Go 语言为主开发，要求使用最新版 Go 1.26 编译，并基于 WireGuard 协议实现加密通信。构建脚本 `build_dist.sh` 用于将版本信息嵌入二进制，支持多种 Linux 发行版及跨平台打包。
zh.hot: 凭借“零配置”即可在任意设备间建立加密组网的能力，Tailscale 已成为远程办公和云原生时代的核心网络工具，GitHub 累计获得 34k+ Stars，本周再以 583 新增 Star 登上 Go 语言 Trending 榜第 2 名。
uses: 远程办公团队 —— 无需公网 IP 即可安全访问公司内网与私有云资源
开发运维人员 —— 快速搭建跨云、跨地域的容器与服务器调试网络
个人技术爱好者 —— 将家庭 NAS、树莓派等设备组成加密私有网络
安全合规企业 —— 基于 SSO/2FA 的零信任网络替代传统 VPN 方案

en.tag: Zero-config WireGuard VPN for secure remote access and private networking
en.what: Tailscale builds secure virtual private networks on top of WireGuard, allowing devices to form a private mesh network without public IPs or port forwarding. It integrates identity-based authentication and two-factor authentication (2FA) to simplify secure remote access and intranet penetration for teams and devices.
en.content: The repository primarily contains the core source code for the `tailscaled` daemon and the `tailscale` CLI tool, covering the networking stack and control logic for Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD systems. It also serves as the underlying network library for mobile apps, while platform-specific GUI wrappers reside in separate repositories.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go and requiring the latest Go 1.26 release, it implements encrypted communication over the WireGuard protocol. The `build_dist.sh` script embeds version metadata into binaries, supporting packaging for multiple Linux distributions and cross-platform deployments.
en.hot: Its "zero-config" approach to encrypted mesh networking across any device has made it an essential tool for remote work and cloud-native environments. With over 34k total stars and 583 new stars this week, it ranks #2 on GitHub's Go Trending chart, reflecting strong community traction.
uses: Remote teams — Securely access corporate intranets and private cloud resources without public IPs
DevOps engineers — Quickly build debug networks across multi-cloud and multi-region servers and containers
Homelab enthusiasts — Encrypt and interconnect personal devices like NAS and Raspberry Pi into a private mesh
Security-focused enterprises — Replace legacy VPNs with zero-trust networking based on SSO and 2FA

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 编程助手会话分析与成本追踪工具
zh.what: AgentsView 是一款本地优先的工具，能够自动发现、浏览和搜索你本地所有 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code、Codex、Devin 等）的历史会话。它提供统一的 Web 仪表板与 CLI，帮助用户追踪 token 消耗、分析使用成本并获取深度洞察，且无需注册账户，所有数据均保存在本地 SQLite 中。
zh.content: 项目以单一 Go 二进制文件发布，包含命令行界面（CLI）、可后台运行的本地守护进程（daemon），以及可选的桌面端应用和 Docker 镜像。核心组件包括自动发现各 Agent 会话数据的同步引擎、本地 SQLite 数据存储、用于成本与 token 分析的 Web 仪表板，并支持通过 S3 兼容存储聚合多机会话。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，数据层使用 SQLite 进行本地存储，桌面端为独立应用，同时提供 Docker 容器化部署方案。通过支持 S3 兼容协议实现会话数据的远程聚合，并以本地守护进程实现 CLI 与桌面端的数据共享。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Codex 等）的快速普及，开发者迫切需要统一的成本洞察与历史会话管理工具；该仓库凭借「本地优先、零账户、单二进制」的简洁体验，在一个月内新增 1,736 Star，总星数达 4,407，冲上 GitHub Go 语言月榜第 3 名。
uses: 高频使用 AI 编程助手的开发者 —— 需要追踪 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的每日 token 消耗与成本。
多 Agent 并行的技术团队 —— 希望在本地统一查看、搜索和分析不同 Agent 的历史会话与产出。
注重数据隐私的个人或企业 —— 倾向无需账户、完全本地存储的会话管理与审计方案。
跨设备协作的工程师 —— 利用 S3 兼容存储同步多机会话，实现集中化分析。

en.tag: Local-first session analytics and cost tracker for AI coding agents
en.what: AgentsView is a local-first tool that automatically discovers, browses, and searches historical sessions from all your local AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, Codex, Devin, and more). It provides a unified web dashboard and CLI to track token usage, analyze costs, and surface insights—without requiring any accounts, keeping all data in a local SQLite database.
en.content: The project ships as a single Go binary bundling a CLI, a background local daemon, and an optional desktop app plus Docker image. Its core components include an auto-discovery sync engine for agent sessions, local SQLite storage, a web dashboard for cost and token analytics, and support for aggregating multi-machine sessions via S3-compatible object storage.
en.stack: Built in Go with SQLite as the local data store, packaged as a single binary with an optional desktop app and Docker deployment. It aggregates remote sessions over S3-compatible protocols and uses a local daemon to share data between the CLI and desktop client.
en.hot: As AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex proliferate, developers urgently need a unified way to manage session history and control costs. Its “local-first, no accounts, single binary” design earned it 1,736 new stars this month, bringing the total to 4,407 and landing it at #3 on GitHub’s monthly Go trending chart.
uses: Heavy AI coding agent users who need to track daily token consumption and costs for tools like Claude Code and Codex.
Teams running multiple agents in parallel who want a unified, local interface to search and analyze session history across tools.
Privacy-conscious individuals and enterprises requiring zero-account, fully local session storage and audit trails.
Engineers working across multiple machines who want to centralize analytics by syncing sessions via S3-compatible storage.

zh.tag: 云原生监控告警系统与多维时序数据库
zh.what: Prometheus 是 CNCF 毕业项目，通过拉取模式采集目标指标，基于多维数据模型存储时序数据，并提供 PromQL 查询与灵活的告警规则。它能独立完成监控、可视化与告警闭环，无需依赖分布式存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Prometheus 主服务源码、PromQL 查询引擎、告警规则评估器、HTTP API、多种服务发现适配器，以及官方文档与架构图。
zh.stack: 以 Go 为主语言实现，支持通过 HTTP 拉取或 Push Gateway 接收指标，可与 Grafana 等可视化工具及多种服务发现后端（Kubernetes、Consul 等）集成。
zh.hot: 作为云原生监控的事实标准，Prometheus 已积累 65,191 Stars，本周新增 277，位列 GitHub Go 周榜第 14，是 Kubernetes 生态不可或缺的观测基础设施。
uses: SRE / 运维团队 —— 构建云原生监控与统一告警体系
后端开发者 —— 为微服务与容器集群埋点暴露指标
企业 IT 架构 —— 进行基础设施监控、容量规划与故障定位
平台厂商 —— 集成或基于 Prometheus 二次开发可观测性产品

en.tag: Cloud-native monitoring and multi-dimensional time series database
en.what: A CNCF graduated project that scrapes metrics from targets using a pull model, stores them in a multi-dimensional time series model, and offers PromQL querying with flexible alerting. It operates as autonomous single nodes without distributed storage dependencies.
en.content: The repository holds the Prometheus server source, PromQL query engine, rule evaluator, HTTP APIs, various service discovery adapters, plus official documentation and architecture diagrams.
en.stack: Implemented primarily in Go, supporting HTTP scraping or Push Gateway ingestion, and integrating with visualization tools like Grafana and service discovery backends such as Kubernetes and Consul.
en.hot: With 65,191 stars and 277 new this week, it ranks #14 on GitHub's Go Trending weekly list, serving as the de facto observability standard in the Kubernetes and cloud-native ecosystem.
uses: SRE / DevOps teams — building unified cloud-native monitoring and alerting stacks
Backend developers — instrumenting microservices and container clusters with metrics
Enterprise IT — monitoring infrastructure, capacity planning, and incident diagnosis
Platform vendors — integrating or extending Prometheus for commercial observability offerings

zh.tag: 生产级容器编排与调度平台
zh.what: Kubernetes（K8s）是开源的容器集群管理系统，用于自动化部署、扩展和管理容器化应用。它基于 Google 十五年大规模运行生产工作负载的 Borg 系统经验构建，能够跨多台主机实现高效的资源调度与自愈。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面组件（kube-apiserver、kube-scheduler、kube-controller-manager）、节点代理 kubelet、命令行工具 kubectl，以及完整的内置 API 和丰富的扩展机制（如 CRD、Operator、CNI/CSI/CRI 插件接口）。
zh.stack: 核心以 Go 语言编写，使用 etcd 作为分布式键值存储，组件间通过 gRPC/HTTP 通信，并基于容器运行时接口（CRI）对接 Docker、containerd 等底层运行时。

zh.tag: 极速 C++ 日志库，支持头文件-only与编译双模式

zh.tag: 跨语言高性能开源 RPC 框架与通信基础设施
zh.what: gRPC 是由 Google 开源的现代高性能远程过程调用（RPC）框架，旨在让客户端与服务端应用透明通信。它基于 HTTP/2 和 Protocol Buffers 构建，支持多种编程语言，简化了分布式连接系统的构建。

en.tag: Cross-language, high-performance open-source RPC framework

zh.tag: 阿里开源轻量级进程内向量数据库，支持混合检索与全文搜索

Heterogeneous adaptation developers — Systems engineers working on backend porting, operator optimization, and hardware plugin integration for inference engines.

zh.tag: 跨平台 C++ 异步网络与底层 I/O 基础设施库
zh.what: Asio 是一个跨平台的 C++ 库，专注于提供异步网络与底层 I/O 编程能力，统一封装了各操作系统的复杂原生 API。开发者可用它高效构建 TCP/UDP 套接字、串口通信及定时器等组件，广泛应用于高并发服务器、实时系统和嵌入式通信场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件-only 与源码编译两种形态的完整实现，以及示例程序、单元测试和离线 HTML 文档。根目录按 src、include、doc、example 组织，便于直接集成或打包构建。
zh.stack: 核心为现代 C++（C++11 起），零依赖或可选衔接 Boost，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 及嵌入式平台。编译系统覆盖 Autotools、CMake 和纯 Makefile，适配多种工具链。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 异步网络编程的事实标准之一，Asio 凭借稳定 API 与卓越性能持续吸引开发者，目前获星 6.1k，本周新增 175 星并跻身 C++ 周榜第 8。最新 1.38.1 版本的发布进一步印证了社区对高性能底层 I/O 基础设施的旺盛需求。
uses: 需要构建高并发网络服务或实时通信系统的后端 C++ 开发者
追求跨平台一致 API、不想直接编写操作系统原生 I/O 代码的嵌入式/工具链团队
希望基于成熟异步模型开发游戏服务器、金融行情网关或物联网网关的工程团队

en.tag: Cross-platform C++ library for asynchronous networking and low-level I/O
en.what: Asio is a cross-platform C++ library for network and low-level I/O programming, offering a consistent asynchronous model across operating systems. It abstracts complex native APIs into composable components like TCP/UDP sockets, serial ports, and timers, making it ideal for high-concurrency servers and real-time systems.
en.content: The repository ships the library in both header-only and compiled source forms, alongside examples, unit tests, and offline HTML documentation. It is organized under src, include, doc, and example directories for easy integration or packaging.
en.stack: Written in modern C++ (C++11 and up) with zero mandatory dependencies—optionally interoperable with Boost—and supports Linux, Windows, macOS, and embedded targets. Build systems include Autotools, CMake, and plain Makefiles for broad toolchain compatibility.
en.hot: A de-facto standard for C++ asynchronous networking, Asio maintains strong momentum with 6.1k stars and 175 added this week, ranking 8th on the GitHub C++ Trending list. The recent 1.38.1 release underscores continued community demand for robust, high-performance low-level I/O infrastructure.
uses: Backend C++ developers building high-concurrency network services or real-time communication systems
Embedded and tooling teams seeking a cross-platform, consistent API without managing native OS I/O directly
Engineering teams developing game servers, financial market gateways, or IoT hubs on a proven asynchronous model

zh.tag: 比特币官方核心客户端与全节点验证软件
zh.what: Bitcoin Core 是比特币网络的官方参考实现，负责连接 P2P 网络、下载并完整验证所有区块与交易。它还内置了钱包功能与可选的图形界面，为用户提供完整的比特币交互能力。作为集成与 staging 仓库，它承载了比特币协议最新的开发与稳定代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含比特币协议的核心源码（共识、网络、验证、钱包、GUI），以及构建脚本、测试套件（C++ 单元测试与 Python 功能/回归测试）和开发文档。master 分支为日常开发主线，release 分支与标签用于标记稳定版本，GUI 开发曾在独立仓库进行。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Boost、Qt（可选 GUI）、SQLite/Berkeley DB（钱包）、libsecp256k1 等密码学与网络库。构建系统采用 Autotools，并支持跨平台编译（Windows、Linux、macOS），测试依赖 Python 框架。
zh.hot: 作为比特币网络的官方参考实现，它是区块链领域最具权威性的开源项目之一，拥有近 9 万 Star 的庞大社区认可。本月新增 550 Star 并跻身 GitHub C++ 月榜第 14 名，反映出市场对比特币底层技术持续的高关注度与开发者对协议改进的活跃参与。
uses: 区块链开发者——研究比特币协议共识、网络通信与验证逻辑的参考实现。
节点运维者——部署全节点以独立验证交易、增强网络去中心化与安全性。
安全研究人员——审计核心代码、测试升级补丁或进行密码学相关实验。
加密货币从业者——集成钱包功能或构建基于比特币网络的衍生应用。

en.tag: Bitcoin's official core client and full-node validation software
en.what: Bitcoin Core is the reference implementation of the Bitcoin protocol, connecting to the peer-to-peer network to download and fully validate blocks and transactions. It also includes an integrated wallet and an optional graphical user interface for end-user interaction. As the integration and staging tree, it hosts both the latest development and stable release code for the Bitcoin network.
en.content: The repository contains the core protocol source (consensus, networking, validation, wallet, GUI), build scripts, test suites (C++ unit tests and Python functional/regression tests), and extensive developer documentation. The master branch serves as the daily integration branch, while release branches and tags mark stable versions, with GUI development maintained in a separate repository.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on Boost, Qt (optional GUI), SQLite/Berkeley DB (wallet), libsecp256k1, and other cryptographic/networking libraries. It uses Autotools for building, supports cross-platform compilation on Windows, Linux, and macOS, and leverages Python frameworks for functional testing.
en.hot: As the authoritative reference implementation of the Bitcoin network, it commands nearly 90k stars, reflecting massive community trust. Its addition of 550 stars this month and rank at #14 on GitHub's monthly C++ Trending list signal sustained mainstream interest and active developer engagement in protocol-level improvements.
uses: Blockchain developers — studying the reference implementation of Bitcoin consensus, networking, and validation logic.
Node operators — running full nodes to independently verify transactions and strengthen network decentralization.
Security researchers — auditing core code, testing upgrade patches, and conducting cryptographic experiments.
Crypto builders — integrating wallet functionality or developing applications atop the Bitcoin network.

zh.tag: Google官方C++单元测试与Mock框架，38K+ Star的行业标准
zh.what: GoogleTest是Google开源的C++测试框架，集单元测试与Mock能力于一体。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、参数化测试和死亡测试等特性，帮助开发者高效验证C++代码的正确性。
zh.content: 仓库合并了原GoogleTest与GoogleMock项目，包含测试框架源码、头文件、详细文档及示例代码。
zh.stack: 基于C++17标准构建，使用CMake/Bazel编译，计划引入Abseil作为底层依赖库。
zh.hot: 作为C++生态的事实标准测试框架，GoogleTest已积累38.8K Star，本月新增173星并持续发布1.17.x版本，保持高度活跃。
uses: C++开发者 —— 为项目编写单元测试和集成测试，确保代码质量
需要Mock测试的工程项目 —— 模拟依赖对象，隔离测试复杂系统
开源/企业级C++项目 —— 建立标准化测试流程与CI/CD质量门禁

en.tag: Google's official C++ unit testing and mocking framework, the industry standard
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's open-source C++ testing framework that combines unit testing and mocking capabilities. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, parameterized tests, and death tests to help developers efficiently verify C++ code correctness.
en.content: The repository merges the formerly separate GoogleTest and GoogleMock projects, containing framework source code, headers, comprehensive documentation, and sample code.
en.stack: Built on C++17, compiled with CMake/Bazel, and planning to adopt Abseil as a foundational dependency.
en.hot: With 38.8K stars and 173 new stars this month, GoogleTest remains the de facto standard C++ testing framework, actively maintained with recent 1.17.x releases requiring C++17.
uses: C++ developers —— writing unit and integration tests to ensure code quality
Projects requiring mocking —— simulating dependencies and isolating complex systems for testing
Open-source and enterprise C++ projects —— establishing standardized testing pipelines and CI/CD quality gates

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 日志库（已弃用）
zh.what: glog 是 Google 开发的 C++ 应用级日志库，提供基于 C++ 流式语法的日志 API 和辅助宏。该项目已停止维护，将于 2025-06-30 归档。
zh.content: 仓库包含 glog 的完整源代码、CMake 构建配置、文档和测试用例。
zh.stack: 纯 C++14 实现，依赖 CMake 构建系统，可选依赖 gflags 用于命令行参数。
zh.hot: 尽管已弃用，glog 仍是许多旧项目的依赖，本月新增 131 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 需要稳定日志功能的 C++ 旧项目维护者
希望迁移到 ng-log 或 Abseil Logging 的开发者
学习 Google 日志库设计理念的 C++ 学习者

en.tag: Google's C++ logging library (deprecated)
en.what: glog is a C++ application-level logging library from Google, providing stream-style logging APIs and helper macros. The project is no longer maintained and will be archived on 2025-06-30.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, CMake build configuration, documentation, and test cases for glog.
en.stack: Pure C++14 implementation, built with CMake, optionally depends on gflags for command-line flags.
en.hot: Despite being deprecated, glog remains a dependency for many legacy projects, gaining 131 stars this month and ranking 18th on the C++ monthly trending list.
uses: Maintainers of legacy C++ projects needing stable logging
Developers planning migration to ng-log or Abseil Logging
C++ learners studying Google's logging library design

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个广受欢迎的头文件优先 JSON 库，为 C++ 开发者提供直观、STL 风格的 API 来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它支持将 JSON 与 C++ 数据结构无缝互转，大幅降低了现代 C++ 项目中处理 JSON 的复杂度。
zh.content: 仓库以单头文件（json.hpp）为核心分发形态，同时包含完整的测试套件、基准测试、文档网站源码及多包管理器（Conan、vcpkg 等）支持配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11/14/17 标准库实现，无需外部依赖，仅依赖 STL 容器和模板元编程，支持通过 CMake 构建测试与示例。
zh.hot: 凭借超 5 万 Star 和今日新增 17 Star 登上 C++ 日榜第 10，它已成为 C++ 生态的事实标准 JSON 库。其“像 STL 一样直观”的 API 设计和单头文件即用的便捷性持续吸引开发者。
uses: C++ 后端/客户端开发者需要轻量、高性能 JSON 解析与序列化
嵌入式与游戏项目团队希望以单头文件引入依赖，简化构建流程
基础设施开发者在微服务、配置系统或协议网关中进行结构化数据交换

en.tag: Modern C++ JSON parsing and serialization library
en.what: A widely-adopted, header-only JSON library for C++ offering an intuitive, STL-like API to parse, generate, and manipulate JSON. It enables seamless mapping between JSON and C++ data structures, dramatically simplifying JSON handling in modern C++ projects.
en.content: The repository centers around a single-header distribution (json.hpp), complemented by comprehensive tests, benchmarks, documentation site sources, and package manager integrations like Conan and vcpkg.
en.stack: Built on C++11/14/17 with zero external dependencies, relying solely on STL containers and template metaprogramming; tests and examples are built via CMake.
en.hot: With over 50k stars and 17 new stars today, ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list, it has become the de facto standard JSON library in the C++ ecosystem. Its STL-intuitive API design and single-header convenience continue to attract developers.
uses: C++ backend and client developers needing lightweight, high-performance JSON parsing and serialization
Embedded and game teams looking to simplify builds with a single-header dependency
Infrastructure developers performing structured data exchange in microservices, config systems, or protocol gateways

zh.tag: 致敬 90 年代 UI 的类 Unix 图形操作系统
zh.what: SerenityOS 是一个为 64 位 x86、Arm 和 RISC-V 计算机打造的图形化类 Unix 操作系统。它融合了 90 年代末生产力软件的审美与 2000 年代末 Unix 的易用性，拥有自定义内核、浏览器、开发工具等完整生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的操作系统源码，包括内核、系统服务（窗口服务器、登录服务器等）、用户态库（LibC、LibJS、LibGL 等）、应用程序（浏览器、IDE、游戏等）以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，部分汇编和 C；构建系统基于 CMake，依赖 GCC/Clang 编译器。
zh.hot: 凭借复古 UI 设计、完整自研生态和活跃社区，长期吸引开发者关注，GitHub 星标超 3.3 万，本月新增 350 星。
uses: 操作系统爱好者 —— 学习现代 OS 设计与实现
复古 UI 爱好者 —— 体验 90 年代风格桌面环境
C++ 开发者 —— 参与大型开源项目贡献代码
技术探索者 —— 研究自研浏览器、内核等组件

en.tag: A graphical Unix-like OS paying homage to 90s UI
en.what: SerenityOS is a graphical Unix-like operating system for 64-bit x86, Arm, and RISC-V machines. It combines the aesthetics of late-1990s productivity software with the power-user accessibility of late-2000s Unix, featuring a custom kernel, browser, development tools, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the complete OS source code, including kernel, system services (WindowServer, LoginServer, etc.), userland libraries (LibC, LibJS, LibGL, etc.), applications (browser, IDE, games, etc.), build scripts, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with some assembly and C; build system is CMake-based, relying on GCC/Clang compilers.
en.hot: With its retro UI design, complete self-built ecosystem, and active community, it has long attracted developers, amassing over 33k stars on GitHub with 350 new stars this month.
uses: OS enthusiasts — learn modern OS design and implementation
Retro UI fans — experience a 90s-style desktop environment
C++ developers — contribute to a large open-source project
Technology explorers — study self-built browser, kernel, etc.

zh.tag: 通用运动恢复结构和多视角立体视觉管线
zh.what: COLMAP 是一个通用的运动恢复结构（SfM）和多视角立体（MVS）管线，提供图形界面和命令行接口。它支持对有序和无序图像集合进行三维重建，广泛应用于计算机视觉和摄影测量领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 SfM/MVS 源代码、预编译二进制文件、Docker 镜像、Python 绑定（pycolmap）以及详细的文档和示例数据集。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，依赖 Ceres Solver、PoseLib、SiftGPU、VLFeat 等库，支持 CUDA 加速。
zh.hot: 12.2k Stars，月增 314，稳居 GitHub C++ 热榜。作为开源 3D 重建的标杆工具，持续吸引研究者和开发者。
uses: 计算机视觉研究者 —— 用于三维重建算法实验和基准测试
摄影测量与测绘从业者 —— 从图像生成高精度点云和网格
AR/VR 开发者 —— 快速构建真实场景的三维模型
文化遗产保护 —— 对文物或建筑进行数字化存档

en.tag: General-purpose Structure-from-Motion and Multi-View Stereo pipeline
en.what: COLMAP is a general-purpose Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Multi-View Stereo (MVS) pipeline with a graphical and command-line interface. It enables 3D reconstruction from ordered and unordered image collections, widely used in computer vision and photogrammetry.
en.content: The repository contains the full SfM/MVS source code, pre-built binaries, Docker images, Python bindings (pycolmap), along with comprehensive documentation and sample datasets.
en.stack: Built with C++, depends on Ceres Solver, PoseLib, SiftGPU, VLFeat, and supports CUDA acceleration.
en.hot: 12.2k stars, +314 monthly, consistently on GitHub C++ trending. As the gold standard for open-source 3D reconstruction, it continues to attract researchers and developers.
uses: Computer vision researchers — for 3D reconstruction algorithm experiments and benchmarks
Photogrammetry and surveying professionals — to generate high-precision point clouds and meshes from images
AR/VR developers — to quickly build 3D models of real scenes
Cultural heritage preservation — to digitally archive artifacts or buildings

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 2D CAD 绘图工具
zh.what: LibreCAD 是一款基于 QCAD 社区版开发的免费 2D CAD 绘图软件，支持读取 DXF/DWG 格式，导出 DXF/DWG/PDF/SVG。它提供点、线、圆、椭圆、抛物线、双曲线、样条曲线等基本图元，并支持高度可定制的 GUI 和 30 多种语言翻译。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 LibreCAD 源代码，基于 Qt 框架和 libdxfrw 库实现 DXF/DWG 读写，并集成了 shapelib 用于 ESRI Shapefile 导入。提供预编译的稳定版和每日构建版，以及命令行工具用于 DXF 到 PDF/PNG/SVG 的转换。
zh.stack: 技术栈：C++、Qt（跨平台 GUI 框架）、libdxfrw（DXF/DWG 读写库）、shapelib（Shapefile 导入）。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 多平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 226 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 23 名。作为成熟的免费 CAD 替代方案，持续维护和更新（如 Qt6 支持）吸引了大量用户和贡献者。
uses: 工程师和设计师 —— 用于 2D 工程制图、建筑设计草图
教育领域 —— 作为免费 CAD 教学工具，降低学习成本
DIY 爱好者 —— 制作激光切割、CNC 加工图纸
企业用户 —— 替代昂贵的商业 CAD 软件进行基础绘图

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform 2D CAD drawing tool
en.what: LibreCAD is a free 2D CAD drawing tool based on the community edition of QCAD. It can read DXF/DWG files and export to DXF/DWG/PDF/SVG. It supports primitives like points, lines, circles, ellipses, parabolas, hyperbolas, and splines, with a highly customizable GUI and translations in over 30 languages.
en.content: The repository contains the full LibreCAD source code, built on Qt framework and libdxfrw for DXF/DWG read/write, with shapelib integration for ESRI Shapefile import. It provides precompiled stable and daily builds, plus command-line tools for DXF to PDF/PNG/SVG conversion.
en.stack: Tech stack: C++, Qt (cross-platform GUI framework), libdxfrw (DXF/DWG read/write), shapelib (Shapefile import). Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: Gained 226 stars this month, ranking 23rd in C++ monthly trending. As a mature free CAD alternative, continuous maintenance and updates (e.g., Qt6 support) attract many users and contributors.
uses: Engineers and designers — for 2D engineering drawings and architectural sketches
Education — as a free CAD teaching tool to reduce learning costs
DIY enthusiasts — creating laser cutting and CNC machining plans
Enterprise users — replacing expensive commercial CAD for basic drafting

zh.tag: Google 边缘端 ML/GenAI 高性能推理运行时
zh.what: LiteRT 是 TensorFlow Lite 的继任者，提供在边缘设备上部署机器学习与生成式 AI 的高性能运行时。它支持 GPU/NPU 加速，并集成了 LLM 推理、Web 推理、C++ 张量操作和 CLI 工具链。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LiteRT 运行时核心、构建状态徽章、文档链接以及多个子项目（LiteRT-LM、LiteRT.js、Tensor API、LiteRT CLI）的入口。
zh.stack: 主语言 C++，依赖 Python 3.13 构建环境，支持 Linux/macOS/Windows 多平台，集成 GPU/NPU 加速与 WebGPU/WASM。
zh.hot: 作为 TensorFlow Lite 的官方继任者，LiteRT 在边缘 AI 领域具有重大影响力，本月新增 586 星，总星数 3157，位列 C++ 月榜第 24 名。
uses: 移动端和嵌入式设备上的 ML/GenAI 推理部署
浏览器中通过 WebGPU/WASM 运行客户端 AI
AI 编码代理工作流加速（通过 LiteRT CLI）
边缘端 LLM 部署（通过 LiteRT-LM）

en.tag: Google's on-device runtime for high-performance ML & GenAI deployment on edge platforms
en.what: LiteRT, the successor to TensorFlow Lite, is Google's on-device runtime for deploying ML and GenAI on edge platforms with high performance. It features GPU/NPU acceleration, LLM inference, Web inference via WebGPU/WASM, C++ tensor API, and a CLI toolkit.
en.content: The repo contains the LiteRT runtime core, build status badges, documentation links, and entry points to subprojects like LiteRT-LM, LiteRT.js, Tensor API, and LiteRT CLI.
en.stack: Primary language is C++, with Python 3.13 build environment, multi-platform support (Linux/macOS/Windows), GPU/NPU acceleration, and WebGPU/WASM integration.
en.hot: As the official successor to TensorFlow Lite, LiteRT has significant impact in edge AI, gaining 586 stars this month (total 3157) and ranking #24 on the C++ monthly trending list.
uses: ML/GenAI inference deployment on mobile and embedded devices
Running client-side AI in browsers via WebGPU/WASM
Accelerating AI coding agent workflows via LiteRT CLI
On-device LLM deployment via LiteRT-LM

zh.tag: 开源体素游戏引擎，轻松模组与游戏创作
zh.what: Luanti（原名 Minetest）是一个免费开源的体素游戏引擎，专注于让用户轻松创建和修改游戏。它提供了丰富的默认控制、配置选项和跨平台支持，适合从玩家到开发者的广泛用户。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎源代码、文档、默认纹理和构建脚本。目录结构包括 bin（编译二进制）、share（只读数据）、user（用户数据）等，并提供了详细的编译指南和 Docker 支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 OpenGL 或 Vulkan 进行渲染，支持 Lua 脚本进行模组开发。构建系统支持 CMake，并提供跨平台编译选项。
zh.hot: 作为 Minetest 的继承者，Luanti 凭借其易用性和活跃的社区持续吸引用户，本月新增 379 星，总星数达 13351，在 C++ 月榜排名第 25。
uses: 游戏玩家 —— 体验和探索体素世界
模组开发者 —— 使用 Lua 轻松创建游戏模组
教育者 —— 用于教授编程和游戏设计
开源贡献者 —— 参与引擎开发和社区建设

en.tag: Open-source voxel game engine with easy modding and game creation
en.what: Luanti (formerly Minetest) is a free open-source voxel game engine that enables easy game creation and modding. It offers extensive default controls, configuration options, and cross-platform support, catering to players and developers alike.
en.content: The repository contains engine source code, documentation, default textures, and build scripts. Directory structure includes bin (compiled binaries), share (read-only data), user (user data), along with detailed compilation guides and Docker support.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with rendering via OpenGL or Vulkan, and Lua scripting for modding. Build system uses CMake with cross-platform compilation support.
en.hot: As the successor to Minetest, Luanti continues to attract users with its ease of use and active community, gaining 379 stars this month and reaching 13,351 total stars, ranking 25th on the C++ monthly trending list.
uses: Gamers — explore and experience voxel worlds
Mod developers — create game mods easily with Lua
Educators — teach programming and game design
Open-source contributors — participate in engine development and community

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills
